It is therefore hardly surprising that the southern German cartographer Martin Waldseemüller turned to the popular name of Amerigo Vespucci as an inspiration when he tried to suggest a name for these unknown lands one year later. <n><n>Waldseemüller’s name was accepted by his colleagues. It would have been fairer if the continent had been christened “Columbia”.
text: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布确实发现了一片新的陆地。准确地说，是重新发现，因为维京人早在中世纪就已踏上美洲的土地。但他却错误地宣称自己发现了通往印度的海路。<n><n>在筹备四次远航中的第二次和第三次时，这位热那亚人与来自佛罗伦萨的亚美利哥·韦斯普奇进行了合作。韦斯普奇率先提出，西方的这些土地其实属于一片全新而未知的大陆。这一惊人见解重新点燃了公众的兴趣，每当人们谈起这些新领土，总会提到韦斯普奇的名字。<n><n>相比之下，克里斯托弗·哥伦布的声望却每况愈下。在此期间，由于加勒比殖民者的投诉，他甚至曾戴着镣铐被押回国。1506年，他在愤懑与病痛中离世，也没有得到应有的关注。因此，一年后，德国南部的制图师马丁·瓦尔德泽米勒试图为这些未知土地提出一个名称时，采用了广受欢迎的亚美利哥·韦斯普奇之名，也就不足为奇了。<n><n>瓦尔德泽米勒提出的名字得到了同行的认可。若把这片大陆命名为“哥伦比亚”，或许会更公平一些。

source: The first part of America that rose to great importance under the Spanish was Hispaniola. Christopher Columbus had already founded the first European settlement here in 1493, although it had been wiped out by Native Americans even before he returned from Europe.<n><n>Over the following years, the Spanish Crown took increasing control of this island. The first monastery and the first cathedral were built, and it was here that the social system that was to be extended to the other areas was first established: A slave-holding society, strictly divided into classes and closely associated with the Catholic Church.<n><n>Hisponiola seemed to offer huge opportunities and attracted many enterprising settlers across the ocean. <n><n>However, it was not long before Spain directed its attention to other regions: By now, the great realms of the continent had been discovered and conquered. Here, it was easier to rule, the deposits of gold and silver were richer and easier to extract.<n><n>Just like a toy that has been tossed aside, people lost interest in Hispaniola. Dutch, English and French pirates took turns to mount attacks. In 1697, the French took control of Saint Domingue, the western part of the island (today Haiti) and established a profitable plantation economy. The production of cocoa, sugar, indigo, cotton and coffee made Saint Domingue the most profitable colony in the New World in the 18th century.<n><n>The only successful slave revolt in history, which erupted as a result of the French Revolution, eventually led to the independence of Haiti in 1804. The rebels treated their former oppressors very much as they had been treated themselves: "For the declaration of independence, we need the skin of a white man for the parchment, his skull as an inkwell, his blood as ink and a bayonet for a pen" announced the black General, Boisrond-Tonnerre at the time.
text: 美洲最早在西班牙统治下获得重要地位的地区，是伊斯帕尼奥拉岛。1493年，哥伦布便在这里建立了第一个欧洲人定居点，不过在他从欧洲返回之前，该定居点就已被原住民摧毁。<n><n>此后数年，西班牙王室逐步加强对该岛的控制。第一座修道院和第一座大教堂相继建成，后来推广到其他地区的社会制度，也最先在这里确立：一个阶级森严、与天主教会紧密相连的奴隶制社会。<n><n>伊斯帕尼奥拉似乎蕴藏着无限机会，吸引了许多富有进取心的移民横渡大洋。<n><n>然而，西班牙很快将目光投向其他地区：美洲大陆上的强大王国此时已被发现并征服。那里更容易统治，金银矿藏更加丰富，开采也更方便。<n><n>伊斯帕尼奥拉如同被丢弃的玩具，逐渐失去了人们的关注。荷兰、英格兰和法国海盗轮番来袭。1697年，法国控制了该岛西部的圣多明各，也就是今天的海地，并建立了利润丰厚的种植园经济。可可、糖、靛蓝、棉花和咖啡的生产，使圣多明各成为18世纪新大陆利润最高的殖民地。<n><n>受法国大革命影响而爆发的、历史上唯一成功的奴隶起义，最终促成海地于1804年独立。起义者以自己曾遭受的方式对待昔日的压迫者。黑人将领布瓦龙-托内尔当时宣称：“撰写独立宣言，我们需要一个白人的皮作纸，他的头骨作墨水瓶，他的血作墨水，再用刺刀当笔。”

source: A typical Caribbean product, though of questionable benefit to mankind, is rum. This spirit made from sugar-cane molasses, which originally bore the colorful name of “devil killer”, was first alluded to in Barbados in 1650. As the pirates’ legendary drink of choice, most people tend to associate rum with the island of Jamaica, one of the most feared pirate’s dens of all time. <n><n>Slave traders sold the human merchandise that they had purchased on the African coast in the Caribbean for large quantities of molasses. This molasses was refined into rum in New England and then transported to Africa on the very same ships. The spirit was sold in Africa and the empty ships were then loaded with a fresh cargo of slaves. With this fatal “triangle trade”, the ship owners ensured that their ships were always fully laden on every voyage.
text: 朗姆酒是加勒比地区的典型产品，尽管它究竟给人类带来多少好处值得商榷。这种用甘蔗糖蜜酿成的烈酒，最初有个响亮的名字——“杀魔酒”，于1650年首次见诸巴巴多斯的记载。作为传说中海盗最爱的饮品，朗姆酒常让人联想到牙买加岛，那是历史上最令人畏惧的海盗巢穴之一。<n><n>奴隶贩子将从非洲海岸买来的“人口货物”运到加勒比地区，换取大量糖蜜。糖蜜在新英格兰被酿成朗姆酒，再由同一批船运回非洲。烈酒在那里售出后，空船又装上新一批奴隶。这种残酷的“三角贸易”使船主的船只在每一段航程中都能满载而行。

source: Next to Cuba, Jamaica is probably the most famous of the Caribbean islands. Its name is derived from the Arawak Indian name of Xymaca, which means roughly “the land of wood and water”. Christopher Columbus himself, who had discovered the island nine years previously, had ample opportunity to experience the beauty of the landscape and the friendliness of its inhabitants when his ship was wrecked off the northern coast in 1503.<n><n>Indeed he liked it so much that he transferred ownership of the entire island from the King of Spain and declared it as his own. In spite of this, this island paradise was quite neglected over the next few decades until it was seized by the British in 1655. Very few Arawak still remained at this stage, as their tribe proved particularly susceptible to the diseases that the Europeans had brought with them.<n><n>In 1661, Edward D'Oyley was appointed captain general and governor of Jamaica. Under his authority, the capital of Port Royal was transformed into a vibrant, heavily defended haven for pirates. It was said to be the “richest and most corrupt place on earth” and many of the inhabitants, who were otherwise ordinary traders, frequently banded together to carry out private raids in Spanish waters. At first, the British Government showed little inclination to reign in these goings on, as after all, the buccaneers kept its Spanish rivals at bay.<n><n>It was only after Sir Henry Morgan took office as governor (significant in that he was a former pirate himself) that culture and order returned to Jamaica. Morgan ruthlessly suppressed piracy and showed no hesitation in sending his former associates to the gallows.<n><n>However, no sooner had British authority been re-established than a new and lucrative source of income in addition to growing sugar cane was discovered: After 1672, Port Royal developed into the largest slave market in the world, once the English Royal African Company had established a monopoly.
text: 除了古巴，牙买加大概是加勒比海最著名的岛屿。它的名字源于阿拉瓦克原住民的称呼Xymaca，大意为“森林与水之地”。1503年，哥伦布的船在牙买加北岸遇难，使这位九年前发现该岛的航海家，有充足的机会领略当地风光与居民的友善。<n><n>事实上，他如此喜爱这里，以至于将整座岛的所有权从西班牙国王名下划走，宣布归自己所有。尽管如此，在此后的数十年里，这座天堂般的岛屿一直遭到忽视，直到1655年被英国夺取。那时，阿拉瓦克人已所剩无几，因为他们对欧洲人带来的疾病尤其缺乏抵抗力。<n><n>1661年，爱德华·多伊利被任命为牙买加的军政长官兼总督。在他的统治下，首府皇家港变成了一座繁华而防守严密的海盗避风港。据说，它是“世上最富有、也最堕落的地方”。许多平日里只是普通商人的居民，经常结伙前往西班牙海域劫掠。起初，英国政府无意约束这些行为，毕竟私掠者替他们牵制着西班牙这个对手。<n><n>直到亨利·摩根爵士出任总督，文明与秩序才重返牙买加。颇具讽刺意味的是，他本人曾是一名海盗。摩根无情地镇压海盗活动，毫不犹豫地将昔日同伙送上绞刑架。<n><n>然而，英国权威刚刚重新确立，人们便在甘蔗种植之外发现了一种新的丰厚财源：1672年后，随着英国皇家非洲公司建立垄断，皇家港逐渐成为世界上最大的奴隶市场。

source: A mere two weeks after his arrival in the New World, Christopher Columbus reached Cuba, the largest island in the West Indies. Several tribes lived here, the Ciboney, die Guanahatabey and the Tainos, who, despite their peaceful nature, all suffered the same unhappy fate as other Native American tribes: In 1511, after fighting a four-year war against the Spanish, they were conquered and exterminated. This then resulted in large numbers of black slaves being imported here. The island, with its capital city Havana, was divided into seven administrative areas (cabildos), each of which sent a deputy to a special council. The deputy’s duty was to represent local interests of the area.<n><n>What is remarkable about the history of Cuba is that, apart from a short interlude of British control from 1762 to 1763, the island remained in Spanish hands for a relatively long time. This may have been because Cuba was not one of the most important areas of the Spanish empire during colonial times (for example, there were hardly any mineral deposits) and was generally used as a stopover on the way to the continent. In any case, while the vast majority of South American and Central American countries fought for their independence in the first quarter of the 19th century, the Spanish were able to hold on to Cuba until 1898, when they ceded control of the island to the United States.
text: 抵达新大陆仅仅两周后，克里斯托弗·哥伦布便到达了西印度群岛最大的岛屿——古巴。岛上居住着西博内人、瓜纳哈塔贝人和泰诺人等多个部族。尽管他们天性和平，却仍遭遇了其他美洲原住民同样的不幸：1511年，在与西班牙人进行了四年战争后，他们被征服并惨遭灭绝。随后，大量黑人奴隶被运到这里。以哈瓦那为首府的古巴岛被划分为七个行政区（cabildos），每区派遣一名代表参加特别议会，维护本地区的利益。<n><n>古巴历史的一大特点是，除了1762至1763年间短暂受英国控制之外，这座岛长期掌握在西班牙手中。原因或许在于，殖民时代的古巴并非西班牙帝国最重要的地区之一，例如岛上几乎没有矿藏，通常只是前往美洲大陆途中的中转站。无论如何，当南美与中美绝大多数国家在19世纪前四分之一时期争取独立时，西班牙却一直控制着古巴，直到1898年才将该岛交给美国。

source: It is well known that many things we now take for granted first arrived in Europe as a result of the trade with America. However, the cultural exchange worked the other way around.<n><n> For example, when one pictures the typical Native American of the North American plains, it is hard to imagine that there were no horses in America before the arrival of the Spanish and the Portuguese. Many of the Native Americans fled in blind panic the first time that they saw a horse and rider, because they thought that this was a strange beast comprising two beings that had grown into one.<n><n>Coffee, which one normally associates with countries such as Brazil and Guatemala, is not native to America and had already traveled across three continents before its arrival there: From Africa (probably from Ethiopia), it traveled via the Arab countries before arriving in southwest Europe. The plant was first introduced in America during the 18th century, when the drink’s increasing popularity made it necessary to increase cultivation of the crop.<n><n>In the potato, the Europeans had discovered in the Caribbean a basic foodstuff of unimaginable value. Conversely, wheat was unknown in America until the arrival of the Spanish and the English, who brought this crop to Mexico in 1520 and to Virginia in 1777 respectively. Although people originally felt that the American climate was not suited to growing wheat, it was North America in particular that witnessed the most phenomenal success of this crop. Today, wheat is the agricultural crop with the largest acreage under cultivation in the world.
text: 众所周知，许多如今习以为常的事物，最初都是通过与美洲的贸易传入欧洲的。不过，文化交流也沿着相反的方向进行。<n><n>例如，人们想到北美大平原上的原住民时，很难想象在西班牙人和葡萄牙人到来之前，美洲竟然没有马。许多原住民第一次看到骑马的人时惊恐逃散，以为眼前是一种由两个生物长成一体的怪兽。<n><n>人们通常将咖啡与巴西、危地马拉等国家联系在一起，但咖啡并非美洲原产植物。在抵达美洲之前，它已经辗转经过三个大洲：从非洲（很可能是埃塞俄比亚）出发，经阿拉伯地区传入欧洲西南部。直到18世纪，随着咖啡饮品日益流行、种植需求扩大，这种植物才被引入美洲。<n><n>欧洲人在加勒比地区发现了马铃薯，这是一种价值难以估量的主食。反过来，美洲原本并不认识小麦。西班牙人于1520年将小麦带到墨西哥，英国人则于1777年将其带到弗吉尼亚。起初，人们认为美洲气候不适宜种植小麦，然而小麦后来恰恰在北美取得了惊人的成功。如今，小麦是世界上种植面积最大的农作物。

source: Can you imagine life without chocolate? You certainly should, because cocoa was unknown in the rest of the world before the discovery of America. The word cocoa probably originates from the Maya language, to which it can first be traced: It seems certain that Maya traders were drinking cocoa 400 years before the birth of Christ.<n><n>The Aztecs, who were the dominant power on the Central American continent since the 14th century, even bestowed a religious significance on cocoa. The first European to come into contact with this delicacy was, once again, Christopher Columbus, although this was on a later voyage in 1502 that took him to Nicaragua.<n><n>However, the rightful “discoverer” of cocoa is Hernan Cortés, conqueror of the Aztec kingdom, who brought back to Spain the recipe for a drink called xocoatl (hence the word “chocolate”). The taste was initially too bitter for the European palate and it was only after people started to add sugar or vanilla that hot chocolate become a popular drink among the Iberian upper classes.<n><n>The Spanish kept the recipe to themselves for nearly a hundred years, after which time hot chocolate spread through France and the rest of Europe. Around the year 1700, the British added milk. The final breakthrough of cocoa in Europe took place when it was discovered how delicious coffee and cocoa tasted together.
text: 你能想象没有巧克力的生活吗？不妨试着想想，因为在美洲被发现之前，世界其他地方根本不知道可可。可可一词很可能源于玛雅语，最早的痕迹也可追溯至此。可以确定的是，早在公元前400年，玛雅商人就已经饮用可可了。<n><n>自14世纪起称霸中美洲大陆的阿兹特克人，甚至赋予可可宗教意义。第一个接触这种美味的欧洲人又是克里斯托弗·哥伦布，不过那是在1502年他后来一次抵达尼加拉瓜的航行中。<n><n>然而，可可真正的“发现者”应当算是阿兹特克王国的征服者埃尔南·科尔特斯。他把一种名为xocoatl的饮品配方带回了西班牙，“巧克力”一词便由此而来。起初，欧洲人觉得这种饮品太苦；直到加入糖或香草之后，热巧克力才在伊比利亚上层社会流行起来。<n><n>西班牙人将配方保密了近一百年，此后热巧克力才传入法国及欧洲其他地区。1700年前后，英国人又往里面加入了牛奶。当人们发现咖啡与可可搭配起来十分美味时，可可终于在欧洲大获成功。

source: Although it is sometimes difficult to distinguish between reality and legend when one talks about piracy, there is no disputing the fact that there were women pirates. Two of the most dazzling figures set out on this course on the island of Jamaica during the early 18th century.<n><n>Anne Bonny, who was said to have been stabbed in the stomach while still a child, had eloped with a seaman to the pirate haven of New Providence (Nassau). There, she managed to get rid of her husband and start her own career on board a captured Dutch ship. <n><n>There, she met Mary Read, who had already fought in the Spanish Wars of Succession disguised as a man and who allegedly bared her breasts to her opponents before killing them, to prove to them that they had been beaten by a woman.<n><n>After their capture in the year 1720, they only escaped being sent to the gallows because they were pregnant. They fared better than most of their male sidekicks, on whose heads Anne Bonny could only pour scorn.<n><n>Below are the words she spoke to the infamous “Calico Jack” on his way to the gallows: “I’m sorry to see you here, Jack, but if you had only fought like a man, you wouldn’t be here to be hung like a dog”.
text: 谈起海盗，现实与传说有时很难分清，但女性海盗的存在无可争议。18世纪初，两位最耀眼的人物在牙买加岛踏上了这条道路。<n><n>据说童年时腹部就曾被刺伤的安妮·邦妮，与一名水手私奔，来到海盗天堂新普罗维登斯（拿骚）。在那里，她设法摆脱丈夫，登上一艘俘获的荷兰船，开始了自己的生涯。<n><n>她在那里遇见了玛丽·里德。里德此前曾女扮男装，参加西班牙王位继承战争。据说她在杀死对手前，会露出胸部，让他们知道自己败在一个女人手里。<n><n>1720年两人被俘后，只因怀孕才免于走上绞刑架。她们的遭遇比多数男性同伙好得多，而安妮·邦妮对那些男人只有鄙夷。<n><n>臭名昭著的“棉布杰克”被押往绞刑架时，她对他说：“杰克，看到你落到这步田地，我很难过。可你当初若像个男人一样战斗，就不会像条狗一样被吊死。”

source: The Welshman, Bartholomew Roberts (1682? – 1722), was not only one of the most important pirates but he was also a very unusual one. Also known as “Black Bart” (not to be confused with “Blackbeard” alias Edward Teach), he was a late convert to piracy at 37 years of age, although the transition into criminal activities was without doubt a smooth one: The ship on which he was working and which was attacked in 1719 by his fellow Welshman Howell Davis was in fact a slave ship.<n><n>Roberts decided to throw in his lot with Davis, after whose murder a couple of weeks later, he assumed the role of captain. It is said that Bartholomew Roberts avoided alcohol and preferred tea.<n><n>In contrast to Teach, who cast himself as the devil incarnate, Roberts had a penchant for fine clothes, disliked gambling and insisted that his men said their prayers. However, this certainly did not mean that Roberts was a pious man at heart. There are numerous tales of the atrocities he committed, especially against prisoners, during his countless looting exploits. With a haul of over 400 ships and an area of operation extending from Brazil as far as Newfoundland and West Africa, he was, along with Henry Morgan, one of the most successful pirates of Central America. <n><n>The roar of guns from a British warship off the coast of Guinea in 1722 signaled the end of his career and the removal of one of the greatest menaces on the seven seas.
text: 威尔士人巴塞洛缪·罗伯茨（约1682—1722）不仅是最重要的海盗之一，也是个与众不同的人。他绰号“黑巴特”，不要与绰号“黑胡子”的爱德华·蒂奇混淆。他直到37岁才投身海盗生涯，不过，走上这条罪恶道路对他来说无疑并不突兀：1719年，他任职的船只遭到同为威尔士人的豪厄尔·戴维斯袭击，而那艘船本身就是一艘贩奴船。<n><n>罗伯茨决定加入戴维斯的团伙。几周后戴维斯被杀，他便接任了船长。据说巴塞洛缪·罗伯茨不喝酒，偏爱饮茶。<n><n>蒂奇把自己装扮成恶魔化身，罗伯茨却喜欢华丽服饰，厌恶赌博，还坚持让手下做祷告。但这绝不意味着他内心虔诚仁善。关于他在无数次劫掠中犯下的暴行，尤其是虐待俘虏的行径，流传着许多故事。他劫获了400多艘船，活动范围从巴西远至纽芬兰和西非，与亨利·摩根并称中美洲最成功的海盗。<n><n>1722年，一艘英国战舰在几内亚海岸外的炮声结束了他的生涯，也让七海之上少了一个最大的祸患。

source: The most famous buccaneer of the 17th century was the Welshman, Henry Morgan (1635-1688), who plagued the Spanish colonies in the West Indies, thereby shaking the authority of the great Iberian power in the region to its foundations.<n><n>His life exemplifies the rather dubious morality behind the policies of Britain, Holland and France, who were only too happy to turn a blind eye to piracy as long as it inflicted damage on the other great powers.<n><n>Henry Morgan, who was put in command of a buccaneer ship in 1668, first started to wreak havoc along the northern coast of South America. In command of almost 2,000 men, he captured the heavily defended town of Panama in August 1670, and then absconded with most of the booty on the return voyage. However, because the attack took place after Spain and England had signed a peace treaty, has was taken prisoner and put on trial in London.<n><n>Morgan was not convicted, on the contrary: It was not long before the winds of diplomacy had once more changed direction. Not only was Morgan pardoned, he was made a knight. As Sir Henry, he was appointed as the new governor of Jamaica, where he imposed strict law and order and lived out the remaining years of his life as a wealthy and respected planter.
text: 17世纪最著名的海盗是威尔士人亨利·摩根（1635—1688）。他不断袭扰西印度群岛的西班牙殖民地，从根本上动摇了这个伊比利亚强国在当地的权威。<n><n>他的一生体现了英国、荷兰和法国外交政策背后颇为可疑的道德观：只要海盗损害的是其他强国的利益，这些国家就乐于睁一只眼闭一只眼。<n><n>1668年，亨利·摩根开始指挥一艘海盗船，随后在南美洲北岸肆意劫掠。1670年8月，他率领近两千人攻占了防守严密的巴拿马城，并在返航途中携大部分战利品潜逃。不过，由于这次袭击发生在西班牙和英格兰签订和平条约之后，他被捕并押往伦敦受审。<n><n>摩根不仅没有被定罪，反而很快遇上了外交风向的再次转变。他获得赦免，还被授予骑士爵位。此后，亨利爵士被任命为牙买加总督，在那里严厉整顿治安，最终以富有而受人尊敬的种植园主身份度过了余生。

source: The Bahamas, which for a brief period in the middle of the 17th century served as a refuge for religious dissenters from England, was from 1670 officially under the control of the Earl of Albemarle and other gentlemen who had taken ownership of the group of islands from King Charles II in the hope of making profits.<n><n>Despite their promises, however, these individual showed little interest in setting up a well-ordered civil administration. Quite the opposite was the case: Similar to other places in the Caribbean, hordes of pirates settled in the Bahamas, especially on the island of New Providence, which was home to the town of Nassau. <n><n>The shallow bays, into which heavy warships could not intrude, offered an ideal berth for several hundred sloops and pirate barques. The frequent raids in Spanish waters resulted in reprisals and John Wentworth, the first governor, had the unenviable task of reimposing law and order on the islands.<n><n>As the situation showed no signs of improvement, King George I of England confiscated the Bahamas again and turned it into a Crown Colony. Woodes Rogers, the former buccaneer and circumnavigator, was appointed the first royal governor in the middle of 1718.<n><n>Using a carrot and stick approach, he brought an end to the chaos that had hitherto prevailed. He held out a general amnesty for all pirates who were prepared to renounce their activities under oath. For all those who were unwilling to do so, punishment awaited in the form of a fleet of ships armed to the teeth.<n><n>After normal conditions had been restored in this way, the island group was granted its own parliament in 1729 and over the following hundred years, with the exception of occasional disturbances as a result of invasions, the history of the Bahamas remained relatively uneventful.
text: 17世纪中叶，巴哈马曾短暂成为英格兰宗教异见者的避难所。1670年起，群岛正式归阿尔伯马尔伯爵及其他几位绅士管辖。他们从查理二世手中取得群岛所有权，希望从中获利。<n><n>然而，这些人虽有承诺，却对建立井然有序的民政管理毫无兴趣。情况恰恰相反：和加勒比海其他地方一样，成群海盗在巴哈马落脚，尤其聚集于拿骚所在的新普罗维登斯岛。<n><n>浅海湾使重型战舰无法进入，却为数百艘单桅帆船和海盗巴克帆船提供了理想泊地。海盗频繁袭击西班牙海域，引来报复。首任总督约翰·温特沃思因此接下了一桩苦差事：恢复群岛的法律与秩序。<n><n>局势迟迟不见好转，英王乔治一世收回巴哈马，将其改为王室殖民地。1718年年中，曾是私掠者和环球航海家的伍兹·罗杰斯，被任命为首位王室总督。<n><n>他恩威并施，结束了当地长期的混乱。愿意宣誓放弃海盗生涯的人，都可以得到大赦；拒绝者面对的，则是一支武装到牙齿的舰队。<n><n>秩序就此恢复后，群岛于1729年获准设立自己的议会。此后一百年间，除偶有入侵造成动荡，巴哈马的历史大体平静。

source: Almost everywhere in their newly acquired colonies, the Spanish set up a rigid social system offering precious little opportunity for advancement. At the very top of the hierarchy were those fellow countrymen born in Europe.<n><n> Spaniards born in the colonies were known as Creoles. Although they were only considered as being of secondary importance in the hierarchy, they occupied most of the lesser positions in the state, church and the army.<n><n>Spaniards of European descent and Creoles therefore represented the elite class in the colonies. The children of mixed marriages between whites (mostly men) and Native Americans were known as mestizos. The Native Americans, who originally owned the land, occupied the very lowest position in society and in those areas where they had been completely exterminated by the Europeans, this honor was reserved for the black slaves.<n><n>The relative proportions of these classes among the population differed greatly among the various regions of the Spanish empire. In Mexico, for example, the mestizos formed the largest section of the population. On many islands, black slaves were present in superior numbers (and at the mercy of their masters). Native American tribes also managed to survive in those areas where jungles, swamps and mountainous regions offered a safe retreat, for example, in Bolivia or Florida.
text: 西班牙人几乎在每一处新获得的殖民地，都建立了严格的社会等级制度，个人向上晋升的机会少得可怜。站在等级顶端的，是出生于欧洲的西班牙同胞。<n><n>出生在殖民地的西班牙人被称为克里奥尔人。虽然他们在社会等级中只居次席，却占据了国家、教会和军队中大部分较低级别的职位。<n><n>因此，欧洲出生的西班牙人和克里奥尔人构成了殖民地的精英阶层。白人——通常为男性——与美洲原住民通婚所生的子女被称为梅斯蒂索人。原本拥有这些土地的美洲原住民，却处于社会最底层；而在他们遭欧洲人彻底灭绝的地区，这份“殊荣”便落到了黑人奴隶头上。<n><n>西班牙帝国各地区人口中，这些阶层所占的比例差异很大。例如，在墨西哥，梅斯蒂索人构成了人口最多的群体。许多岛屿上，黑人奴隶人数占优，却仍任由主人摆布。美洲原住民部落也在丛林、沼泽和山区提供庇护的地方得以生存，例如玻利维亚和佛罗里达。

source: %1,<n>in normal circumstances I wouldn't see you now, but times are hard and I have something to discuss with you.
text: %1，<n>通常我现在不会接见你，但眼下时局艰难，我有些事情想与你商量。

source: Our enemies have looted English traders numerous times in recent days.
text: 近日，我国敌人多次劫掠英格兰商人。

source: Our enemies have looted French traders numerous times in recent days.
text: 最近几天，敌人多次劫掠法国商人。

source: Our enemies have looted Dutch traders numerous times in recent days.
text: 最近几天，敌人多次劫掠荷兰商人。

source: Our enemies have looted Spanish traders numerous times in recent days.
text: 最近几天，敌人多次劫掠西班牙商人。

source: In this scenario, you have to track down and kill the infamous pirate Edward Teach, otherwise known as Blackbeard. The Governor of Havana gives you various instructions and supports you in your quest.<n:25>In this scenario, you can use all the options offered in free-play mode. However, you'll also have specific tasks to fulfill in order to complete the scenario successfully.
text: 本关中，你要追踪并消灭臭名昭著的海盗爱德华·蒂奇，也就是黑胡子。哈瓦那总督会不断给你指示，并支持你的行动。<n:25>本关可使用自由游戏模式中的全部功能，但你还需要完成指定任务，才能成功通关。

source: You are to loot English ships and seize a certain number of goods.
text: 你要劫掠英格兰船只，夺取一定数量的货物。

source: You are to loot French ships and seize a certain number of goods.
text: 你需要劫掠法国船只，夺取一定数量的货物。

source: You are to loot Dutch ships and seize a certain number of goods.
text: 您需要劫掠荷兰船只，夺取指定数量的商品。

source: You are to loot Spanish ships and seize a certain number of goods.
text: 你需要劫掠西班牙船只，夺取一定数量的货物。

source: So be it. I want you to destroy @I$NumConvoys$ military convoys belonging to @n$TargetNation$. You must hurry, for the success of the entire operation depends on the element of surprise. You therefore only have until @D$EndDate$.
text: 那就这么定了。我希望你消灭@n$TargetNation$的@I$NumConvoys$支军事船队。必须抓紧时间，整个行动能否成功全靠出其不意。因此，你的期限是@D$EndDate$。

source: I am delighted. However, I regret that I cannot give you much time. Destroy @I$NumConvoys$ military convoys belonging to @n$TargetNation$ by @D$EndDate$.
text: 太好了。不过很抱歉，我给不了你太多时间。在@D$EndDate$之前，消灭@n$TargetNation$的@I$NumConvoys$支军事船队。

source: Deliver @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$ from the market in @T$TOWN$ to the market in @T$Town$. You have until @D$EndDate$.
text: 在@D$EndDate$之前，把@a$Amount$的@G$Goods$从@T$TOWN$市场运到@T$Town$市场。

source: That's a strange and very interesting artifact you've found there. Please leave it here with me and bring me any other artifacts you can find. Maybe I can find out something about them.
text: 你找到的这件器物既古怪又有趣。请先把它留在我这里，日后找到其他器物也请带来。也许我能查出它们的来历。

source: The longer I look at these artifacts, the more I get the impression that they have a special significance other than just their practical purpose. I have found strange engravings on some of them. Perhaps you will find even more artifacts and that might help.
text: 看这些遗物越久，我就越觉得它们除了实用价值，还另有特殊意义。我在其中几件上发现了奇怪的刻文。也许再找到一些遗物，就能有所帮助。

source: He often has business to attend to in a town in the northwest.
text: 他经常去西北方的一座城镇办事。

source: He is usually to be found in a town to the north, between Biloxi and Grand Bahama.
text: 通常可以在北方比洛克西与大巴哈马之间的一座城镇找到他。

source: His home town is somewhere in the north of the Caribbean, to the east of Grand Bahama.
text: 他的家乡在加勒比海北部，大巴哈马以东的某个地方。

source: You will find him in a town to the northeast.
text: 你能在东北方的一座城镇找到他。

source: You will find him in a town in the Western Caribbean.
text: 你能在加勒比海西部的一座城镇找到他。

source: He has a girl, somewhere in a town in the middle of the Caribbean, between Cancun, Havana, Trinidad and Roatán.
text: 他在加勒比海中部的一座城镇里有个姑娘，地方在坎昆、哈瓦那、特立尼达和罗阿坦之间。

source: He often has business to attend to in the middle of the Caribbean, between Andross, Charles Towne, Santo Domingo and Port Royale
text: 他经常在加勒比海中部处理生意，活动范围在安德罗斯、查尔斯镇、圣多明各和皇家港之间。

source: His home town is somewhere in the Eastern Caribbean.
text: 他的家乡在加勒比海东部。

source: He has a girl, somewhere in a town far to the southwest.
text: 他有个姑娘，住在遥远西南方的某座城镇里。

source: His home town is somewhere in the south, between Providence and Curacao.
text: 他的家乡在南方某处，位于普罗维登斯与库拉索之间。

source: He often has business in a town to the south, between Providence and Curacao.
text: 他经常到南方一座城镇办事，位置在普罗维登斯和库拉索之间。

source: He has a girl, somewhere in a town to the southeast.
text: 他在东南方某座城镇有个相好。

source: The status of the town is too low.
Not all of the local traders' businesses are working to full capacity.
text: 当地商人的产业尚未全部满负荷运转。

source: Increase the population of your town to 480.
text: 把你的城镇人口提高到480。

source: %1,<n><n>You can buy a building permit for this town. If your reputation in my nation were higher, I would offer you a better price.<n><n>The current price for a building permit is %2.
text: %1：<n><n>你可以购买本城的建筑许可证。如果你在我国的声望更高，我会给你更优惠的价格。<n><n>目前建筑许可证的价格是%2。

source: %1,<n><n>you can purchase a permit to build in this town.<n><n>A permit costs %2.<n>The more building permits you have, the more expensive the next one will be.
text: %1，<n><n>你可以购买本城的建筑许可证。<n><n>许可证价格为%2。<n>你已有的建筑许可证越多，下一张就越昂贵。

source: Governor %1 %2 of the town of %3 has been dismissed.
<n>The viceroy of %1 has moved to %2. Governor %3 %4 has been dismissed.
text: <n>%1的殖民地总督已迁往%2。总督%3 %4已被免职。

source: Your trading record in this town is not yet impressive enough for you to be allowed to meet the treasurer. Deliver goods that the town needs to improve your trading record.
text: 你对本城的贸易贡献还不够，暂时无法获准面见财务官。运来城镇需要的货物，就能提高贸易贡献。

source: <n>Do you want to give me some gold for the upkeep of additional soldiers? I can get %2 new soldiers for %1.
text: <n>你愿意出些钱，供养更多士兵吗？支付%1，我就能再招募%2名士兵。

source: A military convoy has tried, unsuccessfully, to breach the town's harbor defenses.
text: 一支军事船队试图突破城镇港口防线，但未能成功。

source: Help the viceroy in Grand Bahama to increase Holland’s military strength by handing over a convoy to him. Then accept a mission to capture towns on his behalf.
text: 向大巴哈马的殖民地总督移交一支船队，帮助荷兰增强军力。然后接受任务，替他夺取城镇。

source: This ship has no captain and so cannot set sail. Hire a captain for this ship at the inn or add it to an existing convoy.
text: 这艘船没有船长，因此无法出航。请到酒馆为它雇用船长，或将其编入现有船队。

source: You have sold your building permit and all your buildings in this town.
text: 您已出售本城的建造许可证及您在这里的全部建筑。

source: You have handed back your building permit.

A trader from a different nation has lured away a considerable number of workers. These workers have left the town as settlers together with their families.<n><n>Now your task is to find enough settlers so that every business in the town has a full complement of workers by no later than @D$EndDate$.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective <f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>The number of citizens (inhabitants minus soldiers) must be restored to @I$Pop$ by no later than @D$EndDate$.
text: 一位外国商人挖走了大量工人。他们带着家人，以移民身份离开了城镇。<n><n>现在，你必须找到足够移民，最迟在@D$EndDate$前让城中每家企业都拥有充足工人。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>最迟在@D$EndDate$前，将市民人数（总人口减去士兵人数）恢复到@I$Pop$。

source: I'm afraid you have taken too long to reply. Speak with my daughter first to see if she still wants you.
text: 恐怕你迟迟没有答复，已经拖得太久了。先去找我女儿谈谈，看她是否还愿意嫁给你。

source: Greetings. Do you have a ship that can bring me to @T$TargetTown$? I urgently need to get there by @D$EndDate$. I will pay you @g$Reward$ if you get me there on time.
text: 你好。你有船能带我去@T$TargetTown$吗？我急需在@D$EndDate$前到达。如果按时送到，我付给你@g$Reward$。

source: @A$USER$, I've been left in the lurch here. But I urgently need to get to @T$TargetTown$. Can you bring me there? I will pay you @g$Reward$!
text: @A$USER$，我被人丢在这里不管了，可我急着去@T$TargetTown$。你能送我一程吗？我会付你@g$Reward$！

source: @A$USER$, I'm looking for a ride to @T$TargetTown$. I would be most grateful if you would offer me a berth on one of your ships. I will pay you @g$Reward$.
text: @A$USER$，我想搭船去@T$TargetTown$。如果你愿意在船上给我安排一个铺位，我将不胜感激。我会付给你@g$Reward$。

source: So be it. Please start building a hospital in @T$Town$ by @D$EndDate$.
text: 就这么办。请在@D$EndDate$之前开始在@T$Town$建造医院。

source: Would you like to chance a little card game with me?<n><n>Then choose your stake! I’ll match it, and the winner takes all.
text: 想和我玩一局牌，试试运气吗？<n><n>那就选个赌注吧！我出同样多的钱，赢家全拿。

source: I don't even need to ask you if you'll join me in a game, you're as cleaned out as a freshly scrubbed deck! Come back when your pockets are full.
text: 我都不用问你愿不愿意赌一局了，你的口袋比刚刷过的甲板还干净！等钱袋鼓起来再来吧。

source: Oh no, not you again! I can still remember our last game. Do you still not have enough? Well, I won't be playing with you for the time being.
text: 哦，不会又是你吧！上次那局牌我还记得一清二楚。你还没玩够吗？反正我暂时不想再和你玩了。

source: Everyone has been given 5 cards. I'll call %1 points.<n><n>If you want to play, you must call one point higher.
text: 每人都拿到了5张牌。我叫%1点。<n><n>如果您想继续，就必须再加一点。

source: Then I'm in. %1 are trumps.<n>Here is my first card.
text: 那我跟了。%1是王牌。<n>这是我的第一张牌。

source: You lead. Tell me which color you want as the trump suit (choose a card).
text: 由你主叫。告诉我哪种花色是王牌，选一张牌即可。

source: So %1 are trumps.<n>Play your first card.
text: 那就以%1为王牌。<n>请出第一张牌。

source: You have won 1 point.<n>Choose your next card.
text: 你赢得一分。<n>选择下一张牌。

source: I have won 1 point.<n>And here is my card.
I can't reach the number of points I called. I've lost.
text: 我达不到自己叫出的分数。我输了。

source: I have reached the number of points I called. You have lost.
text: 我达到了自己叫出的分数。你输了。

source: You cannot reach the number of points you called. You have lost the game.
text: 您无法达到叫出的点数。这局牌您输了。

source: You have reached the number of points you called. You're home and dry!
text: 你达到了自己叫出的分数。这局你稳稳赢了！

source: So, that's my last point. You've lost the game!
text: 这是我需要的最后一分。你输掉这局了！

source: Damn, I should have won that point. I've lost the game.
text: 可恶，那一分本该归我。这一局我输了。

source: Well, the game went in my favor after all. I'm afraid you've lost.
text: 看来这局还是对我有利。恐怕你输了。

source: You have the luck of the devil!<n>That was my last game, I'm broke.
text: 你的运气真是邪了门！<n>这是我最后一局了，我已经输光了。

source: You've taken all my gold. Order me a bottle of rum, and then please leave me alone to drown my sorrows.
text: 我的金币全被你赢走了。给我叫瓶朗姆酒，然后让我一个人借酒消愁吧。

source: Now you've done it! I won’t be able to show my face at home tonight.
text: 这下您可把我坑惨了！今晚我都没脸回家了。

source: Do you want to chance another game?
Your convoy picks up a message in a bottle. The bottle contains a map showing the location of a particular spot.
text: 你的船队捡到一只漂流瓶。瓶里装着一张地图，上面标明了一个特殊地点的位置。

source: Your convoy picks up a message in a bottle. The bottle contains a map showing the location of a particular spot.
text: 你的船队捡到一只漂流瓶。瓶里装着一张地图，上面标明了一个特殊地点的位置。

source: The convoy finds a message in a bottle. It contains a hastily written note: "Rescue me! I think they intend bringing me to this spot!".<n>The note is accompanied by a map showing the location of a particular spot.
text: 船队发现了一个漂流瓶，里面有张匆忙写下的纸条：“救救我！我想他们要把我带到这个地方！”<n>纸条旁附着一张地图，上面标出了一个地点。

source: Very good! That was no simple feat! England has now lost so many military convoys that its towns can be captured. In grateful recognition of your service, the Governor of the Turk Islands provides you with four more carracks.<n><n>You can only capture a nation's towns by order of a viceroy. A viceroy will only instruct you to capture a town if his own nation is militarily strong and the enemy nation is militarily weak.<n><n>Unfortunately, Holland is not strong enough to be able to capture a town. However, you can do something about this: Pay a visit to the Dutch viceroy in Grand Bahama and hand over one of your convoys to him. He will then assemble a new military convoy, which will increase Holland's military strength.<n><n>If you want to hand over a convoy to a viceroy, the convoy in question must have exactly five ships and at least 150 cannons.<n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Help the viceroy to increase Holland's military strength. Then accept a mission to capture towns on his behalf.
text: 干得漂亮！这可不是件容易的事！英格兰已经损失了如此多的军事船队，现在可以夺取它的城镇了。为感谢你的贡献，特克斯群岛总督又送给你四艘卡拉克帆船。<n><n>只有奉殖民地总督之命，你才能为国家夺取城镇。殖民地总督只有在本国军事实力强大、敌国军事实力薄弱时，才会下达占领城镇的命令。<n><n>遗憾的是，荷兰目前还不够强大，无法夺取城镇。不过，你可以改变这一点：拜访大巴哈马的荷兰殖民地总督，将你的一支船队交给他。他会据此组建新的军事船队，增强荷兰的军事实力。<n><n>交给殖民地总督的船队，必须恰好拥有五艘船，并配备至少150门火炮。<n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>帮助殖民地总督增强荷兰的军事实力，然后接受为他夺取城镇的任务。

source: Quality of Life in Your Town

This time, you begin the scenario in Cartagena, a governor town in the middle of the Caribbean.<n>Your convoy, which consists of a sloop, is in the harbor.<n>First you must arm your convoy because this scenario will involve sea battles.<n>Go to the docks and open the Cargo menu.
text: 这次您从加勒比海中部设有总督的城镇卡塔赫纳开始。<n>您的船队停在港内，目前只有一艘单桅帆船。<n>这个场景会涉及海战，因此首先要武装船队。<n>前往码头，打开货物菜单。

source: As you can see, you have no cannons or ammunition on board your convoy. You are also in need of a crew.<n>Take on board the largest crew and as many cannons as you can, as well as 10x10 of each of the three types of ammunition for your cannons.<n>There may not be enough space in your convoy because cannons are heavy. If this is the case, you can sell some of the goods you have loaded.
text: 可以看到，船队没有火炮或弹药，也缺少船员。<n>尽量补满船员和火炮，再带上三种炮弹各10×10发。<n>火炮很重，船队可能装不下。若空间不足，可以卖掉一些已装载的货物。

source: Well done! Your convoy is now armed and ready for a small-scale battle.<n>As it happens, the Governor of Cartagena now has the perfect mission for you.<n>Click on the governor's building and accept his mission.
text: 干得好！船队已经武装完毕，可以打一场小规模战斗。<n>正好，卡塔赫纳总督现在有一项很适合你的任务。<n>点击总督府，接受任务。

source: Governors often propose missions that will improve your reputation with their nation if they are successfully accomplished.<n>You are also entitled to ask governors for Letters of Marque or claim ransom for buccaneers whom you have captured.<n>Now use your convoy to find the ships the governor told you about.
text: 总督经常发布任务，成功完成后可提高你在该国的声望。<n>你还可以向总督申请私掠许可证，或为被你俘获的私掠者索取赎金。<n>现在派船队去寻找总督提到的船只。

source: Very good, you have located the convoy.<n>Your next step is to clear your ship for action and prepare to engage in combat. To do so, open the list of ships in your convoy and select your sloop. To declare it as a warship, press the button next to the cannon. You can then "attack" the convoy by right-clicking on it.
text: 很好，你找到了船队。<n>接下来要让船只进入战备。打开船队的船只列表，选中单桅帆船，再按火炮旁边的按钮，把它设为战船。之后右键点击敌方船队，就能发起攻击。

source: This is Port Royale's Sea Battle View.<n>It shows your ship and you can view the abandoned ships by moving the display window.<n>Now deactivate pause mode and practice navigating with the right mouse button. The Event window displays the direction of the wind and the ship during sea battles.
text: 这是《海商王》的海战视图。<n>画面中显示着你的船，移动视野还可以看到那些被遗弃的船只。<n>现在解除暂停，用鼠标右键练习航行。海战时，事件窗口会显示风向和船只的朝向。

source: All ships engaged in the battle are displayed at the bottom of the screen. Here you can use which ammunition you want to use. Select the heavy cannonballs and sink one of the enemy ships.<n>You can fire with the left mouse button, but only when your ship is in a good firing position. Targets are then shown in red.
text: 所有参战船只都显示在屏幕底部，你也可以在这里选择弹药。请选择重型实心弹，击沉一艘敌船。<n>只有船只处于合适的射击位置时，才能用鼠标左键开火，此时目标会显示为红色。

source: Good! Board the second ship.<n>To do so, click on the “Board” button on the bottom right of the ship display.<n>Then move towards the enemy ship and ram it. Take note: The F1 button is also active during sea battles.
text: 很好！登上第二艘船。<n>先点击船只面板右下方的“接舷”按钮。<n>然后驶向敌船并撞上它。请注意：海战期间同样可以使用F1键。

source: Usually, the enemy has a crew and a battle ensues on board the ship between your crew and theirs.<n>When the battle is over, all of the ships that have been boarded fall to the victor.<n>Now add the enemy ship to your convoy and close the Transfer window .
text: 通常敌船上也有船员，你的船员会与他们展开接舷战。<n>战斗结束后，所有被登上的船都归胜利者所有。<n>现在把敌船编入你的船队，再关闭转移窗口。

source: Very good!<n>Now send your convoy back to Cartagena.
text: 很好！<n>现在派船队返回卡塔赫纳。

source: A convoy belonging to the pirate %1 has attacked a trader from %2.
text: 海盗%1的一支船队袭击了来自%2的商人。

source: First, buy a new ship. Go to the shipyard and buy a ship with as many cannons as possible.
text: 先买一艘新船。前往造船厂，挑选一艘尽可能多配火炮的船。

source: Select your convoy and then right-click on the harbor to add the new ship to the convoy.
text: 选中船队，然后右键点击港口，将新船编入船队。

source: All convoys consist of trading ships and escort ships.<n>If one ship in your convoy is to be involved in a battle, you must define it as a warship. <n>Open the list of ships in your convoy to display all your ships.
text: 所有船队都由商船和护航舰组成。<n>如果要让船队中的某艘船参加战斗，就必须将它设为战舰。<n>打开船队的船只列表，查看全部船只。

source: The Ships list displays all of the ships in your convoy. The warship status is displayed in the top right corner of a ship. If a cannon symbol is displayed, the ship is defined as a warship and it takes part in battles. Clicking on this corner changes the status directly.<n>But you should now click on your new ship and select it.
text: 船只列表显示船队中的全部船只。每艘船右上角都会显示其战舰状态。如果那里有火炮图标，就表示该船被设为战舰，将参加战斗。点击这个角落即可直接切换状态。<n>不过，现在请点击并选中你的新船。

source: The ship's technical details, such as its maximum load capacity, are displayed here as in the shipyard.<n>You can also see the daily cost of  maintaining the ship.<n>Now convert the ship into a warship by ticking the cannon symbol.
text: 这里与造船厂一样，会显示船只的技术数据，例如最大载货量。<n>你还可以查看这艘船每天的维护费用。<n>现在勾选火炮图标，将它设为战舰。

source: Well done!<n>Cannons and sailors are always divided equally among the escort ships in a convoy.<n>Ensure that your escort ships are fully armed and have a full crew, and then pay a visit to the governor and accept the new mission he assigns to you.
text: 干得好！<n>火炮和水手总会平均分配给船队中的护航船。<n>确保护航船武器齐备、船员满编，然后拜访总督，接受他的新任务。

source: Now accomplish the mission assigned to you by the Governor.
text: 现在去完成总督交给你的任务。

source: Select the ship that you want to control in the sea battle from among your escort ships.<n><n>You can select another escort ship at any stage by clicking on it in the list.<n><n>But beware: As soon as the battle starts, each ship can only be selected once!
text: 从护航船中选择你想在海战中操纵的船只。<n><n>你可以点击列表中的另一艘护航船，随时更换选择。<n><n>但请注意：战斗一旦开始，每艘船就只能被选择一次！

source: Well done! You have destroyed the pirate convoy.<n>Now return to the Governor of Cartagena because this is part of your mission.<n><n>Note that your missions are automatically recorded in your log. You can view the details of your mission there at any time if necessary.
text: 干得好！你消灭了海盗船队。<n>现在返回卡塔赫纳总督那里，这也是任务的一部分。<n><n>任务会自动记入日志，需要时可以随时查看详细要求。

source: I have the following mission for you.<n><n>
You could do me a favor.<n><n>
There is something you could do for me.<n><n>
Before the Governor assigns a new mission to you, make sure that your convoy is "shipshape"!<n>If your convoy is damaged, go to the shipyard and have it repaired.
text: 在总督给你新任务之前，先确保船队状态良好！<n>船队若有损伤，请到造船厂修理。

source: You have just received some money to help you make sure your convoy is better equipped.<n>Your convoy should have three fully-armed ships and a full crew.<n>Don't forget the ammunition, and remember to define your new ships as warships. Do this now.
text: 你刚获得一笔资金，用于改善船队装备。<n>船队应有三艘武器齐备、船员满编的船。<n>别忘了弹药，也记得把新船设为战船。现在就去办吧。

source: Excellent!<n>Now visit the Governor and accomplish the mission he assigns to you.
text: 太好了！<n>现在去拜访总督，完成他交给你的任务。

source: You are now going to raid a pirate hideout.<n>First, ensure that your convoy is "shipshape"!<n>You could visit some more governor towns to see if a larger ship is available in one of the shipyards.<n>Along the way, pay a visit to the governor and obtain some information on the pirate hideout.
text: 接下来，你将突袭一处海盗巢穴。<n>首先，确保船队已经整装待发！<n>你可以多去几座总督驻地，看看造船厂里有没有更大的船出售。<n>途中拜访总督，打听海盗巢穴的情报。

source: Port battles are similar to sea battles, except for the fact that the battle is between you and very solid cannon towers instead of other ships.<n>To win a port battle, you have to destroy all of the towers.<n>Sometimes there are armed ships in the harbor. In this case, you must fight the ships before you can attack the port itself.
text: 港口战与海战类似，只是对手不是船只，而是十分坚固的炮塔。<n>必须摧毁全部炮塔，才能赢得港口战。<n>有时港内会停泊武装船。遇到这种情况，必须先击败它们，才能进攻港口本身。

source: To end this scenario, return to Cartagena with your convoy.
text: 率领船队返回卡塔赫纳，即可结束本剧本。

source: The Governor of Cartagena believes you have great potential and makes you a gift of @g$Gold$.<n><n>Hint:<n>Purchase goods that are in plentiful supply in a town (the quantity must not be shown in red). Then sell these goods in a town where they are in short supply to ensure that you get a better price for them.<n><n>You will soon increase your wealth in this way.
text: 卡塔赫纳总督认为你前途无量，赠送了你@g$Gold$。<n><n>提示：<n>在某种货物供应充足的城镇购买它（数量不能显示为红色），再将其运到供应短缺的城镇出售，就能卖出更好的价钱。<n><n>这样很快就能增加你的财富。

source: %1,<n>what do you want from me? If you had sailed into town like a true seaman, I would have turned my cannons on you, as you are hostile to my nation.<n><n> But now that you are here, I must behave like a gentleman.
text: %1，<n>你找我有什么事？你与我国为敌，若是像个真正的水手那样驶入港口，我早就用大炮招呼你了。<n><n>不过，既然你已经到了这里，我就必须保持绅士风度。

source: Supply provisions to @T$TOWN$ until @D$EndDate$. The status of the town must not drop below "flourishing economy".
text: 持续向@T$TOWN$供应物资，直到@D$EndDate$。城镇的发展状况不得低于“经济兴盛”。

source: I have further important information for you concerning the war with %1.<n><n>
text: 关于与%1的战争，我还有重要情报告诉你。<n><n>

source: <n><n>Now it is time to strike back:
The pirate %1 has become more powerful.
Successful battles will boost your reputation more quickly with <o:0xFFFF2FAAD>5%<o>.
text: 战斗获胜时，声望增长额外提高<o:0xFFFF2FAAD>5%<o>。

source: I am glad to see you, @A$USER$, for I need your help. I once served under the pirate @P$PirateName$. However, I came to my senses and made a bargain with the Governor of @T$TargetTown$. Unfortunately, my former comrades have learned of this and have put a price on my head. Can you help me and take me to @T$TargetTown$?
text: 见到你真高兴，@A$USER$，我需要你的帮助。我曾在海盗@P$PirateName$手下效力，后来醒悟过来，与@T$TargetTown$总督达成了协议。可惜从前的同伙得知了此事，已经悬赏要我的人头。你能帮帮我，把我送到@T$TargetTown$吗？

source: I have heard that you can be trusted, @A$USER$. I am in the service of the Governor of @T$TargetTown$ and must see him urgently to give him some highly sensitive information. Unfortunately, certain parties are intent on preventing me from reaching @T$TargetTown$. For this reason, I am asking you whether you can grant me safe passage.
text: 听说你值得信赖，@A$USER$。我为@T$TargetTown$的总督效力，必须尽快见到他，传递一些高度机密的情报。可惜，有些人正竭力阻止我抵达@T$TargetTown$。因此，我想请你护送我安全到达。

source: Oh, I am plagued with misfortune. Several weeks ago, I came across a ship belonging to the notorious pirate @P$PirateName$. However, the captain of this ship must have been very inexperienced, as we managed to sink it almost without trying.<n>Unfortunately, this hapless captain turned out to be the beloved nephew of the pirate @P$PirateName$. Ever since he heard my name, he has been hunting me down. My crew have taken my ship and have fled in terror and now I am stranded here.<n>Can you help me to get to @T$TargetTown$, my home town?
text: 唉，我真是倒霉透顶。几周前，我遇到一艘属于臭名昭著的海盗@P$PirateName$的船。那艘船的船长肯定经验不足，我们几乎没费什么力气就把它击沉了。<n>不幸的是，这个倒霉船长竟是海盗@P$PirateName$最疼爱的侄子。他得知我的名字后，就一直追杀我。船员们吓得夺了我的船逃跑，把我困在了这里。<n>你能帮我回到家乡@T$TargetTown$吗？

source: After breaking through the harbor defenses, your convoy docks and the sailors set off to hunt for the pirate treasure. They are suddenly confronted by pirate %1, who challenges your captain to a duel.
text: 突破港口防御后，你的船队靠岸，水手们开始搜寻海盗的财宝。突然，海盗%1出现在他们面前，向你的船长提出决斗挑战。

source: Your new ship is in the harbor. Your basic crew is already on board.
text: 你的新船已在港口，基本船员也已登船。

source: Deliver @a$Amount$ of tools to the marketplace of @T$DestTown$ by @D$Date$ . You will receive @g$GoldPerBarrel$ for each <gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>.
text: 在@D$Date$之前向@T$DestTown$市场交付@a$Amount$工具。每<gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>可获得@g$GoldPerBarrel$。

source: Introductory Scenario<n><n>In Port Royale 2, you can build in any town in which you have a building permit. You always have permission to build in the town in which you start the game.<n:25>This scenario introduces you to construction and production. Your task is to construct several commercial and residential buildings. In the various steps in the scenario, you will have to find raw materials, settlers and workers.
text: 入门关卡<n><n>在《海商王2》中，只要拥有建筑许可证，你就能在相应城镇建设。游戏起始城镇始终允许你建造。<n:25>本关介绍建设与生产。你需要建造数座商业建筑和住宅，并在各个阶段筹集原材料、移民和工人。

source: I'm sorry, it turns out I can't give you this mission after all. I have just heard that the problem no longer exists.
text: 抱歉，看来我不能把这项任务交给你了。我刚听说，问题已经解决。

source: You don't have enough cash to settle your debts. As soon as you have %1, the sum will be collected.
text: 你没有足够现金偿还债务。等你攒够%1，这笔款项就会被收取。

source: A military convoy has tried, unsuccessfully, to attack the town by land.
text: 一支军事船队试图从陆路攻打城镇，但失败了。

source: Thank you for the punctual delivery! The feast will be announced right away and shall begin this very day!
text: 谢谢你准时交货！我马上宣布举办宴会，今天就开席！

source: %1's attitude towards you is now neutral.
Continue to defeat English military convoys until England's strength is rated as “weak”.
text: 继续击败英格兰军事船队，直到英格兰的实力被评为“弱”。
英格兰殖民地总督驻地
西班牙殖民地总督驻地

source: I've been waiting for you, %1. Where should the goods be brought to?
text: 我一直在等你，%1。货物该送到哪里？

source: There you are, %1. Have you enough storage space with you?
text: 你来了，%1。带了足够的装货空间吗？

source: Greetings, %1. I have something for you here.
text: 你好，%1。我这里有东西给你。

source: Unfortunately, a plague has broken out in Tortuga. It will rage in the town for about one month. The town's status falls considerably and its citizens are dying every day. Many citizens are terrified of the disease and are fleeing.<n><n>For you as a trader, it is also of interest that the demand for garments and wood is doubled in the town while the plague rages.<n><n>Your task now is to ensure that the town is supplied during the plague and to ensure that the number of citizens does not fall.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>The number of citizens (inhabitants minus soldiers) must be restored to @I$Pop$ by no later than 20 days after the end of the plague. This will ensure that all businesses have a full complement of workers.
text: 不幸的是，托尔图加爆发了瘟疫，将持续约一个月。城镇状态大幅下滑，每天都有居民死亡，许多人因恐惧疾病而逃离。<n><n>作为商人，你还应注意：瘟疫期间，城镇对服装和木材的需求会翻倍。<n><n>你现在的任务是在瘟疫期间保证城镇供给，并确保居民人数不减少。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>关卡目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>最迟在瘟疫结束后的20天内，把居民人数（总人口减去士兵）恢复到@I$Pop$，使所有产业都能拥有足够工人。

source: How do you want to attack?
the military presence in this town is excellent
text: 这座城镇的驻军十分强大

source: %1 %2 has destroyed the hideout of the pirate %3. Unfortunately, several ships have escaped. They will probably set up a new hideout.
text: %1%2摧毁了海盗%3的巢穴。可惜有几艘船逃脱了，它们很可能会建立新的巢穴。

source: %1 %2 has destroyed the hideout of the pirate %3. None of the ships managed to escape.
text: %1%2摧毁了海盗%3的巢穴，没有一艘船逃脱。

source: Are you sure you want to delete the route?
text: 确定要删除这条航线吗？

source: <n>Unfortunately, you have no space left in your convoy for this ship. Come back later.
text: <n>很遗憾，你的船队已经没有位置接纳这艘船。稍后再来吧。

source: <n><n>You are delighted to add the ship to your convoy.
text: <n><n>你欣喜地把这艘船编入船队。

source: It contained a new collection of ladies' fashion from Paris.
text: 里面装着一批巴黎最新款的女装。

source: It was used to store perfumed rose petals.
text: 它曾用来存放芳香的玫瑰花瓣。

source: It evidently contained a beautiful miniature dolls' teaset.
text: 里面显然装着一套精美的玩偶迷你茶具。

source: The chest contained pink soft toys.
text: 箱子里装着粉色毛绒玩具。

source: Apparently the chest contained a collection of lipsticks from Paris, among other things.
text: 看来箱子里除其他物品外，还装着一套来自巴黎的口红。

source: Apparently it was used to store brightly colored feather dusters.
text: 它似乎曾用来存放色彩鲜艳的羽毛掸子。

source: The chest contained several maids' uniforms.
text: 箱子里装着几套女仆制服。

source: The chest contains lots of useful things including whips, candles and powder compacts.
text: 箱子里装着许多有用的东西，包括鞭子、蜡烛和粉盒。

source: The chest contained unusual things including a Dutch kit for growing tulips.
text: 箱子里装着稀奇古怪的东西，包括一套荷兰郁金香栽培工具。

source: It was used to store long patent-leather boots and leather caps.
text: 它原来用来存放漆皮长靴和皮帽。

source: It was crammed full of raffia skirts and gents' moustache wax.
text: 里面塞满了拉菲草裙和男士胡须蜡。

source: The chest contained a general's uniform, an Indian costume, workers' garments and a leather suit.
text: 箱子里装着一套将军制服、一套印第安人服饰、几件工人衣服和一套皮衣。

source: It was crammed full of dolls and feather boas.
text: 里面塞满了玩偶和羽毛围巾。

source: The chest was used to store long French wigs.
text: 箱子里装的是长款法国假发。

source: The chest seems to have contained paintings of Spanish bullfighters.
text: 箱子里装的似乎是西班牙斗牛士的画像。

source: Apparently the chest contained, among other things, a box of mint cookies from England.
text: 看来箱子里的东西中，还有一盒来自英格兰的薄荷饼干。

source: It seems the chest had been used to tuck away some tigerprint pantyhose, silk pajamas and riding breeches.
text: 箱子里似乎藏过几条虎纹连裤袜、丝绸睡衣和马裤。

source: The chest was full of fluffy cushions.
text: 箱子里塞满了松软的靠垫。

source: It also contained berets with earmuffs.
text: 里面还装着带护耳的贝雷帽。

source: The main thing the chest contained was an embroidered cover for keeping baguettes warm.
text: 箱子里最显眼的东西，是一个给法棍面包保温用的绣花罩。

source: The most valuable thing in the chest was a long Scottish tartan skirt made of bearskin.
text: 箱子里最值钱的东西，是一条用熊皮做成的苏格兰格纹长裙。

source: In particular, the chest contained unusually large high-heeled shoes.
text: 箱子里尤其引人注目的，是几双大得出奇的高跟鞋。

source: The chest contained little ballet tutus and perfumed handkerchiefs.
text: 箱子里装着小巧的芭蕾舞裙和洒过香水的手帕。

source: The chest contained a particularly attractive pinafore with ribbons.
text: 箱子里装着一件缀有丝带、格外漂亮的围裙。

source: Well done! Your town has already grown a little.<n><n>As soon as your town has more than 1,000 inhabitants, it will be of interest to traders from other towns, who may come to trade their goods.<n><n>Traders usually visit a town if there is a demand in the town for a certain good, in other words, if there are some goods that are not available in your town.<n><n>You have just received a message about trade and production in your own town. To read it, open the log.<n><n>Your first objective is to increase the population of your town to 1,000.<n><n>Note: If a town is to have more than 500 inhabitants, it must have an inn!<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Increase the population of your town to 1,000.
text: 干得好！你的城镇已经有所发展。<n><n>人口一旦超过1,000，外地商人就会开始关注这里，可能前来做买卖。<n><n>商人通常会前往缺少某种商品、对其有需求的城镇。<n><n>你刚收到一条关于自有城镇贸易与生产的消息，打开日志即可阅读。<n><n>首先，把城镇人口增加到1,000。<n><n>注意：人口若要超过500，城镇必须有一家旅店！<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>关卡目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>把你的城镇人口增加到1,000。

source: You have delivered the goods and have been paid @g$Gold$ for them.
text: 你交付了货物，获得@g$Gold$报酬。

source: The town of @T$TargetTown$ now belongs to our nation and we have you to thank for this. The master builder in the town has therefore provided you with a building permit and several buildings in the town.
text: @T$TargetTown$如今已归我国所有，这全归功于你。因此，当地建筑师赠予你一张建筑许可证，以及城内的几座建筑。

source: There are problems in the following towns:<n>(Double-clicking on the town opens the town view)
name: IDPR_LOP_PROBLEMS
text: 以下城镇出现了问题：<n>（双击城镇可打开城镇视图）

source: A military convoy has attacked the town by land and looted goods. Many of the town's troops were killed and the status of the town has fallen.
text: 一支军事船队从陆地攻入城镇，劫掠了货物。许多守军阵亡，城镇的发展状态也下降了。

source: The owner, @N$OwnerName$, is aboard the convoy @C$Convoy$. Bring him to @T$TargetTown$ before @D$EndDate$.
text: 货主@N$OwnerName$正在@C$Convoy$船队上。请在@D$EndDate$之前把他送到@T$TargetTown$。

source: We are at war with %1, but the enemy does not have enough military convoys to protect its waters. I want you to take advantage of this and capture a town.
text: 我们正与%1交战，而敌方缺少足够的军事船队来保护海域。我希望你趁此机会攻占一座城镇。

source: %1 does not have enough military convoys to protect its waters! We should get going this instant and capture a town!!<n>Can I rely on you?
text: %1没有足够的军事船队保护海域！我们应该立刻出击，攻占一座城镇！<n>我可以指望你吗？

source: Excellent! You now have @g$Gold$.<n><n>Each nation has military convoys to defend its towns and protect the waters around them. The more towns a nation occupies, the more military convoys it needs to ensure they are adequately protected.<n><n>If a nation loses a military convoy, its military strength is weakened. Since military convoys are quite aggressive towards the enemy nation's towns and convoys during a war, a nation may lose a military convoy from time to time. For this reason, convoys are regularly sent from Europe to reinforce a nation’s military strength in the New World.<n><n>You can check a nation's strength under "Nations" in the Chronicle. If a nation is described as weak, its towns can be captured.<n><n>You should now defeat enough English military convoys to ensure that England's strength is rated as “weak”.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Defeat enough English military convoys to ensure that England is rated as “weak”.
text: 太好了！你现在拥有@g$Gold$。<n><n>每个国家都有军事船队，负责保卫城镇和周围海域。拥有的城镇越多，就需要越多军事船队才能提供充分保护。<n><n>失去军事船队会削弱国家军力。战争期间，军事船队经常积极进攻敌国城镇和船队，因此损失在所难免。为此，欧洲会定期派出增援船队，补充各国在新大陆的军事力量。<n><n>你可以在编年史的“国家”页面查看国家实力。若某国被评为“弱”，就可以夺取它的城镇。<n><n>现在，你应击败足够多的英格兰军事船队，使英格兰的实力降为“弱”。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>击败足够多的英格兰军事船队，使英格兰的实力降为“弱”。

source: Welcome, %1.<n><n>You already have a building permit and you may build in this town.
text: 欢迎，%1。<n><n>你已经拥有建筑许可证，可以在本城建造。

source: Stocks and 10-day consumption by citizens and businesses
text: 库存及居民与产业的十天消耗量

source: Save game error. Loading not possible.
We are at war with @n$HostileNation$ and I am itching to sabotage a town belonging to our enemies. Do you wish to help me cut the supply of goods to a town, in order to bring down its status?
text: 我们正在与@n$HostileNation$交战，我迫不及待地想让敌人的一座城镇吃点苦头。你愿意帮我切断它的货物供应，拖垮它的经济吗？

source: I am most eager to bring about economic ruin in one of the enemy’s towns. Why don't we blockade the access routes to a town belonging to @n$HostileNation$ until it has reached the status "Recession"?
text: 我非常希望让敌人的某座城镇陷入经济崩溃。我们不妨封锁@n$HostileNation$一座城镇的航道，直到它陷入“衰退”，如何？

source: You can now boost your reputation in %1 by attacking Dutch ships and towns. This will not diminish your reputation in the other nations.
text: 现在攻击荷兰的船只和城镇，可以提高你在%1的声望，且不会降低你在其他国家的声望。

source: Here's the gold. But please accept some advice: Don't spend it all at once!
text: 金币在这里。不过请听句劝：别一下子全花光！

source: Your time is up but you have not achieved the final scenario objective.<n><n>In free-play mode, the viceroy of any nation may grant you the gift of your own town. But this is not so easy to achieve, because you must always capture towns in order to be awarded a plot of land, and this will naturally damage your reputation with other nations. <n><n>Anything you have learned in this scenario about developing your town will help you to develop businesses in other towns also. The main difference is that you don't have to worry about defending those towns.
text: 时间已到，但你没能达成本剧本的最后一个目标。<n><n>在自由游戏模式中，任何国家的殖民地总督都可能赐给你自己的城镇。但这并不容易，因为要获得土地，你必须不断夺取城镇，而这自然会损害你与其他国家的关系。<n><n>你在本剧本中学到的城镇发展知识，同样有助于在其他城镇经营产业。主要区别在于，你不必操心那些城镇的防御。

source: Then I look forward to doing business with you.<n>Deliver as much @G$Goods$ as you can to the market in @T$TOWN$. I will also be receiving several deliveries there and I will pay you @g$Price$ immediately.<n>The expeditionary convoy will arrive here on @D$EndDate$. Guarantee this convoy safe passage to Europe and I will pay you the rest of the gold.
text: 那么，我期待与你合作。<n>尽量多把@G$Goods$运到@T$TOWN$市场。我会在那里分批收货，并立即支付@g$Price$。<n>远征船队将于@D$EndDate$抵达这里。确保它安全返回欧洲，我就付清余款。

source: In %1, a business owned by a local trader has been demolished.
text: %1的一位当地商人拆除了自己的一家企业。

source: Increase the population of your town to 1,000.
text: 将你的城镇人口增加到1,000。

source: Once the harbor defenses have been breached, your sailors disembark and storm into the town. They look for the treasure chamber without meeting any resistance and loot %1.<n><n>Now choose what goods you want to loot from the town's warehouse.
text: 港口防线被突破后，你的水手登陆并冲进城镇。他们毫无阻碍地找到了宝库，掠走了%1。<n><n>现在选择要从城镇仓库中掠走哪些货物。

source: There are currently no new ships for sale in the shipyard.
text: 造船厂目前没有新船出售。

source: The person who charged you with your task has had goods delivered to the market in @T$Town$.
text: 委托你任务的人已把货物送到@T$Town$市场。
Ascaron 英国有限公司董事总经理

source: Your ships inflict <o:0xFFF2FAAD>5%<o> more damage in sea battles if you command the battle yourself.
text: 亲自指挥海战时，您船只造成的伤害提高<o:0xFFF2FAAD>5%<o>。

source: There are not enough raw materials
Low level of wealth in the town
Costs have built up in the warehouse
No convoy available in the harbor

You have now learned some of the basic controls and know how to send a convoy from one town to another. This is very important, because at first you will make your living by transporting and trading goods between the towns.<n><n>In the second part of this scenario, you will buy a ship and add it to your existing convoy.<n><n>Here's another tip:<n><n>You can press F1 at any time during the game to display a help page explaining the keyboard and mouse configuration.<n><n><n><c><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Your convoy with two ships must reach the harbor of the town of Cartagena.
text: 你已经学会了一些基本操作，也知道如何把船队从一座城镇派往另一座。这很重要，因为一开始你将靠城镇之间的货物运输与贸易谋生。<n><n>在本关第二部分，你将购买一艘船，把它编入现有船队。<n><n>再给你一个提示：<n><n>游戏中随时按F1，都可以打开介绍键盘和鼠标操作的帮助页面。<n><n><n><c><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>关卡目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>让拥有两艘船的船队抵达卡塔赫纳港口。

source: You have received a Letter of Marque against Spain.
text: 你获得了针对西班牙的私掠许可证。

source: The game time is limited to one year in this demo.
text: 此试玩版的游戏时间仅限一年。

source: Nice work! The famine in Tortuga is over. It lasted @I$Days$ days.
text: 干得好！托尔图加的饥荒结束了，共持续了@I$Days$天。

source: In the full version of the game, you can attack towns from land or from the sea.
text: 在完整版游戏中，你可以从陆地或海上攻击城镇。

source: %1 %2 %3 tries his luck in the English town of %4.
%1 %2 %3 tries his luck in the French town of %4.
%1 %2 %3 tries his luck in the Dutch town of %4.
%1 %2 %3 tries his luck in the Spanish town of %4.
Thank you! The new troops will arrive in the next few days, as soon as there is enough room to accommodate them.
text: 谢谢！只要有足够的住宿空间，新部队将在未来几天内抵达。

source: All of your businesses are running smoothly.
name: IDPR_LOP_NO_PROBLEMS
text: 你的所有产业都在正常运作。

source: Piece of a treasure map found
Unable to delete trade route. <n>The file may be write-protected.
name: IDPR_AHS_NAME_DELETE_FAILED
text: 无法删除贸易航线。<n>文件可能受到写保护。

source: <n>I will pay you %1 per barrel of %2. You have %3 with you.<n><n>Would you like to give me the goods?
text: <n>每桶%2我付%1。你带来了%3。<n><n>愿意把货物交给我吗？

source: As the towns belonging to my nation do not produce enough, I was forced to rely on deliveries from English towns.
text: 由于我国城镇产量不足，我不得不依赖英格兰城镇的供货。

source: As the towns belonging to my nation do not produce enough, I was forced to rely on deliveries from French towns.
text: 由于我国城镇的产量不足，我不得不依靠法国城镇的供货。

source: As the towns belonging to my nation do not produce enough, I was forced to rely on deliveries from Dutch towns.
text: 由于我国城镇产量不足，我不得不依赖荷兰城镇的供货。

source: As the towns belonging to my nation do not produce enough, I was forced to rely on deliveries from Spanish towns.
text: 由于我国城镇产量不足，我只能依靠西班牙城镇供货。

source: The needle of this compass moves very freely and settles into position very quickly. You have never seen such an accurate compass.<n>The compass is wrought like a piece of jewelry and the underside is adorned with various engravings.
text: 这个罗盘的指针转动十分灵活，而且很快就能稳定下来。你从未见过如此准确的罗盘。<n>它制作得如同一件珠宝，底面装饰着各式雕刻。

source: The pair of compasses sits beautifully in your hand and is very easy to use. It seems to be made entirely of gold and is decorated with an intricate pattern.
text: 这把两脚规握在手里十分舒适，使用起来也很顺手。它似乎由纯金制成，表面饰有精美复杂的花纹。

source: This sextant gives an accurate bearing even in heavy seas. Parts of the sextant are mounted on springs, which helps to reduce any strong vibrations.
text: 这件六分仪即使在汹涌海面上也能准确测定方位。仪器的部分组件装在弹簧上，有助于减轻剧烈振动。

source: This instrument is a double spy-glass that allows you to see into the distance with both eyes simultaneously. You can slide colored glass over the lens to protect your eyes . A mysterious engraving is discernable on the side.
text: 这是一件双筒望远装置，可以同时用双眼眺望远方。镜片前能推入有色玻璃，保护眼睛。侧面隐约可见神秘的刻文。

source: This is an ordinary gold watch, but it is smaller than any you have ever seen. On a disc behind the face, you also notice a moon that seems to be slowly rotating. There are also some engravings on the back of the watch.
text: 这是一块普通金表，却比你见过的任何表都要小。表盘后的一块圆盘上还有一轮月亮，似乎在缓缓旋转。表背也刻有一些文字。

source: This lamp is similar to a normal lantern. However, lots of mirrors are arranged around the burning wick so that the light shines in one direction only. By using a device resembling a fan over the aperture, you can switch the light emitted on and off very quickly.
text: 这盏灯看着像普通提灯，不过灯芯四周装了许多镜子，使光线只朝一个方向射出。灯口还有个扇叶状装置，可以让射出的灯光快速明灭。

source: A ruler that can slide back and forth is set into another ruler. A sliding bracket made of transparent material is attached to this. You could use this device to carry out simple calculations very quickly.
text: 一把尺子嵌在另一把尺子里，可以来回滑动，上面还装着一个透明材料制成的滑框。用这个装置，应该能够很快完成简单的计算。

source: This strange device looks like an arrow. The vanes on it cause it to rotate as soon as you hold it in the water. A little dial counts each revolution, thus enabling you to calculate the ship's speed very accurately.
text: 这个奇怪的装置看起来像一支箭。把它放入水中，装在上面的叶片就会开始旋转。一个小表盘会记录转数，让你能够相当准确地算出船只的速度。

source: This instrument consists of rotating vanes and a dial that displays the rotational speed of the vanes. By holding the vanes in the wind, you can read the direction and speed of the wind. The instrument is meticulously crafted and marked with an unknown symbol.
text: 这件仪器由旋转叶片和显示叶片转速的刻度盘组成。将叶片迎向风，就可以读出风向和风速。仪器制作精巧，上面刻着一个不认识的符号。

source: Although this rope must have been exposed to seawater for some time, it looks as if it had just been made. It feels wonderfully smooth and ties very strong knots.
text: 这根绳索一定在海水中泡过很久，却依然像刚制成的一样。摸起来异常光滑，打出的绳结也十分牢固。

source: This folio contains a multitude of beautiful star charts. A large table specifies precisely when and where each individual star rises and falls.
text: 这本大开本书里有大量精美星图。一张大表格精确列出了每颗星辰升起与落下的时间和位置。

source: A round disk, finely engraved, into which various smaller round disks are set. You could use it to see which part of the starry sky is currently visible, depending on the date and time.<n>Markings on the disk show that this instrument was once used to determine a ship's position in a particular region.
text: 这是一块雕刻精细的圆盘，嵌着几个较小的圆盘。根据日期和时间，可以用它查看此刻可见的星空。<n>盘上的标记表明，这件仪器曾被用来确定船只在某片海域中的位置。

source: When you turn a handle, a large horn emits the dulcet tones of a woman singing. Just the thing for sailors at sea for weeks on end.
text: 转动把手，一只大喇叭里便会传出女子悦耳的歌声。对常年一连数周漂泊海上的水手来说，这可真是好东西。

source: A large piece of rounded glass is mounted on the end of a golden rod. If you hold it over a map, the finest lines are clearly visible even in poor light.
text: 一根金色杆子的一端装着一块巨大的弧形玻璃。把它悬在地图上方，即使光线昏暗，也能看清最细小的线条。

source: This small metal table is made of solid brass and is constructed in such a way that its surface always remains horizontal regardless of the pitch of the ship. The outer metal ring is engraved with markings that seem to indicate directions. However, you cannot identify the region in which the table was once used.
text: 这张小金属台由实心黄铜制成，结构精巧，无论船身如何俯仰，台面都能保持水平。外侧金属环刻着似乎表示方位的标记，但你无法辨认它曾在哪片地区使用。

source: A small box contains an ornate device that can be used to light a fire very easily. This box is covered in mysterious engravings.
text: 一只小盒子里装着精巧装置，能轻易点起火来。盒子表面刻满神秘的纹样。

source: This anchor is more decorative than practical. At best, it could be used to anchor a rowing boat.<n>It is very heavy for its size and is covered with intricate decorations and unknown lettering.
text: 这枚船锚的装饰价值大于实用价值，最多只能用来固定一艘划艇。<n>它虽然不大，却十分沉重，表面满是精巧的装饰和不认识的文字。

source: This device is like an oil lamp with its own flint. If you turn the small wheel, sparks fly onto a wick and can ignite a flame even in a strong wind.
text: 这个装置像一盏自带燧石的油灯。转动小轮子，火花便会飞向灯芯，即使刮着大风也能点燃火焰。

source: This horn is not sounded with your mouth, but by using a device that resembles a pump. If you press it down hard, the horn sounds louder than you would have believed possible.
text: 这只号角不是用嘴吹响，而是靠一种类似气泵的装置。用力按下去，号角发出的声音大得超乎想象。

source: This chart looks very different to the ordinary sea charts that are available. It is very detailed and has been drafted using several colors. However, you cannot identify which area is shown on the chart.
text: 这张海图与常见海图截然不同：绘制得非常精细，还使用了多种颜色。不过，你认不出图上画的是哪片区域。

source: The convoy cannot set sail because there are too many cannons on board. Sell some of your cannons or move them to your warehouse so you do not exceed the maximum number of cannons.
text: 船队无法出航，因为船上的火炮太多。请出售一些火炮，或将其转移到仓库，确保不超过火炮数量上限。

source: Call %1 points and lead the game
Your convoy has recovered from the sea a casket containing one of the governor's documents.
text: 你的船队从海中打捞起一个小匣子，里面装着总督的一份文件。

source: You have now taken all of the governor's documents on board. Take the documents to @T$TOWN$
text: 总督的全部文件都已装上船。请将文件送往@T$TOWN$。

source: %1,<n><n>You cannot purchase any permits because your reputation in my nation is not high enough and besides, you have not done enough for this town.<n><n>Increase your reputation in my nation and trade with my town to improve your trading record, and then we will speak again.
text: %1：<n><n>你在我国的声望不够，而且为本城做的贡献也不足，因此还不能购买许可证。<n><n>先提高你在我国的声望，多与本城贸易，改善交易记录，然后我们再谈。

source: %1,<n><n>Your reputation in my nation is not high enough, I'm afraid I cannot sell you any permits.<n><n>Come back when your reputation has improved.
text: %1，<n><n>你在我国的声望还不够高，恐怕我不能把许可证卖给你。<n><n>等声望提高了再来吧。

source: %1,<n><n>You have not done enough trade with this town. Deliver goods that are in demand to improve your trading record. Only then can you buy a permit.
text: %1，<n><n>你与本城的贸易还不够多。运来本城急需的货物，提高贸易贡献后，才能购买许可证。

source: Let %1 be your new town. You can now enter it just like any other town to erect buildings and set up businesses there.<n>The entire district is not yet available to you, but, if you capture additional towns, I will give you the land you need for this.
text: 就让%1成为你的新城镇吧。现在，你可以像进入其他城镇那样进入它，建造建筑、兴办企业。<n>你暂时还不能使用整个地区，但只要继续夺取城镇，我就会把所需的土地赐给你。

source: That's agreed then. Bring @a$Amount$ tools to @T$DestTown$. At the marketplace, you will get @g$GoldPerBarrel$ per <gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>. The goods must be delivered by @D$Date$.
text: 那就说定了。把@a$Amount$工具运到@T$DestTown$。在市场上，每<gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>可获得@g$GoldPerBarrel$。必须在@D$Date$之前交货。

source: So be it. Deliver @a$Amount$ to @T$DestTown$. The tools must arrive by @D$Date$.
text: 那就这么定了。向@T$DestTown$运送@a$Amount$工具，必须在@D$Date$之前送达。

source: Good! I am tasking you with procuring @a$Amount$ of tools. Deliver them by @D$Date$ to @T$DestTown$. You will be paid @g$GoldPerBarrel$ per <gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen> at the marketplace.
text: 很好！我交给你的任务是筹措@a$Amount$工具，并在@D$Date$之前送到@T$DestTown$。市场上每<gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>会付给你@g$GoldPerBarrel$。

source: In this scenario, you must help the Dutch colonies to acquire new towns.<n:25>You begin the scenario with a well-armed convoy and some starting capital. By capturing English trading ships, you'll immediately increase your wealth and will be able equip your convoy with more arms.<n:25>Later, your convoy will attack English military convoys to weaken England's defenses and will then be able to capture their towns.
text: 在本剧本中，你必须帮助荷兰殖民地夺取新的城镇。<n:25>开始时，你拥有一支装备精良的船队和一笔启动资金。夺取英格兰商船可以迅速增加财富，让你为船队添置更多武器。<n:25>之后，你的船队将攻击英格兰军事船队，削弱其防御力量，进而占领他们的城镇。

source: The number of soldiers will increased by %1 in the coming days, provided that sufficient living space is available.
text: 只要有足够住处，未来几天士兵数量就会增加%1。

source: Greetings, %1. Do you have the goods for the big wedding banquet with you?
text: 你好，%1。盛大婚宴所需的货物，你都带来了吗？

source: Today, the convoy of the English buccaneer %1 was destroyed by %2.
text: 今天，英格兰私掠者%1的船队被%2消灭。

source: Today, the convoy of the French buccaneer %1 was destroyed by %2.
text: 今天，法国私掠者%1的船队被%2消灭。

source: Today, the convoy of the Dutch buccaneer %1 was destroyed by %2.
text: 今天，荷兰私掠者%1的船队被%2消灭。

source: Today, the convoy of the Spanish buccaneer %1 was destroyed by %2.
text: 今天，西班牙私掠者%1的船队被%2消灭。
军事船队发现走私货物。

source: You ensured safe passage of the  transport convoy to Europe and I am indebted to you. I am therefore presenting you with a @S$ShipType$. She is waiting for you in the harbor.
text: 你护送运输船队平安抵达欧洲，我感激不尽。因此，我赠你一艘@S$ShipType$。它正在港口等你。

<ts:0><ts:110><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>鼠标左键<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>选择单位<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>鼠标右键<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>派遣单位<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>1..0<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>选择单位

source: You still need %1 to reach the next rank

It is 1676 in the Dutch governor town of the Turk Islands. Holland is in possession of seven towns, five of which are colonial towns, one a governor town and one a viceroy town.<n><n>England is in possession of 14 towns and has been at war with Holland for a long time and will continue to be for many months to come. As long as this war lasts, you must capture towns from the English Crown on behalf of Holland.<n><n>But before you can attack any English towns, you need more capital and more arms for your convoy. Your first objective is to defeat three English trading convoys and capture their ships.<n><n>First, though, you must obtain a Letter of Marque from the Dutch governor in the Turk Islands.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Pay a visit to the Governor of the Turk Islands and obtain a Letter of Marque against England.
text: 现在是1676年，你身处荷兰总督驻地特克斯群岛。荷兰拥有七座城镇，其中五座为普通殖民城镇，一座为总督驻地，一座为殖民地总督驻地。<n><n>英格兰拥有14座城镇，与荷兰的战争已经持续很久，而且还将延续数月。只要战争尚未结束，你就必须代表荷兰，夺取英格兰王室的城镇。<n><n>但在进攻英格兰城镇之前，你需要更多资金，也要为船队增添武装。你的第一个目标是击败三支英格兰商船队，并夺取它们的船只。<n><n>不过，首先你必须从特克斯群岛的荷兰总督那里取得私掠许可证。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>拜访特克斯群岛总督，取得一张针对英格兰的私掠许可证。

source: Very good! You have destroyed one of Blackbeard's pirate convoys. Now go to the Governor of @T$TOWN$ and collect your reward.<n><n>He also has another mission for you to accomplish.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Accomplish another mission for the Governor of @T$TOWN$.
text: 很好！你消灭了黑胡子的一支海盗船队。现在去找@T$TOWN$的总督，领取报酬。<n><n>他还有另一项任务要交给你。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>为@T$TOWN$总督再完成一项任务。

source: You must increase supplies of wheat, bricks, cotton, sugar and tobacco to @a$Amount$ each by @D$EndDate$.
text: 你必须在@D$EndDate$之前，将小麦、砖、棉花、糖和烟草的库存分别增加到@a$Amount$。

source: Ensure that your town has a supply of @a$Amount$ of all goods.
text: 确保你的城镇为每一种货物都储备@a$Amount$。

source: In the last scenario, you learned that your rank depends on your total assets. Your total assets comprise your cash as well as your buildings, ships and goods. You can check your total assets at any time under "Successes" in the log.<n><n>You can also check the blue bar indicating your experience, which is always at the bottom of the screen in the convoy display. When the bar reaches the right edge of the screen, you are promoted to the next rank. You cannot drop below a rank once you have reached it.<n><n>The higher your rank, the more convoys you can command and, therefore, the greater the number of towns in which you can establish businesses later. After you reach a certain rank, you are entitled to an unlimited number of convoys and building permits.
text: 在上一个剧本中，你已经了解到，等级取决于你的总资产。总资产包括现金，以及建筑、船只和货物的价值。你随时可以在日志的“成就”中查看总资产。<n><n>你也可以查看屏幕下方船队信息栏中的蓝色经验条。当它延伸到右端时，你就会晋升到下一个等级。一旦达到某个等级，就不会再降级。<n><n>等级越高，你能指挥的船队越多，今后可以开办产业的城镇数量也就越多。达到一定等级后，你能拥有的船队和建筑许可证数量将不再受限。

source: %1, so you are the %2 my father has told me so much of. I am %3. Will you not join me and tell me of your adventures?
text: %1，原来你就是父亲常提起的那位%2。我叫%3。愿意坐下来，给我讲讲你的冒险吗？

source: I believe I have already heard tell of you, %1. I am %3, the governor’s daughter. I always wanted to meet a %2. Please, do tell me of your adventures!
text: 我想我已经听说过你的事迹了，%1。我叫%3，是总督的女儿。我一直想结识一位%2。请跟我讲讲你的冒险吧！

source: So, you are the famous %1! I had imagined you as being much taller, from all the stories I've heard about you. But that doesn't make you any less interesting! Come over here and tell me of your adventures! I have already heard my father, the governor, talk so much about you.
text: 原来你就是大名鼎鼎的%1！听了那么多故事，我还以为你会更高大呢。不过，你依然很迷人！快过来讲讲你的冒险，总督父亲已经提起你好多次了。

source: %1,<n>I am so happy to see you again. Tell me how you've been since we last met. Did you bring something for me?
text: %1，<n>能再见到你真开心。快说说，我们分别之后你过得如何？给我带什么了吗？

source: %1,<n>it is lovely to see you again. I haven't stopped thinking of you since our last meeting. Come in quickly, I have a lot to tell you.
text: %1，<n>再次见到你真好。自上次分别后，我一直想着你。快进来，我有好多话要告诉你。

source: %1,<n>I am so happy you've come to visit me again. I've told all my friends of your adventures. But now you must tell me more, for the girls are longing for more information. Come in quickly.
text: %1，<n>你又来看我了，真让我高兴。我把你的冒险经历告诉了所有朋友。不过，你现在得再多讲一些，姑娘们都盼着听后续呢。快请进！

source: So we have a deal. Bring me @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$ to the market. I will wait for you there until @D$EndDate$. You must deliver the goods in a single delivery.
text: 那就说定了。请把@a$Amount$的@G$Goods$送到市场，我会在那里等到@D$EndDate$。必须一次交齐全部货物。

source: I have no other news for you. See me again when you've accomplished the mission I set you.
text: 我没有其他消息。完成我交给你的任务后，再来见我。

source: there are far too few soldiers in this town
text: 这座城镇的士兵严重不足

source: The %1 buccaneer %2 has contaminated large amounts of food in the town. A famine has broken out as a result. While the famine rages, the price of wheat, fruit, corn and meat will rise.
text: %1私掠者%2污染了城镇的大量食物，导致饥荒。饥荒持续期间，小麦、水果、玉米和肉的价格都会上涨。

source: Do you want to buy a Letter of Marque for %1 and hunt down the ships of our enemies in the name of Spain?
text: 你愿意花%1购买私掠许可证，以西班牙的名义追猎敌船吗？

source: Do you want to demolish this business?

In Tortuga, the town's stocks have been destroyed by saboteurs. Many of the town's supplies have been lost, and the quality of life for the town's citizens has fallen dramatically as a result.<n><n>Your objective is to replenish the town's supplies as quickly as possible so the town's status can rise again.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>The town must reach the status "boom" by @D$EndDate$.
text: 破坏者摧毁了托尔图加的库存。城镇损失了大量物资，居民生活质量因此急剧下降。<n><n>你的目标是尽快补充供应，让城镇的发展状态重新回升。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>关卡目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>在@D$EndDate$之前，让城镇达到“繁荣”状态。

source: <f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>Choose a building<n><n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res>Your first building in this town must be a warehouse
text: <f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>选择建筑<n><n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res>你在本城的第一座建筑必须是仓库

source: <g:INTEXT_SCHATZKISTE_800x600.screen><n>Using your treasure map, you have found treasure.<n>@g$Gold$

%1,<n>I would be pleased to sell you a permit to construct buildings in this town. However, at your rank, you may only have %2 building permits, and you already have that many.<n><n>Come back when you have a higher rank.
text: %1，<n>我很乐意卖给你本城的建筑许可证。不过，你目前的等级最多只能持有%2张，而你已经达到上限。<n><n>晋升后再来吧。

source: To change details, click on the town. Move and delete by dragging with your mouse.
text: 点击城镇可修改详细设置，拖动鼠标可移动或删除它。

<ts:0><ts:110><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>%1<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>编年史<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>%2<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>日志<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>%3<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>船队列表<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>CTRL<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>贸易窗口中的<n><t>交易单位数量<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>RMB<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>关闭对话框

source: I am faced with a small problem in @T$Town$. I promised my wife that I would see to it that a school was built there. Unfortunately, relations between myself and the master builder remain extremely hostile. He would never allow me to interfere in the affairs of his town. Could you not build the school for me?
text: 我在@T$Town$遇到一点麻烦。我答应妻子，要确保那里建起一所学校。可惜，我与当地建筑师的关系一直非常恶劣，他绝不会允许我插手城里的事情。你能替我建造学校吗？

source: I would like you to build a school in @T$Town$ in order to increase the wealth of the town. In fact, @T$Town$ means nothing to me, but my sister lives there and simply will not accept that there are better towns.
text: 我希望你在@T$Town$建造一所学校，提升城镇的富裕程度。其实我根本不在乎@T$Town$，可我姐姐住在那里，就是不肯承认别处的城镇更好。

source: The viceroy has instructed me to support the town of @T$Town$. I would therefore be happy to pay for a school in the town. However, the town council has rejected my offer, they don't want me interfering and would rather take the gold directly. Hence, I wanted to ask whether you could build the school.
text: 殖民地总督命我支援@T$Town$。我很愿意出资在当地建一所学校，但镇议会拒绝了我的提议。他们不希望我插手，宁可直接拿到金币。所以我想问问，你能否出面建造学校？

source: <f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res>Your captain is on the left. You control him as follows:<n> <n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>Attack<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n>To attack, left-click on part of your opponent’s body.
