Click on different parts of his body to increase your chances of scoring a hit.<n> <n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>Defend<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n>As soon at the opponent prepares to attack, you must click the right mouse button at the right time to ward off the attack.<n> <n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>Special attacks<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n>Press the left mouse button just before your captain has returned to the starting position after an attack.<n><n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>Endurance<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n>Each attack reduces your captain’s endurance, which recovers between attacks.<n><n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>Reaction time<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n>The more duels you have won, the faster you must react.
text: <f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res>左边是你的船长。操作方式如下：<n> <n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>攻击<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n>左键点击对手的身体部位进行攻击。变换攻击部位，可以提高命中的机会。<n> <n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>防御<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n>对手准备进攻时，把握时机点击鼠标右键，挡开攻击。<n> <n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>特殊攻击<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n>船长完成一次攻击、即将回到起始姿势时，按下鼠标左键。<n><n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>体力<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n>每次攻击都会消耗体力，攻击间歇则会恢复。<n><n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>反应时间<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n>赢得的决斗越多，你需要作出的反应就越快。

source: (list of towns changed, route was reset)
text: （城镇列表已变化，航线已重置）

source: %1,<n>we have known each other for so long now and my heart yearns for you to be mine alone. Will you not ask my father for my hand in marriage?
text: %1：<n>我们相识已经这么久，我多么盼望你只属于我。你愿不愿意向父亲请求，娶我为妻？

source: %1,<n>I need to talk to you about something. My father would dearly love nothing better than to choose a fine nobleman to wed his daughter. But my heart belongs to you. Will you not ask my father for my hand in marriage?
text: %1，<n>我有件事想和你说。父亲一心想为女儿挑选一位体面的贵族做丈夫，可我的心属于你。你愿意向父亲求婚，请他把我嫁给你吗？

source: %1,<n>my heart leaps for joy every time we meet. But my father is threatening to marry me off to some would-be nobleman. You are the only one who can save me from this fate. Will you not ask my father for my hand in marriage?
text: %1，<n>每次见到你，我的心都欢喜不已。可是父亲威胁说，要把我嫁给某个自命贵族的人。只有你能让我摆脱这个命运。你愿意向父亲求娶我吗？

source: The last feast was held quite recently. Come back and talk to me some other time.
text: 上一次宴会才刚办过不久。改天再来找我谈吧。

source: This is a good opportunity for us. A town belonging to @n$TargetNation$ wishes to align itself with our nation because it appears to be continuously beset with various conflicts. I want you to support the town until such time as it decides to change its nationality.
text: 这是我们的好机会。@n$TargetNation$的一座城镇长期饱受冲突困扰，希望归附我国。我希望你持续支援它，直到它决定改换国籍。

source: A problem has arisen regarding a town belonging to @n$TargetNation$. A written agreement setting out the peaceful handover of the town to our nation was signed long ago. Regrettably, @n$TargetNation$ is no longer honoring the agreement. I want you to support the town until such time as the disputes have been resolved.
text: @n$TargetNation$的一座城镇出了些问题。我们很早以前就签署了协议，约定和平移交这座城镇，可惜@n$TargetNation$如今不愿履约。我希望你在争议解决之前，持续支援这座城镇。

source: A town belonging to @n$TargetNation$ is in serious dispute with its viceroy. I know the reason why and I am now planning to support the town, so as to tempt it to side with us. You could help me do this.
text: @n$TargetNation$的一座城镇正与其殖民地总督发生严重争执。我知道其中的缘由，正计划支持这座城镇，吸引它归附我们。你可以帮我做这件事。
找到黑胡子的海盗巢穴。@l$IslandPos$

source: You have wreaked much destruction upon my nation, but you are also the only man who can save our fate. I will offer you our friendship for %1. What do you say?
text: 你给我国造成了惨重破坏，但也只有你能挽救我们的命运。支付%1，我就愿意与你修好。你意下如何？

source: I am %1. Are you interested in doing business? If you give me a convoy, I will share %2 of my booty with you. You can even tell me which waters you want me to operate in. You can hand me over any convoy with up to 5 ships.
text: 我是%1。想做笔生意吗？给我一支船队，我就分给你%2的战利品。你甚至可以指定我在哪片海域活动。你可以交给我任意一支不超过5艘船的船队。

source: Construct one cocoa production facility and one residential area in Santa Marta.
text: 在圣玛尔塔建造一处可可生产设施和一片住宅区。

source: Read and follow the hints in the Event window.
text: 阅读并遵循事件窗口中的提示。

source: The convoy finds your wife adrift on a raft. She has enjoyed the adventure but she now wants to return home to her powder boxes as soon as possible.
text: 船队发现你的妻子正乘着木筏漂流。她很享受这次冒险，不过现在只想尽快回家，回到那些脂粉盒旁边。

source: The convoy finds your wife adrift on a raft. She says that the pirates abandoned her, as the matter concerned only them and you.
text: 船队发现了你乘木筏漂流的妻子。她说，海盗认为这件事只关乎他们和你，于是把她抛下了。

source: At last, the convoy finds your wife, adrift at sea. She is unconscious, but she comes to after a while:<n>"This buffoon abducted me! He actually believed that I wanted to elope with him just because I smiled politely at him once or twice.“
text: 船队终于找到了漂流海上的妻子。她昏迷不醒，过了一阵才苏醒过来：<n>“那个蠢货绑架了我！我不过礼貌地朝他笑了一两次，他竟以为我想跟他私奔！”

source: You cannot finish the transfer because your convoy is overloaded. Remove some cargo from your convoy or add more ships.
text: 船队超载，无法完成调配。请卸下部分货物，或为船队增添船只。

source: Pay a visit to the Governor of Cartagena and accomplish his mission.
text: 拜访卡塔赫纳总督，完成他的任务。

source: Supply @T$TargetTown$ with goods. The town's status cannot fall below "Boom" before @D$EndDate$.
text: 向@T$TargetTown$供应商品。在@D$EndDate$之前，城镇状态不得低于“繁荣”。

source: You must put an end to the famine in Tortuga by @D$EndDate$.
text: 你必须在@D$EndDate$前结束托尔图加的饥荒。

source: You begin your career with <o:0xFFF2FAAD>%1<o> gold coins and a <o:0xFFF2FAAD>brig<o>(80 tons, max. 16 cannons)
text: 你将带着<o:0xFFF2FAAD>%1<o>金币和一艘<o:0xFFF2FAAD>双桅横帆船<o>开始生涯（80吨，最多16门炮）

source: Your warships fought valiantly but could not repel the attack.
text: 你的战船奋勇作战，却未能击退进攻。

source: The pirate %1 has become more powerful. He now has %2 ships.
text: 海盗%1的势力壮大了，现在拥有%2艘船。

source: Everyone has been given 5 cards. I'll call 1 point.<n><n>If you want to play, you must call one point higher.
text: 每人拿到五张牌。我叫一分。<n><n>如果你想主叫，就必须比我至少高一分。

source: You can now boost your reputation in %1 by attacking Spanish ships and towns. This will not diminish your reputation in the other nations.
text: 现在攻击西班牙的船只和城镇，可以提高你在%1的声望，且不会降低你在其他国家的声望。

source: Deliver @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$ to the market in @T$TOWN$ by @D$EndDate$. There, you will receive @g$Price$ per barrel.
text: 在@D$EndDate$之前，向@T$TOWN$市场交付@a$Amount$的@G$Goods$。每桶可获得@g$Price$。

source: You have not loaded the maximum cargo your ship can hold.<n>Are you sure you want to finish the transfer?
text: 你的船还没有装满货物。<n>确定要结束调配吗？

source: My thanks to you for destroying that pirate convoy. Here is a reward of @g$GoldReward$.<n>By the way: Whenever you accomplish a mission on my behalf, you automatically improve your reputation with my nation.<n>If, on the other hand, you have a low reputation with my nation, I'm afraid I cannot entrust any missions to you.
text: 感谢你消灭了那支海盗船队。这是@g$GoldReward$赏金。<n>顺便告诉你，每次完成我交给你的任务，你在我国的声望都会提高。<n>反过来，如果你在我国声望太低，我恐怕就不能把任务交给你了。

source: My thanks to you for destroying the pirate convoy. Here is a reward of @g$GoldReward$. If luck is on our side, we will soon discover the location of the pirate hideout. Then we can destroy it.
text: 感谢你消灭海盗船队。这是@g$GoldReward$赏金。若运气好，我们很快就能发现海盗巢穴的位置，再把它摧毁。

source: %1,<n><n>A loan of %2 was due on %3. The sum was collected today.<n><n>The treasurer of %4
name: ID_LETTER_AUTO_LOAN_PAYOFF_TEXT
text: %1：<n><n>一笔%2贷款于%3到期，今日已收取还款。<n><n>%4司库

source: You didn't manage to increase the population of Tortuga to @I$Pop$ by no later than 20 days after the end of the plague. <n><n>As soon as a town's status reaches "boom" or higher, new workers can be hired. You can supply the town with new workers in the form of settler families. These travel from Europe to the governor towns, where they wait for a passage to other towns. You'll also find settlers waiting to be picked up in towns with a lower status.
text: 瘟疫结束后20天内，你未能将托尔图加的人口恢复到@I$Pop$。<n><n>只要城镇的经济状况达到“繁荣”或更高水平，就可以雇用新工人。你可以运送移民家庭，为城镇补充劳动力。他们从欧洲来到总督驻地，等候前往其他城镇的船只。经济状况较差的城镇里，也会有移民等待接走。

source: <ts:75><ts:150><ts:225><ts:300>A plague of rats has destroyed food in your warehouses. Plagues of rats frequently occur if traders hoard too much food in their warehouses.<n><n>Losses:
text: <ts:75><ts:150><ts:225><ts:300>鼠患毁掉了您仓库中的食物。商人在仓库里囤积过多食物时，常会招来鼠患。<n><n>损失：

source: <n><n>You can usually hand back a building permit you have acquired. However, you cannot do so in this case because %1 is the town where you started the game.
text: <n><n>通常，你可以交回已取得的建筑许可证。但这里不行，因为%1是你开始游戏的城镇。

source: <n><n>A local trader offers you %1 for your permit and buildings. Do you want to accept the offer? Remember that you will then lose all of your buildings in this town.
text: <n><n>一位当地商人愿意出%1收购你的许可证和建筑。接受吗？请记住，你将失去在本城的全部建筑。

source: %1,<n>thank you for capturing one of our enemy's towns.
text: %1，<n>感谢你夺取了敌人的一座城镇。

source: %1,<n>I have already given you a mission. Accomplish this mission, as I have more for you to do.
text: %1，<n>我已经给了你一个任务。先完成它，我还有别的事要交给你。

source: %1,<n>your mission was to capture a town, but you have failed. I hope you will stick to our agreements next time.
text: %1：<n>你的任务是占领一座城镇，但你失败了。希望下次你能信守我们的约定。

source: Find and destroy a convoy belonging to the pirate @P$PirateName$ by @D$EndDate$. The last known position of one of his convoys is marked for you on the sea chart. @l$Pos$
text: 在@D$EndDate$之前，找到并消灭海盗@P$PirateName$的一支船队。海图上已标出其中一支船队最近出现的位置。@l$Pos$

source: @s$USER$, in Europe, @n$Nation$ is experiencing a shortage of @G$Goods$. I am therefore organizing an expedition to Europe. I will buy as much @G$Goods$ as you can supply and am prepared to offer you a unit price of @g$FullPrice$. Are you interested?
text: @s$USER$，欧洲的@n$Nation$目前缺少@G$Goods$，因此我正在组织一次赴欧航行。您能提供多少@G$Goods$，我就收购多少，愿意出每单位@g$FullPrice$。您有兴趣吗？

source: Greetings. I am organizing an expedition to Europe. I want to exploit the shortage of @G$Goods$ there. I am offering to buy as many goods as you can supply and I will give you a very good price per barrel, let's say @g$FullPrice$. Do we have a deal?
text: 你好。我正在组织一支前往欧洲的船队，想利用那里@G$Goods$短缺的机会做生意。你能供应多少，我就收多少，而且每桶都给你个好价钱，就定为@g$FullPrice$。成交吗？

source: Greetings to you, @s$USER$. I am organizing a convoy to Europe, for I have heard that @G$Goods$ is fetching a very high price. I am offering a unit price of @g$FullPrice$ to anyone who can deliver me @G$Goods$ . Do we have a deal?
text: 你好，@s$USER$。我正在组织船队前往欧洲，听说那里@G$Goods$的价格很高。谁能交给我@G$Goods$，我就按每份@g$FullPrice$收购。成交吗？

source: The %1 buccaneer %2 has attacked the town from land and has looted goods. Many of the town's troops were killed and the status of the town has fallen.
text: %1私掠者%2从陆地攻入城镇，劫掠了货物。许多守军阵亡，城镇的发展状态也下降了。

source: You have come across @I$Settlers$ shipwrecked settlers on a raft. Unfortunately, you do not have enough room for all of them on board your convoy. Return with another convoy.
text: 你在木筏上发现了@I$Settlers$名遇难移民。可惜船队没有足够空间容纳所有人，请换一支船队回来。

source: %1,<n>now it is my turn to meet you. You are a popular fellow in my nation, I had always hoped to meet you in person.
text: %1：<n>这回终于轮到我与你见面了。你在我国颇受欢迎，我一直盼着能亲自认识你。

source: Good. A contact person is waiting for you at the market in @T$TargetTown$. Deliver as much @G$Goods$ as you can get your hands on by @D$EndDate$. You will then be paid @g$Price$ for each barrel you deliver.
text: 好。联络人会在@T$TargetTown$的市场等你。请在@D$EndDate$之前，尽量多运来@G$Goods$，每桶可获得@g$Price$。

source: The %1 buccaneer %2 has destroyed the harbor defenses of the town and looted goods. The status of the town has also fallen.
text: %1私掠者%2摧毁了城镇的港口防御并劫走货物，城镇的经济状况也随之恶化。

source: The town is recovering from an attack.
text: 城镇正在从袭击中恢复。

source: Oh, look. I've just received a message from my courier. The mission I was about to give you is no longer valid. I must have left it sitting on my desk for too long!
text: 哦，瞧，我的信使刚送来消息。我正要交给你的任务已经失效了，想必是搁在书桌上太久！

source: Now it’s time to find Blackbeard’s pirate hideout and put an end to his dastardly deeds.  Once a pirate has been at large for a while, it will only be a matter of time until his hideout is discovered. But you can also do something to influence this: From time to time, a pirate convoy will return to its hideout to drop off loot and make any necessary repairs.<n>If you follow one of these pirate convoys on the sea chart and watch as it disappears into its hideout, it is very likely that you'll discover the location of the hideout. Once you have discovered the hideout, you can destroy it by attacking it from the sea in the same way you attack a town.<n><n>Hint:<n> @l$IslandPos$ Wait until a convoy approaches and observe it as it disappears into its hideout.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Locate Blackbeard's hideout.
text: 现在该找到黑胡子的海盗巢穴，终结他的恶行了。海盗逍遥一段时间后，巢穴迟早会被发现。不过你也可以主动促成此事：海盗船队会不时返回巢穴卸下赃物、修理船只。<n>若在海图上跟踪一支海盗船队，观察它消失在哪里，就很可能找到巢穴。发现后，可以像从海上攻击城镇一样，将巢穴摧毁。<n><n>提示：<n>@l$IslandPos$ 等船队靠近，留意它返回巢穴时消失的位置。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>关卡目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>找到黑胡子的巢穴。

source: You have not yet returned my ship? Please tie it up in the harbor as soon as you find it and then come back to me.
text: 您还没把我的船带回来吗？找到后请尽快将它停在港内，再回来找我。

source: You do not have a convoy in the harbor.
An English military convoy is attacking
text: 一支英格兰军事船队正在进攻

source: A French military convoy is attacking
text: 一支法国军事船队正在进攻

source: A Dutch military convoy is attacking
text: 一支荷兰军事船队正在进攻

source: A Spanish military convoy is attacking
text: 一支西班牙军事船队正在进攻

source: You didn't accomplish the mission assigned to you by the Governor, which means the scenario objective is not achieved.
text: 你没有完成总督交给你的任务，因此也未能达成关卡目标。

source: You have no damaged ships or convoys in the harbor.
text: 港口里没有需要修理的己方船只或船队。

source: Excellent! You increased supplies of the goods that could be produced and put an end to the strike in Tortuga within @I$Days$ days.
text: 太好了！你增加了本地可生产货物的供应，在@I$Days$天内平息了托尔图加的罢工。

source: Our current enemy, @n$HostileNation$, has attacked our transport convoys and looted the imported goods that were intended for the English towns in the New World.
text: 我们现在的敌人@n$HostileNation$袭击了运输船队，抢走原本运往新大陆英格兰城镇的进口商品。

source: Our current enemy, @n$HostileNation$, has attacked our transport convoys and looted the imported goods that were intended for the French towns in the New World.
text: 我们目前的敌人@n$HostileNation$袭击了运输船队，劫走了原本要送往新世界法国城镇的进口货物。

source: Our current enemy, @n$HostileNation$, has attacked our transport convoys and looted the imported goods that were intended for the Dutch towns in the New World.
text: 我们目前的敌国@n$HostileNation$袭击了我国的运输船队，抢走了原本要送往新世界荷兰城镇的进口商品。

source: Our current enemy, @n$HostileNation$, has attacked our transport convoys and looted the imported goods that were intended for the Spanish towns in the New World.
text: 我们目前的敌国@n$HostileNation$袭击了我国的运输船队，抢走了原本要送往新世界西班牙城镇的进口商品。

source: Pay a visit to the Governor of the Turk Islands and obtain a Letter of Marque against England.
text: 拜访特克斯群岛的总督，取得一张针对英格兰的私掠许可证。

source: You have neither a ship nor a convoy in the town
text: 你在本城没有船只或船队

source: Today, the %1 buccaneer %2  tried to storm the town. However, the attack was successfully repulsed.
text: 今天，%1私掠者%2试图强攻城镇，但进攻被成功击退。

source: Deliver %2 each of wheat, fruit, meat, rum and wine for the wedding banquet with %3 to the market of %4 by %1.
text: 为筹备你与%3的婚宴，请在%1之前向%4市场交付小麦、水果、肉、朗姆酒和葡萄酒各%2。

source: %1 cannot be assigned because it is already being used by a different function.
text: 无法分配%1，因为该按键已被其他功能占用。

source: <g:INTEXT_SCHIFFBRUECHIGER_800x600.screen><n>You have rescued a castaway from @n$DestNation$. @N$Name$ offers you a large reward if you put him ashore at the next town belonging to his nation.
text: <g:INTEXT_SCHIFFBRUECHIGER_800x600.screen><n>你救起了一名来自@n$DestNation$的落难者。@N$Name$表示，只要你让他在最近的本国城镇上岸，就会给予你丰厚的报酬。

source: <g:INTEXT_SCHIFFBRUECHIGER_800x600.screen><n>You have rescued the trader @N$Name$ from @T$DestTown$. He promises you a large reward if you return him to his hometown.
text: <g:INTEXT_SCHIFFBRUECHIGER_800x600.screen><n>你救起了来自@T$DestTown$的商人@N$Name$。他承诺，只要把他送回家乡，就会给予丰厚报酬。

source: <g:INTEXT_SCHIFFBRUECHIGER_800x600.screen><n>You have rescued the very experienced captain @N$Name$. He asks to be put ashore at a town belonging to @n$DestNation$.
text: <g:INTEXT_SCHIFFBRUECHIGER_800x600.screen><n>你救起了经验丰富的船长@N$Name$。他希望你把他送到@n$DestNation$所属的城镇上岸。

source: <g:INTEXT_SCHIFFBRUECHIGER_800x600.screen><n>You have picked up @I$Sailors$ shipwrecked sailors, who appear to be acquainted with some of the crew. The welcome party raises the morale of the crew.
text: <g:INTEXT_SCHIFFBRUECHIGER_800x600.screen><n>你救起了@I$Sailors$名遇难水手，他们似乎认识船上的一些人。欢迎他们的聚会提高了船员士气。

source: <g:INTEXT_SCHIFFBRUECHIGER_800x600.screen><n>You have picked up a sailor from @n$Nation$. To thank you for rescuing him, he tells you where you can find many barrels of valuable debris. @l$DebrisPos$
text: <g:INTEXT_SCHIFFBRUECHIGER_800x600.screen><n>你救起了一名来自@n$Nation$的水手。为了感谢救命之恩，他告诉你哪里漂着许多桶有价值的货物。@l$DebrisPos$

source: <g:INTEXT_SCHIFFBRUECHIGER_800x600.screen><n>You have rescued a priest from @n$DestNation$. He cannot pay you to take him to a town belonging to his nation, but he promises to intervene on your behalf in order to improve your reputation in @n$DestNation$.
text: <g:INTEXT_SCHIFFBRUECHIGER_800x600.screen><n>你救起了一位来自@n$DestNation$的神父。他付不起前往本国城镇的船费，但答应替你说好话，提高你在@n$DestNation$的声望。

source: Do you want to buy a Letter of Marque for %1 and hunt down the ships of our enemies in the name of Holland?
text: 您愿意花%1购买私掠许可证，以荷兰的名义追捕我国敌人的船只吗？

source: There is a plague of rats in %1. The consumption of wheat, fruit, corn and meat is twice as high for one month.
text: %1发生鼠灾。在接下来的一个月里，小麦、水果、玉米和肉类的消耗量将翻倍。

source: You have not delivered the goods on time.

You need tools to produce colonial goods. In the same way, you need raw materials to produce finished goods. Finished goods include rope and cloth, for example. The raw materials for these are hemp and cotton.<n><n>Now that you know how to build production facilities, you should purchase a building permit in a governor town and build facilities there for producing finished goods. However, before you can purchase a building permit, you must have established a proven trading record with the town, which means that you must sell goods to the town when they are in scarce supply.<n><n>But be careful! If you buy up scarce goods in a town, this has a negative effect on your trading record with the town! Goods that are scarce in a town are displayed in red in the Trade window.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Improve your trading record in Cartagena so that you can purchase a building permit there.
text: 生产殖民地货物需要工具。同样，生产制成品也需要原材料。例如，绳索和布匹都属于制成品，分别需要大麻和棉花作为原材料。<n><n>既然你已经学会建造生产设施，就应在一座总督驻地购买建筑许可证，并在那里建造生产制成品的设施。不过，购买建筑许可证之前，你必须先在城镇中积累良好的贸易表现，也就是向城镇出售当地短缺的货物。<n><n>但要小心！买走城镇短缺的货物，会对你的当地贸易表现产生负面影响。短缺货物会在贸易窗口中以红色显示。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>改善你在卡塔赫纳的贸易表现，直到能够在那里购买建筑许可证。

source: You can only enter a trade route if the captain of the convoy has %1 experience points. He currently has %2 points.
text: 船队船长至少拥有%1点经验，才能设置贸易航线。他目前只有%2点。

source: Thank you. It looks as though we shall not be receiving any imported goods from Europe in the near future. As we are currently at war with @n$HostileNation$, we have the opportunity of looting goods from the transport convoys of our enemies, without capturing or sinking their ships.<n>Please procure @a$Amount$ of each of the goods spices, wine and tools and deliver them to my trader at the market by @D$EndDate$.
text: 谢谢你。看来近期我们都收不到欧洲的进口商品了。既然我们正与@n$HostileNation$交战，就可以从敌方运输船队那里抢夺货物，但不要俘获或击沉他们的船。<n>请取得香料、葡萄酒和工具各@a$Amount$，并于@D$EndDate$之前交给市场上我的商人。

source: Your mission is to attack and loot transport convoys belonging to @n$HostileNation$, without capturing or sinking their ships. You must then deliver the goods to the market. You have until @D$EndDate$.
text: 你的任务是袭击并劫掠@n$HostileNation$的运输船队，但不得俘获或击沉其船只。之后把货物交到市场。期限为@D$EndDate$。

source: So be it. Go in search of transport convoys belonging to @n$HostileNation$ and loot @a$Amount$ of the imported goods on board. You then have until @D$EndDate$ to hand over the goods to a trader, who will be waiting for you at the market. A word of advice: Due to the very tense situation that presently exists in the region, you may only loot the ships and must neither capture nor sink them!
text: 就这么办。寻找@n$HostileNation$的运输船队，劫掠船上@a$Amount$进口商品。然后在@D$EndDate$前，把货物交给在市场等候的商人。提醒你：目前当地局势极度紧张，你只能劫掠船只，绝不能俘获或击沉它们！

source: My dear %1,<n>perhaps I can help you with a loan so you can assist us in developing this town. What amount did you have in mind?
text: 亲爱的%1，<n>或许我能提供一笔贷款，帮助您参与本城的建设。您打算借多少？

source: %1 has looted the legendary Spanish treasure fleet.
text: %1劫掠了传说中的西班牙宝船队。

source: A local trader is prepared to pay you %1 for the residential area.
text: 一位当地商人愿意出%1购买这片住宅区。

source: I'm glad to see you, @A$USER$. I lost a package on my way here. Could you find it for me?
text: 很高兴见到你，@A$USER$。我在来这里的路上丢了一个包裹。你能帮我找回来吗？

source: Greetings! Do you own a ship? I lost mine in a recent storm. Fortunately, I was able to save myself, but I lost my chest containing many of my most precious personal effects. Could you set sail and see whether my chest is still floating around somewhere at sea? I will reward you handsomely, for the chest is very valuable to me.
text: 您好！您有船吗？前些日子的一场风暴夺走了我的船。幸好我保住了性命，却丢失了装着许多珍贵私人物品的箱子。您能出海找找，看它是否还漂在什么地方吗？那箱子对我意义重大，我一定重重酬谢。

source: Our donation coffers are filled to the brim. Drop by again in a few weeks' time.
text: 我们的捐款箱已经装得满满当当。过几周再来吧。

source: Supply the town of @T$TargetTown$, which belongs to @n$TargetNation$, with goods so that the town attains the status "Flourishing economy" and has more than 2,000 inhabitants by @D$EndDate$.
text: 向@n$TargetNation$所属的@T$TargetTown$供应商品，使其在@D$EndDate$之前达到“经济兴盛”状态，人口超过2,000。

source: Congratulations! You have successfully completed the scenario and have captured several English towns on behalf of Holland.<n><n>You can capture towns in the same way in free-play mode. But remember to ensure that the nation whose towns you want to capture must be militarily weak. In addition, the nation for which you want to capture towns must be militarily weak and the two nations in question must be at war.<n><n>Note: You are usually rewarded with a plot of land on which you can build your own towns when you capture towns for a viceroy. However, this feature is deactivated in this scenario.
text: 恭喜！你成功完成了剧本，并代表荷兰夺取了几座英格兰城镇。<n><n>在自由游戏中，你也可以用同样的方式占领城镇。但请记住：你想要攻占的城镇所属国家必须军力薄弱。此外，你为之夺城的国家必须军力强盛，而且这两个国家必须正在交战。<n><n>注意：替殖民地总督夺取城镇，通常会获得一块土地作为奖赏，你可以在上面建立自己的城镇。不过，本剧本禁用了这一功能。

source: Press a new key to change.

Blackbeard has discovered that you are collaborating with the Governor of @T$TOWN$.  He has therefore begun to terrorize the traders who visit @T$TOWN$.  Within a few days, hardly any traders will dare to come to @T$TOWN$. <n><n>This is only a temporary tactic. Your task is to supply the town with goods until @D$EndDate$. The status of the town must not drop below "flourishing economy".<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Supply @T$TOWN$ with goods until @D$EndDate$. The status of the town must not drop below "flourishing economy".
text: 黑胡子发现你正在与@T$TOWN$总督合作，因此开始恐吓前往@T$TOWN$的商人。再过几天，几乎就没人敢来@T$TOWN$了。<n><n>这只是他的临时手段。你的任务是持续向城镇供货，直到@D$EndDate$。城镇经济状况不得低于“经济兴盛”。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>持续向@T$TOWN$供货，直到@D$EndDate$。城镇经济状况不得低于“经济兴盛”。

source: Click on the ships and move them using the mouse
text: 点击船只，用鼠标移动它们

source: Battle against pirates, buccaneers and military convoys from enemy nations.<n><n>Try your hand at hunting down trading convoys as a buccaneer.<n><n>Set off in search of the legendary Spanish treasure fleet.<n><n>Command 16 different types of ship.
text: 迎战海盗、私掠者和敌国军事船队。<n><n>化身私掠者，尝试追猎贸易船队。<n><n>启程寻找传说中的西班牙宝船队。<n><n>指挥16种不同类型的船只。

source: Guide your captain through duels with  other captains and pirates.<n><n>Accomplish countless missions involving battles, trade and politics.
text: 指挥您的船长，与其他船长和海盗展开决斗。<n><n>完成涉及战斗、贸易和政治的众多任务。

source: Visit towns in 4 different nations with different sets of buildings<n><n:10>Enjoy a rich variety of graphics as you move through different landscapes.<n><n:10>Loot and capture towns for your favorite nation<n><n:10>Build your own towns<n><n:10>Buy businesses from other traders and establish monopolies on goods<n><n:10><o:0xFFFFEB7D>...take the whole of the Caribbean by storm!
text: 走访四个国家的城镇，欣赏各具特色的建筑<n><n:10>穿行于不同地貌，领略丰富多彩的画面<n><n:10>为你支持的国家劫掠并攻占城镇<n><n:10>建设属于自己的城镇<n><n:10>收购其他商人的产业，垄断商品市场<n><n:10><o:0xFFFFEB7D>……让整个加勒比海因你而沸腾！

source: Good! Now be on your way and destroy one of Blackbeard's pirate convoys. First, though, you must reinforce your convoy.
text: 很好！去消灭黑胡子的一支海盗船队吧。不过在此之前，先增强你的船队实力。
我们需要的东西已经齐全了。

source: Read and follow the hints in the Event window.
text: 阅读并遵循事件窗口中的提示。

source: Today, the English buccaneer %1 encountered a French military convoy and was killed.
text: 今天，英格兰私掠者%1遭遇法国军事船队并被击杀。

source: Today, the English buccaneer %1 encountered a Dutch military convoy and was killed.
text: 今天，英格兰私掠者%1遭遇荷兰军事船队并被击杀。

source: Today, the English buccaneer %1 encountered a Spanish military convoy and was killed.
text: 今天，英格兰私掠者%1遭遇西班牙军事船队，战死海上。

source: The Graphics card does not meet the minimum system requirements for the game (DirectX 8 functions). This may cause problems under certain circumstances!
text: 显卡不符合游戏的最低系统要求（DirectX 8功能），某些情况下可能出现问题！

source: Today, the French buccaneer %1 encountered an English military convoy and was killed.
text: 今天，法国私掠者%1遭遇一支英格兰军事船队，并被击毙。

source: Today, the French buccaneer %1 encountered a Dutch military convoy and was killed.
text: 今天，法国私掠者%1遭遇荷兰军事船队，被击毙了。

source: Today, the French buccaneer %1 encountered a Spanish military convoy and was killed.
text: 今天，法国私掠者%1遭遇西班牙军事船队，战死海上。

source: Today, the Dutch buccaneer %1 encountered an English military convoy and was killed.
text: 今天，荷兰私掠者%1遭遇英格兰军事船队，被击毙了。

source: Today, the Dutch buccaneer %1 encountered a French military convoy and was killed.
text: 今天，荷兰私掠者%1遭遇法国军事船队，战死海上。

source: Today, the Dutch buccaneer %1 encountered a Spanish military convoy and was killed.
text: 今天，荷兰私掠者%1遭遇西班牙军事船队并被击杀。

source: As you know, we are at war. To weaken @n$TargetNation$'s economy, I want you to capture or sink @I$NumShips$ trading ships. Do you accept this mission?
text: 你知道，我们正在交战。为了削弱@n$TargetNation$的经济，我希望你俘获或击沉@I$NumShips$艘商船。你接受这项任务吗？

source: We are at war with @n$TargetNation$. I therefore want you to sink or capture a specific number of trading ships. Everything you loot from them is yours to keep, all I care about is weakening @n$TargetNation$'s economy. Can I count you on board?
text: 我们正在与@n$TargetNation$交战。因此，我希望你击沉或夺取一定数量的商船。劫到的东西全归你，我只关心如何削弱@n$TargetNation$的经济。你愿意加入吗？

source: I was wondering if you might be able to help us in our war against @n$TargetNation$. I would like to send you into a particular area and task you with capturing or sinking ships there.
text: 我想知道，你是否愿意帮助我们对抗@n$TargetNation$。我想派你前往指定区域，夺取或击沉那里的船只。

source: Holland and England have made peace, so you can no longer capture any towns.<n><n>You got quite far in this scenario but you didn't have time to capture enough towns on behalf of Holland.<n><n>You can capture towns in the same way in free-play mode. However, you must first be sure that the nation whose towns you want to capture is militarily weak. In addition, the nation that wants to capture these towns must be militarily strong and the two nations must be at war with one another.<n><n>Note: You are usually awarded a plot of land on which you can establish your own towns whenever you capture towns for a viceroy. However, this feature is deactivated in this scenario.
text: 荷兰与英格兰已经停战，你不能再夺取城镇了。<n><n>你在本剧本中已取得不小进展，但未能及时替荷兰夺取足够多的城镇。<n><n>自由游戏中也可以用同样的方式夺城。不过，必须先确保目标国家军力薄弱，而想夺取这些城镇的国家军力强盛，且双方正在交战。<n><n>注意：替殖民地总督夺取城镇，通常会获得土地，可以在上面建立自己的城镇。不过，本剧本禁用了这一功能。

source: You can now boost your reputation in %1 by attacking English ships and towns. This will not diminish your reputation in the other nations.
text: 现在攻击英格兰的船只和城镇，可以提高你在%1的声望，且不会降低你在其他国家的声望。

source: Today, the Spanish buccaneer %1 encountered an English military convoy and was killed.
text: 今天，西班牙私掠者%1遭遇英格兰军事船队，被击毙了。

source: Today, the Spanish buccaneer %1 encountered a French military convoy and was killed.
text: 今天，西班牙私掠者%1遭遇法国军事船队并被击杀。

source: Today, the Spanish buccaneer %1 encountered a Dutch military convoy and was killed.
text: 今天，西班牙私掠者%1遭遇荷兰军事船队，战死海上。

source: The convoy of pirate %1 has been destroyed.
The Spanish treasure fleet has moored in the town of %1
text: 西班牙运宝船队已停靠在%1。

source: %1 is waiting for you at the marketplace.

It is the year 1570 and we find ourselves in the Caribbean. Your objective is to rise from being a humble trader to become an influential businessman. To help you achieve the status you seek, you can transport goods as well as trade, build, and engage in politics and piracy.<n><n>The following scenario will teach you the basics of how to play the game. As with the other scenarios, this involves several different objectives. You must achieve all of your objectives to successfully complete the scenario.<n><n>You can now close this window using the Close button and refer to the Event window in the bottom-left of your screen.<n><n><n><c><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Follow the instructions in the Event window.
text: 时间是1570年，我们正身处加勒比海。你的目标是从一名默默无闻的商贩，成长为有影响力的商业巨头。为了实现抱负，你可以运输货物、开展贸易、兴建产业，也可以投身政治和海盗活动。<n><n>接下来的剧本将教会你游戏的基本玩法。与其他剧本一样，其中包含若干不同目标。你必须达成所有目标，才能成功完成剧本。<n><n>现在可以点击关闭按钮关掉这个窗口，然后查看屏幕左下角的事件窗口。<n><n><n><c><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>按照事件窗口中的指示行动。

source: The hideout of the pirate %1 has been discovered. Which heroic adventurer dares to attack and destroy the hideout?
text: 海盗%1的巢穴被发现了。哪位英勇的冒险家敢去攻打并摧毁它？

source: Strange things are happening in Tortuga. Due to a number of events that have happened in the past, hardly a single trader dares set foot in the town. Your task is to support Tortuga as best you can by supplying goods.<n><n>But your starting capital is not exactly spectacular. You have @g$StartGold$ cash available. Nonetheless, you have a well-equipped trading convoy in the harbor and some stores of goods.<n><n>Your first objective is to increase your cash to @g$GoldGoal$. Complete this task as fast as possible, but you cannot take longer than 40 days.<n><n>A word of advice: Under no circumstances should you sell your ships. However, you can take out loans.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Increase your cash to @g$GoldGoal$ by @D$EndDate$.
text: 托尔图加接连发生怪事。由于此前的一系列事件，几乎没有商人敢踏入这座城镇。你的任务是尽可能为托尔图加运送货物，帮助它渡过难关。<n><n>你的启动资金并不丰厚，手头只有@g$StartGold$。不过，港口里有一支装备齐全的贸易船队，还有一些库存货物。<n><n>你的首个目标是将现金增加到@g$GoldGoal$。尽快完成任务，最迟不能超过40天。<n><n>忠告：无论如何都不要出售船只，但你可以贷款。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>在@D$EndDate$前，将现金增加到@g$GoldGoal$。

source: You are back in the harbor of Cartagena and your convoy, the "Santa Maria", is selected.<n>As you can see, the convoy already has some goods: cotton, meat and cocoa.<n>Now find the docks in the harbor and click on them, because you want to sell the goods.
text: 你回到了卡塔赫纳港，当前选中的是你的“Santa Maria”船队。<n>可以看到，船队已经装有一些货物：棉花、肉类和可可。<n>现在找到并点击港口码头，准备出售这些货物。

source: At the docks, you can trade both between the town and your warehouse and between the town and your convoy.<n>You can now see what goods the town has and what goods your convoy has. Use the arrows to buy and sell (the prices are shown on the arrows).<n>Now sell your cotton.
text: 在码头，你既能让城镇与仓库交易，也能让城镇与船队交易。<n>现在可以看到城镇和船队各自拥有的货物。使用箭头买卖，价格就显示在箭头上。<n>现在卖掉你的棉花。

source: You may have noticed how the price of cotton fell when you sold some.<n>This is because the price is determined by the supply and demand in the town.<n>Selling the goods satisfies the demand and the price falls. If you buy a good, its price will go up.<n>Now buy @a$SubGoal$ of wheat.
text: 你可能已经注意到，卖出一些棉花后，棉花价格下降了。<n>这是因为价格由城镇的供需决定。<n>出售货物满足了需求，价格就会下降；买入货物则会让价格上涨。<n>现在买入@a$SubGoal$小麦。

source: Notice how the price of wheat has just gone up? <n>Note, however, that the price depends not only on the supply but also on your reputation in the town.<n>Click on the button with the building to the bottom-right of the Trade window.
text: 注意到小麦价格刚刚上涨了吗？<n>不过，价格不仅取决于供应量，也受到你在该城声望的影响。<n>点击贸易窗口右下方带有建筑图案的按钮。

source: Now you can trade between your warehouse and the town.<n>In every town in which you want to set up production of a good, you must first build a warehouse. You will always already own a warehouse in your starting town.<n>Now sell all the goods you have in the warehouse.
text: 现在，你可以在自己的仓库与城镇之间交易。<n>每当你想在一座城镇生产货物，都必须先建造仓库。在起始城镇，你一开始就拥有一座仓库。<n>现在卖掉仓库里的全部货物。

source: You have three buttons with the numbers 1, 10 and 100 at the very top of the Trade window to allow you to trade larger quantities of goods more quickly. Click on the button 10 and watch how the prices change.<n>It makes no difference whether you buy 10 x 1 good or 1 x 10 goods: The total price is always the same. Now buy @a$SubGoal$ of rum.
text: 贸易窗口最上方有三个按钮，标着1、10和100，可以让你更快地交易大量货物。点击10，看看价格如何变化。<n>分十次各买1单位，或一次买10单位，总价始终相同。现在购买@a$SubGoal$朗姆酒。

source: The column in the far right of the trade menu displays the average prices for the goods you have bought. Since you want to sell the goods at a profit, you must find a town where a higher price will be paid.<n>Now open the transfer between the ship and your warehouse by clicking on the fourth button (with the crane) on the bottom right.
text: 贸易菜单最右列显示你买入商品的平均价格。要获利出售，就得找到愿意支付更高价格的城镇。<n>现在点击右下方第四个按钮，也就是起重机图标，打开船只与仓库之间的转移窗口。

source: In this window, you can move goods between your convoy and your warehouse. Now load any remaining goods from your warehouse onto the convoy, because you want to sell the goods in another town.<n>Then close the Trade window by clicking on the button marked "X" on the bottom right.
text: 在这个窗口里，你可以在船队与仓库之间转移货物。现在把仓库里剩下的货物全部装上船队，因为你要去另一个城镇出售它们。<n>然后点击右下角标有“X”的按钮，关闭贸易窗口。

source: Now switch to the sea chart and travel with your convoy to Santa Marta. Do not enter Santa Marta, but right-click on the town as soon as the convoy reaches the town.
text: 现在切换到海图，带领船队前往圣玛尔塔。船队抵达后先不要进入城镇，而是立即右键点击城镇。

source: This will open the Trade window for Santa Marta.<n>Therefore, you do not have to enter a town to trade there.<n>Now sell all the goods that you have on board your convoy.<n>Then close the Trade window.
text: 这样就打开了圣玛尔塔的贸易窗口。<n>所以，不必进入城镇也能在那里交易。<n>现在卖掉船队携带的全部货物。<n>然后关闭贸易窗口。

source: Are you sure you want to delete the saved game?
text: 确定要删除这个存档吗？

source: Your convoy is now in Santa Marta. Click on the town name to display the town information.<n>You can do this from the sea chart or by entering the town.
text: 你的船队现在位于圣玛尔塔。点击城镇名称，查看城镇信息。<n>在海图上或进入城镇后都可以这样做。

source: The town information shows the goods that are produced in the town.<n><n>Your relationship with Spain is also displayed: This relationship is friendly! This means that you will be paid the best possible prices in the town.<n><n>Now close this window and take a look around the town.
text: 城镇信息中会显示当地生产的货物。<n><n>这里也会显示你与西班牙的关系：目前是友好！这意味着你能在城镇里获得最有利的交易价格。<n><n>现在关闭窗口，看看城镇的其他地方。

source: Now click on the Inhabitants symbol under the town name on the left of the screen to display Santa Marta's stock.
text: 现在点击屏幕左侧城镇名称下方的居民图标，查看圣玛尔塔的货物库存。

source: This displays the quantity of goods in storage and the quantity of goods consumed in the town. Naturally, the level of consumption depends on the town's population.<n>The consumption tells you how many goods can be delivered regularly. Now close the Stock window.
text: 这里显示城镇的商品库存和消费量。消费量自然取决于城镇人口。<n>通过消费量，你可以判断哪些货物适合定期运来、每次该运多少。现在关闭库存窗口。

source: Now try to strike some profitable bargains.<n>Open the Trade window and buy as much cotton, sugar and cocoa as you can transport in your convoy because these goods are produced in this town.<n>Then return to Cartagena and sell these goods at a profit.
text: 现在试着做几笔有利可图的买卖。<n>打开交易窗口，在船队运力允许的范围内，尽量多买些棉花、糖和可可，这些都是本地产的商品。<n>然后返回卡塔赫纳，将它们卖出获利。

source: You have just received two messages with some tips for successful trading.<n>Open the log to read the messages.<n>
text: 你刚收到两条消息，里面有一些成功贸易的诀窍。<n>打开日志，阅读这些消息。<n>

source: Sell as many goods as you can above the average price and buy new goods. <n>Note: The prices of goods that are scarce in a town are shown in red. You will always get good prices for these goods.<n>
text: 尽量以高于平均价格卖出货物，再买入新的商品。<n>注意：城镇短缺商品的价格以红色显示，这些商品总能卖个好价钱。<n>

source: Governor towns like Cartagena receive import goods from Europe.<n>You can usually sell these at a profit to colonial towns, such as Santa Marta, Maracaibo or Gibraltar.<n>Now trade on your own for a while.<n>Your objective is to make @g$GoldGoal$ in cash from trade.
text: 卡塔赫纳这样的总督驻地会接收欧洲进口商品。<n>把这些商品卖到圣玛尔塔、马拉开波或直布罗陀等殖民城镇，通常能赚取利润。<n>现在自己做一阵贸易吧。<n>你的目标是通过贸易积累@g$GoldGoal$现金。
海盗巢穴的位置已被发现

source: %1,<n>I can think of many people I'd rather see. Do we have business to discuss? Come in, if you must.
text: %1：<n>我宁愿见到别人，也不愿见你。我们有什么生意要谈吗？非要进来的话，就进来吧。

source: Go to the town view for Cartagena.<n>Usually, you must have a convoy anchored in the harbor if you want to enter a town. However, you have a warehouse in Cartagena and can therefore enter this town whenever you like.<n>Click on the shipyard in Cartagena.
text: 切换到卡塔赫纳的城镇视图。<n>通常，船队必须停泊在港口，才能进入城镇。但你在卡塔赫纳有仓库，因此随时都可以进入。<n>点击卡塔赫纳的造船厂。

source: In the shipyard, purchase a small ship. Don't spend too much money because you'll need to keep some for trading and for maintaining your ship.
text: 在造船厂购买一艘小船。别花太多钱，你还需要留一些用于贸易和船只维护。

source: In the last scenario, you learned how to add ships to a convoy by right-clicking on the harbor.<n>Now, however, you should assemble a new convoy by hiring a captain at the inn.<n>Find the inn (located in the center of the town) and click on it.
text: 在上一个剧本中，你已经学会右击港口，将船只加入船队。<n>但这一次，你应在酒馆雇用一名船长，组建一支新船队。<n>找到城镇中心的酒馆，然后点击它。

source: Captains are always to be found at the inn. If there is a captain staying in the town, this will be indicated by the third button in the Inn menu.<n>If you have other ships or convoys in the harbor, you must tell the captain where exactly he is to be employed.<n>Specify that he is to captain your new ship.
text: 船长总是在旅店里找。如果城镇有船长停留，旅店菜单的第三个按钮就会显示。<n>港口中若有其他船只或船队，你需要明确告诉船长去哪里任职。<n>指定他指挥你的新船。

source: Congratulations! You have formed your first convoy! Your next task is to increase your wealth to @g$GoldGoal$. You can check your wealth at any time under "Successes" in the log.<n><n>Good luck!
text: 恭喜！你组建了第一支船队！下一个任务是将财富增加到@g$GoldGoal$。你可以随时在日志的“成就”页面查看自己的财富。<n><n>祝你好运！

source: Thank you for completing the last mission I gave you.
text: 谢谢你完成了我上次交给你的任务。

source: I would like to thank you for completing my last mission.
text: 感谢你完成了我上次交给你的任务。

source: I am grateful for your support.
You begin your career with <o:0xFFF2FAAD>%1<o> gold pieces and a <o:0xFFF2FAAD>pinnace<o> (60 tons, max. 8 cannons).
text: 你将带着<o:0xFFF2FAAD>%1<o>枚金币和一艘<o:0xFFF2FAAD>轻型帆船<o>开始生涯（60吨，最多8门火炮）。

source: When you carry settlers to a town where workers are needed, the settlers will thank you by paying you a fare when they disembark.<n><n>A small number of tools is always required to produce colonial goods like cocoa. If these tools are not available, production stops. Later, when you know a little more about prices and quantities, you can instruct the storekeeper to purchase tools regularly in the town. However, you should purchase the tools yourself for the moment, to be on the safe side.<n><n>This is your next task. Then there will be nothing to stop you from producing cocoa.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Produce cocoa and build up a supply of @a$AmountGoal$ in your warehouse.
text: 把移民送到需要工人的城镇时，他们下船会付给你船费，以示感谢。<n><n>生产可可等殖民地商品，始终需要少量工具。缺少工具，生产就会停止。以后熟悉价格和数量后，你可以指示仓库管理员定期在城里购买工具。不过目前为了稳妥，还是亲自采购。<n><n>这就是你接下来的任务。完成后，可可生产就能顺利进行了。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>关卡目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>生产可可，使仓库库存达到@a$AmountGoal$。

source: Thank you. Here are your %1. I am here until %2. You can bring me more goods until then.
text: 谢谢。这是你的%1。我会在这里待到%2，在那之前，你可以继续给我送货。

source: %1 is personally on the enemy ship. He suggests to your captain that the battle should be decided by a duel.<n><n>To spare the crew, your captain accepts the challenge.
text: %1本人就在敌船上。他向你的船长提议，以决斗决定这场战斗的胜负。<n><n>为了保护船员，你的船长接受了挑战。

source: Do you want to overwrite it?
There is a shortage of @G$Goods$ for processing in my town. The stocks of the various businesses are already very low. Could you help me?
text: 本城缺乏用于加工的@G$Goods$，各处产业的库存都快见底了。你能帮忙吗？

source: I recently had the Association of Catholic Producers on my doorstep. They are complaining that there is not enough @G$Goods$ in the town. I had to endure their complaining for three hours. I cannot go through that again. Could you not help to extricate me from this delicate situation?
text: 最近，天主教生产者协会找上门来，抱怨城里的@G$Goods$供应不足。我足足听他们抱怨了三个小时，实在受不了再来一次。你能帮我摆脱这个棘手的处境吗？

source: Curses! Once again, my town has run short of @G$Goods$. It is sometimes quite beyond me how the resident traders carry on their business. Until I have sorted this matter out, I would be grateful if you could help me.
text: 该死！本城又缺少@G$Goods$了。当地商人到底怎么经营的，我有时真想不通。在我把这事理顺之前，还请你帮帮忙。

source: You have occupied the town council. From this day on, this town belongs to %1.
text: 你已占领市政厅。从今天起，这座城镇归%1所有。

source: You have chased the Governor out of town. From this day on, this town belongs to %1.
text: 你已将总督赶出城镇。从今天起，这座城镇归%1所有。

source: You have chased the viceroy out of town. From this day on, this town belongs to %1.
text: 你已将殖民地总督赶出城镇。从今天起，这座城镇属于%1。

source: Greetings, %1. Seaman %2 has offered his services as an inexperienced captain.
text: 你好，%1。水手%2愿意担任船长，不过他还缺乏经验。

source: The %1 buccaneer %2 sneaked into the town harbor and threatened arriving traders. For at least four weeks, traders from outside will only call very reluctantly at the  town.
text: %1私掠者%2潜入城镇港口，威胁前来停靠的商人。至少四周内，外地商人都会极不情愿到这里来。

source: As of today, %1 and %2 are at war. Both sides increase their number of military convoys.
text: 从今天起，%1与%2开战。双方都将增加军事船队的数量。

source: @N$ContactName$ can help you to find a teacher to train one of your captains (in the art of trading).
text: @N$ContactName$可以帮你寻找导师，培训你的一名船长，提升他的贸易技巧。

source: @N$ContactName$ can help you to find a teacher to train one of your captains (in waging battle).
text: @N$ContactName$可以帮你寻找导师，培训你的一名船长，提升他的战斗技巧。

source: @N$ContactName$ can help you to find a teacher to train one of your captains (in the art of navigation).
text: @N$ContactName$能帮你找到一位导师，为你的船长传授航海技艺。

source: Meet the governor's emissary at the marketplace of @T$TOWN$ by @D$Date$ and deliver @a$Amount$ of wine, tools and spices. You must deliver all the goods together.
text: 在@D$Date$之前到@T$TOWN$市场会见总督的使者，交付葡萄酒、工具和香料各@a$Amount$。必须一次交齐全部货物。

source: You have defeated the English buccaneer %1 in a duel and taken him hostage.
text: 你在决斗中击败了英格兰私掠者%1，并将他俘虏。

source: You have defeated the French buccaneer %1 in a duel and taken him hostage.
text: 你在决斗中击败了法国私掠者%1，并将他俘虏。

source: You have defeated the Dutch buccaneer %1 in a duel and taken him hostage.
text: 你在决斗中击败了荷兰私掠者%1，并将他俘获。

source: You have defeated the Spanish buccaneer %1 in a duel and taken him hostage.
text: 你在决斗中击败了西班牙私掠者%1，并将他扣为人质。

source: Use a convoy to find the teacher's hideout. @l$TeacherPos$ There must be @a$Amount$ of wine on board the convoy.
text: 派一支船队寻找导师的隐居处。@l$TeacherPos$船队必须携带@a$Amount$葡萄酒。

source: Use a convoy to find the teacher's hideout. @l$TeacherPos$ There must be @a$Amount$ of rum on board the convoy.
text: 派船队寻找导师的隐居处。@l$TeacherPos$ 船上必须带有@a$Amount$朗姆酒。

source: Use a convoy to find the teacher's hideout. @l$TeacherPos$ There must be @a$Amount$ of food on board the convoy.
text: 派一支船队寻找导师的藏身处。@l$TeacherPos$船队必须携带@a$Amount$食物。

source: Send a captain who does not have much trading experience.
text: 派一位贸易经验不多的船长前去。

source: Send a captain who does not have much battle experience.
text: 请派一位战斗经验不太丰富的船长来。

source: Send a captain who does not have much experience of navigation.
text: 请派一位航海经验不太丰富的船长来。

source: Deliver any amount of @G$Goods$ to the market in @T$TOWN$. There you will receive @g$Price$ per barrel immediately. On @D$EndDate$, an expeditionary convoy will collect the goods. Escort the convoy to Europe and you will receive another @g$Price$ per barrel.
text: 向@T$TOWN$市场运送任意数量的@G$Goods$，每桶可立即获得@g$Price$。@D$EndDate$，远征船队将来收取货物。护送船队前往欧洲后，每桶还能再获得@g$Price$。

source: The convoy cannot set sail because some of your ships are in very poor condition. Have your convoy repaired in the shipyard before sending it to sea again. Alternatively, you can take the damaged ships out of the convoy and have them repaired separately.
text: 部分船只状况极差，船队无法起航。请先到造船厂修理船队，再出海。你也可以把损坏的船移出船队，单独进行维修。

source: We have everything we need here.

The status of a town can advance through seven levels, from poverty to wealth. At the lowest two levels, the quality of life is so bad that citizens regularly leave the town. On the other hand, when a town reaches the levels of “flourishing economy”, “wealth” and “riches”, your businesses receive an efficiency bonus and your workforce is more cost-efficient. At the highest level, a town even produces its own settlers.<n><n>You will find more information on the effects of each status level in the town information. To display this, click on the town name.<n><n> A sufficient supply of two to three goods in each goods group will ensure a good quality of life in your town. The supply of a good is sufficient if it can cater for the town’s population for ten days.<n><n>Note: A town's status doesn't improve overnight. It takes a while for the town’s citizens to adapt to a new situation.
text: 城镇的经济状况从贫困到富庶，共分七个等级。最低两个等级的生活质量非常糟糕，市民会不断离开。反之，当城镇达到“经济兴盛”“富裕”和“富庶”时，企业会获得效率加成，劳动力成本也会更加划算。在最高等级，城镇甚至会自行产生移民。<n><n>城镇信息中可以查看各经济等级的具体影响，点击城镇名称即可打开。<n><n>每类货物中有两至三种供应充足，就能让居民过上不错的生活。如果某种货物足够全城人口使用十天，就视为供应充足。<n><n>注意：城镇经济不会一夜好转，居民需要一段时间适应新的生活状况。

source: Supply @T$TargetTown$ with goods and buy up surplus goods. On @D$EndDate$, the town's status must be "Boom" and all of the local traders' businesses must be working to full capacity.
text: 向@T$TargetTown$供应商品，并收购过剩货物。到@D$EndDate$时，城镇必须达到“繁荣”状态，且当地商人的所有产业都须满负荷运转。

source: Supply @T$TargetTown$ with goods and buy up surplus goods. On @D$EndDate$, the town's status must be "Flourishing economy" and all of the local traders' businesses must be working to full capacity.
text: 向@T$TargetTown$供应货物，并收购当地的过剩货物。到@D$EndDate$时，城镇必须达到“经济兴盛”状态，所有当地商人的产业也必须满负荷运转。

source: A pirate convoy under the command of @P$PirateName$ is currently at large near the town of Belize, northwest of Cartagena. Your mission is to destroy the convoy. Then return to the Governor of Cartagena.
text: @P$PirateName$指挥的一支海盗船队，目前正在卡塔赫纳西北方、伯利兹城镇附近活动。你的任务是消灭它，然后返回卡塔赫纳总督那里。

source: You have found the remains of the sunken convoy and take the goods on board.
text: 你找到了沉没船队的残骸，并将货物装上船。

source: You have found the remains of the sunken transport convoy, but there is no room to take the goods on board.
text: 你找到了沉没运输船队的残骸，但船上没有空间装载这些货物。

source: For a modest feast you need %1 of each of the goods wheat, fruit, meat, rum and wine.
text: 举办简朴的宴会，需要小麦、水果、肉、朗姆酒和葡萄酒各%1。

source: For a medium-sized feast you need %1 of each of the goods wheat, fruit, meat, rum and wine.
text: 举办中型宴会，需要小麦、水果、肉类、朗姆酒和葡萄酒各%1。

source: For a lavish feast you need %1 of each of the goods wheat, fruit, meat, rum and wine.
text: 举办丰盛的宴会，需要小麦、水果、肉、朗姆酒和葡萄酒各%1。

source: Congratulations! You have successfully completed this scenario and now know how to build your own town.<n><n>In free-play mode, the viceroy of any nation may grant you the gift of your own town. But this is not easy to achieve, because you must always capture towns in order to receive a plot of land, and this will naturally damage your reputation with other nations. <n><n>Anything you have learned in this scenario about developing your town will help you to develop businesses in other towns also. The main difference is that you don't have to worry about defending those towns.
text: 恭喜！你成功完成了本关，现在知道如何建设自己的城镇了。<n><n>在自由游戏模式中，任何国家的殖民地总督都可能赐给你自己的城镇。不过，要得到土地，你必须先攻占城镇，这自然会损害你在其他国家的声望，所以并不容易。<n><n>本关学到的城镇发展方法，也能帮助你经营其他城镇的产业。最大的区别是，你不必负责那些城镇的防务。

source: Improve your reputation with Spain to "friendly".
text: 将你与西班牙的关系改善至“友好”。

source: I can mark the approximate location of his convoy on the sea chart. @l$ConvoyPos$ Whether or not you destroy this convoy is up to you. However, you must accomplish this mission by @D$EndDate$.
text: 我可以在海图上标出他船队的大致位置。@l$ConvoyPos$ 是否摧毁这支船队由您决定。不过，您必须在@D$EndDate$之前完成任务。

source: I'm afraid I'm unable to tell you where to find one of Blackbeard's convoys, as they are currently at a secret location. However, I'm allowing you plenty of time for this mission. You have until @D$EndDate$ to destroy a convoy.
text: 恐怕我无法告诉你黑胡子的船队在哪里，因为它们目前都藏在秘密地点。不过，我会给你充足的时间。请在@D$EndDate$之前消灭其中一支船队。

source: Your business in Santa Marta should employ a full complement of workers.
text: 你在圣玛尔塔的产业应当雇满工人。

source: For the loan of %1 which you granted me, you will receive the agreed sum of  %3 on %2.
text: 你借给我的%1贷款，我将依约于%2偿还%3。

source: <n>To make matters appear more official, I will give you a Letter of Marque against @n$HostileNation$.
text: <n>为了让此事更显正式，我会给你一张针对@n$HostileNation$的私掠许可证。

source: You are not exactly on good terms with my nation. Do you want to improve your reputation by paying %1 to my nation as a token of goodwill?
text: 你和我国的关系可算不上好。要不要向我国支付%1以示善意，改善你的声望？

source: The captain of the convoy is on the enemy ship. He suggests to your captain that the battle should be decided by a duel.<n><n>To spare the sailors, your captain accepts the challenge.
text: 敌方船队的船长就在那艘船上。他向你的船长提议，通过决斗决定战斗胜负。<n><n>为了减少水手伤亡，你的船长接受了挑战。

source: The pirate %1 has defeated your captain in a fair duel. The captain nobly accepts the outcome and duly orders a retreat.
text: 海盗%1在公平决斗中击败了你的船长。船长坦然接受结果，依约下令撤退。

source: Select a function from the list to change the keyboard configuration.
text: 从列表中选择一项功能，即可修改按键设置。

source: Destroy @I$NumConvoys$ military convoys belonging to @n$TargetNation$ by @D$EndDate$.
The %1 buccaneer %2 has caused a plague of rats in the town. The consumption of wheat, fruit, corn and meat is twice as high for one month.
text: %1私掠者%2在城镇引发了鼠患。一个月内，小麦、水果、玉米和肉的消耗量将翻倍。

source: Thank you for smoking out this pirate hideout. I hope the hideout contained enough gold to reimburse you for your troubles. All of the nations are grateful to you!
text: 谢谢你捣毁这处海盗藏身处。希望里面的金币足以补偿你的辛劳。所有国家都对你心怀感激！

source: I don't have any other news for you. Come back to see me another time.
text: 我没有其他消息了。改天再来看我吧。

source: Greetings! The convoy is en route, and soon the first traders will be quaking at our feet! Please come back again later to collect your first share.
text: 你好！船队已经出发，很快就会有商人在我们脚下瑟瑟发抖！请晚些再来领取第一笔分成。

source: Good day to you, but I'm afraid you're too early! I have no new shares for you yet. Please be patient for another few days!
text: 你好，不过恐怕你来得太早了！暂时还没有新的分成可以给你。请再耐心等几天！

source: Good day, %1. I have your new share here. This time you are getting %2!
text: 你好，%1。你的新一份分成到了，这次能拿到%2！

source: You have found the chest of @N$ContactName$.<n><n>
A local trader is prepared to sell you the business and all crop fields for a price of %1.
text: 一位当地商人愿意以%1的价格，将这家企业及全部农田卖给你。

source: While you are looting the town, a young woman comes running up to you.<n>"I know this attack is only being carried out on my father's orders! Did he tell you that I am here of my own free will and that I am truly in love with my abductor? I beg you not to take me back, I will reward you!".<n><n>Do you want to abandon the daughter to her fate here in @T$TargetTown$?
text: 你正在劫掠城镇时，一名年轻女子跑到你面前。<n>“我知道，你是奉我父亲的命令才来进攻的！他有没有告诉你，我是自愿留在这里，而且真心爱着那个绑走我的人？求求你别带我回去，我会报答你的！”<n><n>你愿意让她留在@T$TargetTown$，由她自己决定命运吗？

source: The governor's daughter thanks you and gives you a map showing the location of a hideout containing @a$Amount$ of goods.
text: 总督的女儿向你道谢，并送给你一张地图，上面标明了一处藏有@a$Amount$货物的隐秘地点。

source: A local trader is prepared to sell you the residential area for a price of %1.
text: 一位当地商人愿意以%1的价格向您出售这片住宅区。

source: I would like to thank you once again for being so generous as to hand over one of your convoys. It is currently being armed and will be ready to set sail in %1 days.<n><n>If you want to hand over another convoy, you must wait until then.
text: 再次感谢你慷慨地移交一支船队。它正在接受武装，%1天后就能启航。<n><n>如果还想移交另一支船队，请等到那时。

source: Excellent! You destroyed all of the pirate convoys so that none of the pirates can escape. If you destroy all of a pirate gang's convoys before attacking their hideout, it will take longer for new pirate convoys to appear in the Caribbean.<n><n>Now attack the hideout the same way you would attack a town by selecting you convoy and then right-clicking on the pirate hideout.  If some pirate ships are anchored in the harbor, you must first attack these before you can win the harbor battle.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Destroy Blackbeard’s pirate hideout.
text: 太好了！你消灭了所有海盗船队，没有海盗能够逃脱。如果先消灭一个海盗团伙的全部船队，再攻击其藏身处，加勒比海上重新出现海盗船队的时间就会推迟。<n><n>现在，像攻击城镇一样攻击藏身处：选中船队，然后右击海盗藏身处。如果港内停有海盗船，你必须先击败它们，才能赢得港口战斗。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>摧毁黑胡子的海盗藏身处。

source: I must thank you once again, you have done so much for my nation. I shall reward you with additional land for your town %1. You will then own %2% of the district.
text: 我必须再次感谢你，你为我国做了这么多。我将赐予你的城镇%1更多土地。届时，你将拥有该地区%2%的土地。

source: I have nothing further to say to you, other than this warning: watch out for the military convoys of my nation, for they are hunting you!
text: 我跟您无话可说，只给您一个警告：小心我国的军事船队，它们正在追捕您！

source: Active for %1 days. Average daily profit %2.
text: 已运行%1天，平均每日利润%2。

source: Pirates have broken through the town's harbor defenses and have looted various finished goods.
text: 海盗突破了城镇港口的防线，掠走了多种制成品。

source: You destroyed Blackbeard's hideout but you didn't manage to destroy all of his convoys first.
text: 您摧毁了黑胡子的巢穴，但没能先消灭他的全部船队。

source: You didn't manage to restore the population of Tortuga.<n><n>As soon as a town's status reaches "boom" or higher, new workers can be hired. You can supply the town with new workers in the form of settler families. These travel from Europe to the governor towns, where they wait for a passage to other towns. You'll also find settlers waiting to be picked up in towns with a lower status.
text: 你没能恢复托尔图加的人口。<n><n>城镇状态一旦达到“繁荣”或更高，就能雇用新工人。你可以运来移民家庭，为城镇补充劳动力。他们从欧洲来到总督驻地，等待搭船前往其他城镇。在发展状态较差的城镇里，也能找到等待接走的移民。

source: Uses Miles Sound System, Copyright 1991-2004 by RAD Game Tools, Inc. MPEG Layer-3 playback supplied with the Miles Sound System from RAD Game Tools, Inc. MPEG Layer-3 audio compression technology licensed by Fraunhofer IIS and THOMSON Multimedia.
text: 本游戏使用 Miles Sound System，版权归 RAD Game Tools, Inc. 所有，1991—2004 年。MPEG Layer-3 播放功能由 RAD Game Tools, Inc. 的 Miles Sound System 提供。MPEG Layer-3 音频压缩技术经 Fraunhofer IIS 和 THOMSON Multimedia 授权。

source: You can now boost your reputation in %1 by attacking French ships and towns. This will not diminish your reputation in the other nations.
text: 现在，你可以通过袭击法国船只和城镇，提高在%1的声望。这不会降低你在其他国家的声望。

source: <n><n>However, if at least one ship in your convoy survives the battle, the captain survives also.
text: <n><n>不过，只要船队中至少有一艘船在战斗中幸存，船长也能活下来。

source: What misfortune has befallen me. Since the outbreak of war with @n$FoeNation$, I have not been able to accumulate enough colonial goods for the transport convoys. Can you assist by providing me with a large shipment of @G$Goods$?
text: 真是祸不单行。自从与@n$FoeNation$开战，我就一直没能为运输船队筹集到足够的殖民地商品。您能帮我运来一大批@G$Goods$吗？

source: Since we went to war with @n$FoeNation$, their traders have been forbidden to deliver @G$Goods$ to the towns belonging to my nation. I am now faced with a significant shortage of goods. You have many ships and know the seas well. Could you not secure me a large shipment of @G$Goods$?
text: 自从我们与@n$FoeNation$开战，他们的商人就被禁止向我国城镇运送@G$Goods$，如今我面临着严重短缺。你船只众多，又熟悉这片海域，能否替我弄到一大批@G$Goods$？

source: It was a pleasure doing business with you. Good day to you!
text: 和你做生意很愉快。祝你愉快！

source: The goods have been sent to your warehouse. Good day to you!
text: 货物已经送入您的仓库。祝您愉快！

source: The goods have been loaded onto your convoy. Goodbye %1.
text: 货物已经装进你的船队。再见，%1。

source: As you know, the Spanish treasure fleet always takes a different route when collecting treasures from its colonies and shipping them to Europe. The fleet avoids being ambushed by only ever staying a short time at each town. However, this time Spain has committed a serious blunder, by allowing us to find out the route the Spanish treasure fleet is following at this very moment. Your orders couldn't be simpler. Destroy every last ship!
text: 你也知道，西班牙运宝船队每次从殖民地收集财宝并运往欧洲时，都会选择不同的航线。为了避免遭到伏击，船队在每座城镇都只作短暂停留。不过，这次西班牙犯下了严重的失误，让我们获知了运宝船队此刻的行进路线。你的命令再简单不过：把他们的船全部消灭，一艘不留！

source: We are at war with Spain and must ensure that the Spanish treasure fleet never reaches Europe. Luckily, we have learned which town the fleet will be calling at next. We will sabotage the fleet at this town so that it has to prolong its stay in the harbor. This should give you enough time to intercept the fleet and prevent it from reaching Europe. Do you accept this mission?
text: 我们与西班牙正在交战，必须确保西班牙宝船队无法抵达欧洲。幸运的是，我们已经获悉它下一站将停靠哪座城镇。我们会在那里破坏船队，迫使它延长停港时间。这应该能给你足够时间拦截船队，阻止它返回欧洲。你接受任务吗？

source: You don't get opportunities like this every day! Today one of my informants told me the route the Spanish treasure fleet is currently following. But that's not all. We have learned that the fleet will be lying at anchor for longer than usual at the next town it visits. Since we are at war with Spain, we should give the viceroy something to smile about and make sure the treasure fleet never reaches its destination in Europe. Will you intercept the fleet for my nation?
text: 这种机会可不是天天都有！今天，一名线人告诉了我西班牙宝船队正在行驶的航线。不仅如此，我们还得知，船队将在下一座停靠城镇逗留得比平时更久。既然我们与西班牙正在交战，就该给殖民地总督带来一点喜讯，确保宝船队永远到不了欧洲的目的地。你愿意替我国拦截它吗？

source: I see you have still not completed my last mission. Complete this job, as I have further work for you.
name: ID_NPC_GOV_MISSION_RUNNING
text: 看来你还没完成上个任务。先把它做完，我还有其他事要交给你。

source: I'm afraid I have no use for you at the moment.<n> I can only task you with capturing a town if a hostile nation is weakened and I have enough military convoys available to protect my towns.
text: 恐怕眼下没有需要你做的事。<n>只有敌国兵力削弱、而我拥有足够军事船队保护本国城镇时，我才能委托你攻城。

source: The %1 buccaneer %2 sneaked into the town and destroyed large stocks of goods belonging to several of the town's traders. The town council refuses to accept liability.
text: %1私掠者%2潜入城镇，摧毁了几位当地商人的大批库存。镇议会拒绝承担赔偿责任。

source: Convoy @C$Convoy$ has picked up a castaway. Take him to @T$DestTown$.
text: 船队@C$Convoy$救起一名落难者。请将他送到@T$DestTown$。

source: Convoy @C$Convoy$ has picked up castaway. Take him to a town belonging to @n$DestNation$.
text: 船队@C$Convoy$救起了一名落难者。请把他送到@n$DestNation$所属的城镇。

source: @N$Name$ has jumped overboard in a rage because you were too slow.
text: 因为你行动太慢，@N$Name$一怒之下跳进了海里。

source: Your troops break down the town gate and take the commander hostage. When the town's soldiers see this, they capitulate.<n><n>What do you want to do now?
text: 你的部队攻破城门，俘虏了指挥官。城里的士兵见状纷纷投降。<n><n>接下来你想怎么做？

source: Increase your convoy's firepower to at least 90 cannons.
text: 增强船队火力，使其至少拥有90门火炮。

source: You performed an action that prevents you from completing the scenario successfully.<n><n>Follow the instructions in the Event window.
text: 你的某项操作导致本剧本已无法成功完成。<n><n>请遵循事件窗口中的指示。

<ts:0><ts:110><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>鼠标左键<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>舷侧齐射<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>鼠标右键<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>设定航向<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>1,2,3<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>选择弹药<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>4<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>准备接舷战<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>%1<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>火炮开火

source: %1 is full and no longer has any space on which to build a warehouse. If you want to gain a foothold in this town in spite of this, you can try to persuade one of the local traders to demolish one of his businesses.<n><n>Businesses are demolished if the price in the town for the goods produced remains at a low level over a long period, that is, if there is a surplus of the good. To achieve this, you must first start to hoard the product. Then sell sufficient quantities of the product at the town market to drive the price down to a low level.<n><n>The goods produced are delivered to the town market once a day. If the price is currently minimal, the business reduces its complement of workers. You can check this by clicking on the business. A business is demolished once 30 workers have been made redundant.
text: %1已没有空地，无法再建造仓库。如果仍想在本城立足，你可以尝试让当地商人拆掉一家企业。<n><n>当某种产品长期价格低迷，也就是供应过剩时，生产它的企业就可能被拆除。为此，你需要先囤积该产品，再向城镇市场大量抛售，将价格压到低位。<n><n>企业每天向城镇市场交货一次。如果此时价格处于最低水平，企业就会减少工人数。点击企业即可查看。当30名工人都被解雇后，这家企业便会被拆除。

source: The town is flourishing due to a gold discovery
text: 城镇因发现黄金而日益兴盛

source: I must thank you once again, you have done so much for my nation. As a reward, I shall give you the remaining land for your town %1. You now own the entire district.
text: 我必须再次感谢你，你为我国立下了如此多的功劳。作为奖赏，我将把你那座城镇%1剩余的土地全部赐给你。现在，整片地区都归你所有。

source: A campfire exposes the teacher's hideout, not far from the shore. Your captain rows ashore and is met by an old man. When the old man sees all the wine, he rubs his hands with glee.
text: 一堆篝火暴露了导师的隐居处，那里离海岸不远。你的船长划船上岸，见到一位老人。看到带来的许多葡萄酒，老人高兴得直搓手。

source: Not far from the shore, your convoy discovers a small hermit's campsite. Your captain rows ashore and meets an old man wearing a captain's uniform that is even older than he is. He spots the barrels of rum and is delighted.
text: 在离海岸不远的地方，你的船队发现了一个隐士的小营地。船长划船上岸，遇见一位老人，身上那件船长制服看起来比他的年纪还大。看到那些朗姆酒桶，老人喜出望外。

source: After a while, your convoy discovers a hideout on land. The captain rows ashore and looks around. He finally finds the old master and explains what brings him there. The hermit accepts the food.
text: 过了一会儿，船队在岸上发现了一处隐居地。船长划船上岸查看，终于找到老大师，并说明来意。隐士收下了食物。

source: He is happy to teach your young captain all his tricks of the trade.
text: 他很乐意把自己的生意诀窍传授给你那位年轻船长。

source: He will therefore teach the young captain everything he knows about winning battles.
text: 因此，他会把自己所知的制胜之道，全部传授给这位年轻船长。

source: He is happy to teach the captain all about the art of navigation.
text: 他很乐意向这位船长传授航海之道。

source: Construct five different businesses and residential buildings in Tortuga and increase the population to 1,500 by @D$EndDate$.
text: 在托尔图加建造五种不同企业和配套住宅，并在@D$EndDate$前将人口增加到1,500。

source: I shall begin preparations straight away. Please deliver the goods no later than %1.
text: 我会立刻开始准备。请最迟于%1交齐货物。

source: The town is suffering from a rat infestation

Good. The transport convoy will leave the port of @T$TOWN$ on @D$DepartDate$. Sail ahead of it in the direction of Europe and secure its route. Keep a sharp lookout for military convoys from @n$HostileNation$. Your mission will be accomplished if the convoy succeeds in leaving the waters of the New World without being attacked.
text: 很好。运输船队将在@D$DepartDate$离开@T$TOWN$港口。请先向欧洲方向航行，为它清理航路。务必密切留意来自@n$HostileNation$的军事船队。只要运输船队未受攻击并成功驶离新世界海域，你的任务就算完成。

source: I am very grateful to you. A transport convoy will leave my harbor on @D$DepartDate$. I want you to protect it from military convoys from @n$HostileNation$ and make sure that reaches Europe safely.
text: 十分感谢。一支运输船队将于@D$DepartDate$离开我的港口。我希望你保护它免受@n$HostileNation$军事船队的攻击，确保它平安抵达欧洲。

source: You are a man of action. A transport convoy will shortly arrive here and will be leaving port for Europe on @D$DepartDate$. Sail ahead of it and secure its route to protect the convoy from attack.
text: 您果然是实干家。一支运输船队即将抵达这里，并将在@D$DepartDate$离港前往欧洲。请提前出海，肃清航路，保护船队不受袭击。

source: In the demo, you can only enter the towns that were already shown at the start of the game.<n><n>However, you can trade with any town by dispatching a convoy to the town and right-clicking on the town while the convoy is selected.
text: 试玩版中，你只能进入游戏开始时已经显示的城镇。<n><n>不过，你仍能与任何城镇贸易：派船队前往，选中船队后右键点击城镇即可。
使用彩色硬件鼠标指针

source: All of your production is running smoothly.
text: 你的所有生产活动都在顺利进行。

source: You have made yourself very unpopular in my nation. But %1 is prepared to forget the hostilities for %2. Are you prepared to pay this amount?
text: 你在我国已是声名狼藉。不过，%1愿意收取%2，就此放下敌意。你愿意支付这笔钱吗？

source: Deliver @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$ to @T$TOWN$ by @D$Date$. You shall receive @g$GoldPerBarrel$ for each <gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen> at the market.
text: 在@D$Date$之前，向@T$TOWN$交付@a$Amount$的@G$Goods$。在市场上，每<gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>可获得@g$GoldPerBarrel$。

source: You have not delivered the goods in time.
<n>You don't have enough cash. Come back when you can afford it.
text: <n>你的现金不够。等付得起时再来吧。

source: Today, the %1 buccaneer %2 docked in the harbor of the town under a false flag,  posing as a trader. By so doing, he was able to buy stocks in the town. Many goods are now unavailable or very scarce.
text: 今天，%1私掠者%2悬挂假旗，冒充商人停靠在城镇港口，并借机买走了城里的库存。现在，许多货物已经售罄或严重短缺。

source: Capture three English trading convoys: Board their ships and add them to your convoy.
text: 俘获三支英格兰贸易船队：接舷夺取它们的船只，并编入你的船队。

source: Greetings, @A$USER$. I am interested in buying a large quantity of @G$Goods$, say @a$Amount$. I am offering a unit price of @g$Price$. Are you interested?
text: 你好，@A$USER$。我想大量收购@G$Goods$，就要@a$Amount$吧。我给出的单价是@g$Price$。你有兴趣吗？

source: Hello @A$USER$. Can you deliver @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$ to me? I am prepared to pay the sum of @g$TotalPrice$, which would mean a unit price of @g$Price$. What say you?
text: 你好，@A$USER$。你能给我送来@a$Amount$@G$Goods$吗？我愿意支付@g$TotalPrice$，也就是单价@g$Price$。你觉得如何？

source: Greetings, @A$USER$. Would you be interested in supplying me with @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$? I will pay you @g$Price$ per unit, which means a total of @g$TotalPrice$. Are you interested?
text: 你好，@A$USER$。你愿意为我供应@a$Amount$的@G$Goods$吗？我按每单位@g$Price$支付，总计@g$TotalPrice$。有兴趣吗？

source: Select your ship and press the Fast Forward button.
text: 选中你的船，按下快进按钮。

source: Build two weaving mills in Cartagena and produce @a$AmountGoal$ of cloth.
text: 在卡塔赫纳建造两座纺织厂，生产@a$AmountGoal$布匹。

source: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>Unfortunately you cannot take the flotsam on board as your convoy has no available storage space.
text: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>很遗憾，你的船队没有剩余货舱空间，无法打捞这些漂流物。

source: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>You have found flotsam and take it on board your convoy.
text: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>你发现了漂流货物，并把它们装上船队。

source: You have no free ships in the harbor.
text: 你在港口没有闲置船只。

source: You have forced your opponent to flee.
A storm front is moving from the northeast into the Caribbean. Production on crop farms is halved in all affected towns.
text: 一股风暴锋正从东北方进入加勒比海。所有受影响城镇的农作物产量减半。

source: A new storm from the southwest is closing in on the Caribbean. Production on crop farms is halved in all towns affected by the storm.
text: 一场新风暴正从西南逼近加勒比海。所有受灾城镇的农作物产量将减半。

source: You already know that only escort ships can take part in sea battles. The vanquished trading ships always fall to the victor, who can choose to loot or capture them.<n><n>You are not always the initiator of sea battles involving your convoys. If one of your convoys is attacked by pirates or by a military convoy from a nation in which your reputation is very low, you can engage in combat or your convoy can try to avoid the battle. If you want to avoid a battle, your escort ships must try to keep the enemy from getting too close to your trading ships.<n><n>If this fails, your escort ships will be captured and your trading ships  looted. If a convoy has no warships, all it can do in the case of an attack is try to avoid a battle. Advantage: The trading ships are only looted by the enemy and are not captured.<n><n>Now pay the governor a visit. He has a new mission for you. <n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Accomplish the next mission assigned to you by the governor.
text: 你已经知道，只有护航船才能参加海战。败方的商船总会落入胜者手中，由胜者选择劫掠或俘获。<n><n>你的船队并不总是海战的主动发起者。若遭到海盗，或与你关系极差的国家的军事船队袭击，你可以应战，也可以尝试避战。选择避战时，护航船必须设法阻止敌人逼近商船。<n><n>如果失败，护航船会被俘获，商船则会遭到劫掠。没有战舰的船队遇袭时，只能尝试避战。好处是：敌人只会劫掠商船，而不会将其俘获。<n><n>现在去拜访总督，他有新任务交给你。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>完成总督交给你的下一个任务。

source: Sell the goods in your warehouse in @T$TOWN$ to increase your cash to @g$GoldGoal$.
text: 卖出您在@T$TOWN$仓库中的商品，将现金提高到@g$GoldGoal$。

source: You were unable to defeat %1, the English buccaneer, and have lost the ship to him.
text: 你未能击败英格兰私掠者%1，船也被他夺走了。

source: You were unable to defeat %1, the French buccaneer, and have lost the ship to him.
text: 你未能击败法国私掠者%1，船也被他夺走了。

source: You were unable to defeat %1, the Dutch buccaneer, and have lost the ship to him.
text: 你未能击败荷兰私掠者%1，船只被他夺走了。

source: You were unable to defeat %1, the Spanish buccaneer, and have lost the ship to him.
text: 你未能击败西班牙私掠者%1，船也被他夺走了。

source: Greetings, @A$USER$. I am offering you @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$ at a unit price of @g$Price$. Are you interested?
text: 你好，@A$USER$。我出售@a$Amount$的@G$Goods$，每单位@g$Price$。你有兴趣吗？

source: Hello @A$USER$. I have @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$. I would be happy to get rid of it at a unit price of @g$Price$. Are you interested?
text: 您好，@A$USER$。我有@a$Amount$的@G$Goods$，愿意以每单位@g$Price$出售。您有兴趣吗？

source: Would you be interested in @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$? I would only charge you a unit price of @g$Price$, but you would have to take the lot. Do you want to buy the goods?
text: 你想要@a$Amount$的@G$Goods$吗？我只收每单位@g$Price$，不过你必须全部买下。要买这些货物吗？

source: Then I shall charge you with bringing @T$TargetTown$ to the status "Flourishing economy" by @D$EndDate$. Bring the town the goods it needs and take away surplus goods, so that the resident traders start producing properly again.
text: 那么我就委托你在@D$EndDate$之前，让@T$TargetTown$达到“经济兴盛”状态。运去它所需的商品，运走过剩货物，让当地商人重新正常生产。

source: Growth of settlers in the town

Well done! Now you have a town of your own! No one but you may build in this town. <n><n>The town already has some buildings, such as the docks, where you can trade, and your palace. The rest you must build yourself.<n><n>Sail with your convoy to your town. Carry as much wood and as many bricks as you can because you'll need these to construct buildings.<n><n>First, build a shipyard, where you'll be able to repair your own ships.<n><n>Note:<n> It costs a lot to maintain the crew on your escort ships. You should dismiss the crew, as you no longer need them.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Visit your new town and build a shipyard.
text: 干得好！现在你拥有自己的城镇了！除你之外，任何人都不能在这里建造。<n><n>城镇里已经有一些建筑，例如可供交易的码头和你的宫殿。其余设施需要你亲自建造。<n><n>率领船队驶向你的城镇，尽量多带木材和砖，因为建造建筑需要它们。<n><n>首先建造一座造船厂，之后你就能在那里修理自己的船只了。<n><n>注意：<n>维持护航舰上的船员需要花费大量金钱。既然目前已经用不上他们，就应将船员遣散。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>前往你的新城镇，建造一座造船厂。

source: You cannot demolish this part of the large business, because this would be a building development for which you have no permission.
text: 不能拆除这片大型产业的一部分，因为这样改建需要你尚未获得的许可。

source: You now have a building permit for Cartagena and can establish businesses there. Your next objective is to build two weaving mills in Cartagena. A weaving mill is a business that produces finished goods and requires cotton as a raw material.<n><n>You must always have a supply of raw materials in your warehouse, or the business will be unable to produce any goods. However, the costs will still be high because you have to pay maintenance costs for each business and pay your workers.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Build two weaving mills in the town of Cartagena and produce @a$AmountGoal$ of cloth.
text: 你已取得卡塔赫纳的建筑许可证，可以在那里兴办产业。下一个目标是在卡塔赫纳建造两座纺织厂。纺织厂生产制成品，需要棉花作为原材料。<n><n>你的仓库中必须始终备有原材料，否则工厂将无法生产。不过，停工时的开支依然很高，因为每家企业都需要支付维护费和工人工资。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>在卡塔赫纳建造两座纺织厂，并生产@a$AmountGoal$布匹。

source: <ts:20>You have become an enemy of a nation for the first time. Here are some useful hints.<n>-<t>You only become an enemy if you attack the convoys and towns of a nation<n>-<t>You can bribe the governors of the nations, in order to improve your reputation. However, your reputation also automatically improves by a small amount every day, as your bad deeds are slowly forgotten<n>-<t>You may not dock in the harbor of enemy nations<n>-<t>If you sail to an enemy town in spite of this, you must anchor your convoy in secret: You can then enter the town, but you cannot trade there.
text: <ts:20>你第一次成为了某个国家的敌人。下面是一些有用的提示。<n>-<t>只有攻击某国的船队和城镇，才会与该国为敌<n>-<t>你可以贿赂各国总督来提高声望。随着人们逐渐淡忘你的恶行，声望每天也会自动小幅回升<n>-<t>你不能停靠敌对国家的港口<n>-<t>如果仍然驶向敌对城镇，就必须让船队秘密抛锚：这样可以进入城镇，但无法在那里交易。

source: This option disbands the convoy, dismisses the captain and the boarding crew and closes the Transfer window. Do you want to choose this option?
text: 此操作会解散船队，解雇船长和接舷水手，并关闭调配窗口。确定要这样做吗？

source: Donated by %1<n>on %2.<n><n>The school improves the quality of life in the town.
text: 由%1捐建<n>日期：%2。<n><n>学校提高了本城居民的生活质量。

source: As soon as you change a logo, the changed logo is automatically used in the game.<n>You can also create your own logos. You have to create these in the correct format in a specific directory (see the handbook).
text: 一旦更换徽标，游戏就会自动使用新的徽标。<n>您也可以自制徽标，但必须使用正确的格式，并放在指定目录中，详见手册。

source: You are @s$USER$, are you not? Would you not be interested in a treasure map? I only have a small scrap of it, but with luck you will find the remaining pieces!<n>I'll give you the piece for @g$Price$.
text: 你就是@s$USER$，对吧？有没有兴趣买一张藏宝图？我手里只有一小块碎片，不过运气好的话，你能找到剩下的！<n>这块碎片卖你@g$Price$。

source: @s$USER$, you are sure to be interested in a new treasure map, are you not? I'm afraid I can only give you a small piece of it, but I'm sure you'll find a few other pieces, with all the traveling you do.<n>I'm only asking @g$Price$ for it.
text: @s$USER$，你肯定对新的藏宝图有兴趣吧？可惜我只能给你一小片，不过你四处旅行，一定还能找到其他碎片。<n>我只要@g$Price$。

source: Greetings, @s$USER$. You look like just the sort of chap who might be interested in a treasure map. I have a part of a larger map here. I can't tell you where to find the remaining pieces, but there are sure to be other parts of the map in circulation. You'll just have to keep a sharp lookout.<n>In any case, you can have this piece for @g$Price$.
text: 你好，@s$USER$。看你的样子，一定会对藏宝图感兴趣。我这里有一张大地图的碎片。我不知道剩下的碎片在哪里，不过外面肯定还有其他部分在流传，你得多留心寻找。<n>总之，付@g$Price$，这块碎片就是你的了。

source: %1 workers are needed in the town.
name: IDPR_HDC_SIEDLER_NEED

source: Today, the %1 buccaneer %2 sneaked into the town and contaminated several wells. A plague has broken out in the town as a result. The quality of life has worsened and the demand for garments and wood is twice as high for one month.
text: 今天，%1私掠者%2潜入城镇，污染了几口水井，导致城内爆发瘟疫。生活质量恶化，接下来一个月内，服装和木材的需求翻倍。

source: The deadline for handing over the goods has expired.

You didn't manage to increase supplies of wheat, bricks, cotton, sugar and tobacco to 150 barrels. Buy the goods in nearby towns and deliver them immediately to your warehouse in Tortuga. Once you have them all, sell them to the town.
text: 你没能把小麦、砖、棉花、糖和烟草的库存分别增加到150桶。请到附近城镇购买，立即运到托尔图加的仓库。全部备齐后，再卖给城镇。

source: You have taken too long to search for the treasure.
text: 您寻找宝藏花费的时间太久了。

source: If I knew you better, I could also offer you missions and Letters of Marque. However, you need a permit in my town for this.
text: 要是我更了解你，就能给你任务和私掠许可证。不过，你得先在本城取得许可证。

source: Captain %1 assembles a new convoy.<n>The  convoy is seaworthy and waiting in the harbor.<n>The daily cost of the captain and basic crew is %2.
text: 船长%1组建了一支新船队。<n>船队已做好出航准备，正在港内待命。<n>船长与基本船员的每日费用为%2。

source: As you know, we are at war with @n$HostileNation$.<n><n>This would be a good time to fill our warehouses with goods that @n$HostileNation$ has in plentiful supply.<n><n>I want you to capture a substantial quantity of a particular good for me.
text: 你知道，我们正与@n$HostileNation$交战。<n><n>现在正适合拿@n$HostileNation$供应充足的货物填满我们的仓库。<n><n>我希望你替我夺取大量指定货物。

source: As we are at war with @n$HostileNation$, I have been ordered by the viceroy to see to it that our enemies suffer a goods shortage.<n><n>I therefore have a looting mission for you. Do you accept?
text: 我们正与@n$HostileNation$交战，殖民地总督命令我设法让敌人陷入货物短缺。<n><n>因此，我有一项劫掠任务交给你。你接受吗？

source: Have you heard tell of this pirate Blackbeard? His real name is Edward Teach and he is in possession of several convoys and for some time now they have been attacking traders of all nations with a great deal of success. However, no one has yet managed to arrest him.<n><n>I am therefore assigning you the task of tracking down one of his convoys and destroying it.
text: 你听说过海盗黑胡子吗？他的真名是爱德华·蒂奇，手下有好几支船队。这段时间，他们袭击各国商人，屡屡得手，却始终无人能将他逮捕。<n><n>因此，我命令你追踪并消灭他的一支船队。

source: The activities of Blackbeard's gang are already on the decline, but we cannot afford to rest on our laurels when it comes to those filthy scoundrels. I am therefore assigning you the task of destroying yet another of Blackbeard's convoys.
text: 黑胡子团伙的活动已经有所减少，但对付那些肮脏的恶棍，我们可不能沾沾自喜。我因此委托你再消灭一支黑胡子的船队。

source: The place lies somewhere in the northwest.
text: 那个地点位于西北方的某处。

source: This must be a position in the north.
This must be a location in the north.
The place must lie in the far northeast.
text: 地点一定在遥远的东北方。

source: The place is located somewhere in the west.
text: 那个地点位于西方的某处。

source: The place lies in the middle of the Caribbean.
text: 地点位于加勒比海中部。

source: This must be a position in the middle of the Caribbean.
text: 这应该是加勒比海中部的某个地点。

source: The place lies somewhere in the east.
text: 那个地方位于东面某处。

source: The place lies in the far southwest.
text: 地点位于遥远的西南方。

source: The place lies in the Southern Caribbean.
text: 地点位于加勒比海南部。

source: This must be a southerly location.
The place lies in the southeast Caribbean.
text: 地点位于加勒比海东南部。

source: While looting the town, your crew also discovered where the Governor's wife was hiding and "freed" the woman. She wasin the kitchen at the time.<n> "Don't take me back to the Governor in @T$TOWN$. I never loved him, I swear it!".<n><n>Do you want to take this woman with you and bring her back to the Governor despite her pleas ?
text: 劫掠城镇时，船员找到了总督妻子的藏身处，并把她“解救”了出来。她当时正在厨房里。<n>“别把我送回@T$TOWN$的总督那里！我从来没爱过他，我发誓！”<n><n>你要无视她的恳求，把她带回总督身边吗？

source: While looting the town, your men come across a young lad with a poodle. The boy tells you that the Governor of @T$TOWN$ staged the kidnapping himself, in order to get rid of the dog. The captain decides to take Michelle on board his ship. He then wonders if it is worth returning the dog to the Governor of @T$TOWN$.<n><n>Do you want to throw the dog overboard?
text: 劫掠城镇时，你的手下遇到一个带着贵宾犬的小男孩。男孩告诉你，这场绑架其实是@T$TOWN$的总督自导自演的，只为摆脱这条狗。船长决定把米歇尔带上船。随后，他开始琢磨是否值得把狗送回@T$TOWN$总督那里。<n><n>你想把这条狗扔到海里吗？

source: What rotten luck! I must have regular stocks of colonial goods for the transport convoys from Europe, but we don't have the tools to be able to produce these goods in the first place. Would you not like to help me to supply a town with tools?
text: 真倒霉！我得持续备好殖民地商品，供应来自欧洲的运输船队，可我们连生产这些商品所需的工具都没有。你愿意帮我向一座城镇供应工具吗？
