source: How could this happen! Supplies of tools have run low in @T$DestTown$ and now the production of colonial goods is threatened. Will you help me to solve this dilemma?
text: 怎么会这样！@T$DestTown$的工具供应不足，殖民地商品的生产已受到威胁。你愿意帮我化解这个困境吗？

source: My nation lacks tools. We should obtain them from the other nations. What do you think?
text: 我国缺少工具，应该从其他国家弄一些来。你觉得呢？

source: You have made me so happy! Hurry to my father, he'll be overjoyed!
text: 你让我太幸福了！快去见父亲吧，他一定会欣喜若狂！

source: @A$USER$, come here and sit down, I have some business to discuss with you.<n>I'm trying to buy @G$Goods$ for @n$HostileNation$. As you know, @n$Nation$ and @n$HostileNation$ are at war. In fact, it is now a punishable offence in @n$HostileNation$ to import @G$Goods$ from @n$Nation$, and good prices are being paid accordingly. So I'd like to ask you if you'd be interested in a little smuggling?
text: @A$USER$，过来坐，我有笔生意想和你谈谈。<n>我正在替@n$HostileNation$收购@G$Goods$。你知道，@n$Nation$和@n$HostileNation$正在交战。如今在@n$HostileNation$，从@n$Nation$进口@G$Goods$已是违法行为，因此价格也相当可观。所以我想问问，你有没有兴趣做点走私生意？

source: @A$USER$, would you be interested in a little smuggling? I am here on behalf of a trader from @T$TargetTown$. Due to the war, no goods may currently be transported from towns of @n$Nation$ to @T$TargetTown$. The man who sent me is interested in @G$Goods$. He will pay you @g$Price$ for each barrel you deliver him. What do you say?
text: @A$USER$，你有兴趣做点走私生意吗？我代表一位来自@T$TargetTown$的商人来找你。由于战争，目前禁止从@n$Nation$所属城镇向@T$TargetTown$运送货物。我的雇主想要@G$Goods$，你每运到一桶，他就付给你@g$Price$。你意下如何？

source: As a result of your continuing poor relationship with %1, %3 of your businesses in %2 were seized today.
text: 由于你与%1的关系持续恶化，你在%2的%3家企业今天遭到了没收。

source: <n>I would advise you to pay one of my Governors a visit in order to improve your relationship with my nation.
text: <n>我建议你去拜访我麾下的一位总督，改善你与我国的关系。

source: <n>I would advise you to pay me a visit so that we can discuss your relationship with my nation.
text: <n>我建议你来拜访我，好让我们谈谈你与我国的关系。

source: One of my rivals in @n$HostileNation$ has stolen my diaries and now wants to send them to Europe. It is vital that he does not succeed. Luckily, I was able to bribe the helmsman on the ship carrying the diaries to Europe. Now I need your help.
text: 我在@n$HostileNation$的一位对手偷走了我的日记，现在还想把它们送到欧洲。绝不能让他得逞！幸运的是，我已买通那艘运送日记的船上的舵手。现在我需要你的帮助。

source: We have been spied upon by @n$HostileNation$ for a long time. I have discovered that all the information gleaned has been carefully recorded and is now to be sent from @T$HostileTown$ to Europe. I want you to help me ensure that these documents never leave the Caribbean.
text: @n$HostileNation$长期以来一直在刺探我们的情报。我发现，他们搜集的情报都被仔细记录下来，如今正准备从@T$HostileTown$送往欧洲。我希望你帮我确保这些文件永远无法离开加勒比海。

source: <ts:20>You already know how to buy and sell goods in the Trade window. Here are some more tips:<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>The price shown on the arrows depends on the unit size<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>It doesn’t matter whether you buy or sell one good 10 times or buy or sell 10 goods once only. The total price is the same.<n><n><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>A price is always shown, even if a good is not available. This is always the price for a unit of goods, regardless of the unit size that is set.<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>You can also trade by clicking on the symbol for a good. When you do this, a small window containing a scrollbar appears. You can use this scrollbar to specify how many goods you want to buy or sell. The individual price and the total price are then immediately displayed.
text: <ts:20>你已经知道如何在贸易窗口买卖货物。这里再提供一些提示：<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>箭头上显示的价格取决于每次交易的数量<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>分十次各买卖一份货物，与一次买卖十份，支付或获得的总价完全相同。<n><n><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>即使某种商品没有库存，也会显示价格。此时显示的始终是单份商品的价格，不受所设交易数量影响。<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>你也可以点击商品图标进行交易。会出现一个带滑块的小窗口，可用滑块指定买卖数量，单价和总价也会立即显示。

source: You have found a very special ship!<n><n><g:INTEXT_BONUSSCHIFF_800x600.screen><n><n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>Steam-powered sailing ship<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><n>Never in your life have you seen such a ship! It seems to be powered not only by the sails on its twin masts, but also by a curious mechanism that uses steam to power two paddle wheels. Apparently, this allows the ship to keep moving even if there isn't a breath of wind.
text: 你发现了一艘极其特别的船！<n><n><g:INTEXT_BONUSSCHIFF_800x600.screen><n><n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>蒸汽动力帆船<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><n>你这辈子从未见过这样的船！它似乎不仅依靠双桅上的船帆驱动，还装有一套奇妙的机械，利用蒸汽带动两个明轮。显然，即使一丝风也没有，它仍能继续航行。

source: Your captain has won his sword fight against %1. Your men begin searching for the pirate treasure and find %2.<n><n>You have destroyed the hideout and ended the reign of pirate %3.
text: 你的船长在与%1的剑术决斗中获胜。手下开始搜寻海盗的财宝，找到了%2。<n><n>你摧毁了藏身处，结束了海盗%3的横行。

source: Your captain has won his sword fight with %1. Your men begin searching for the pirate treasure and find %2. While you have destroyed the hideout and successfully eliminated the dangers it posed, there are signs that you may not have destroyed all the ships. The remaining ships might seek out a new hideout.
text: 您的船长在剑术决斗中击败了%1。手下开始搜寻海盗的财宝，找到了%2。您摧毁了巢穴，消除了它带来的威胁，不过种种迹象表明，可能仍有船只漏网。残余船只或许会另寻新的巢穴。

source: You must accumulate @g$GoldGoal$ cash by trading.
text: 你必须通过贸易积累@g$GoldGoal$现金。

source: You have received a loan to the value of %1. The repayment is %2 and will be due on %3.
text: 你已获得%1的贷款。需偿还%2，还款期限为%3。

source: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>You have found a huge goods cache in the place the castaway described, and you take the goods on board.
text: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>你在落难者描述的地点找到了大批隐藏的货物，并把它们装上船。

source: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>You discover a huge goods cache in the place the castaway described.<n>Unfortunately your convoy has no more space left on board, so you will have to leave the goods behind for now.
text: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>你在落难者描述的地点发现了大批隐藏的货物。<n>可惜船队已经没有空余货舱，只能暂时把货物留在那里。

source: The convoy cannot set sail because it is currently in the shipyard for repair. Wait until the repairs have finished.
text: 船队无法出航，因为目前正在造船厂维修。请等待维修完成。

source: Sorry, I'm afraid I can no longer give you this mission. You have taken too long to think it over.
text: 抱歉，这项任务已经不能交给你了。你考虑得太久。

source: %1 is waiting for you at the inn.
Captain %1 has replaced the previous captain.

A workers' strike has been instigated in Tortuga. All of the workers have downed tools and are now on strike (but they are still incurring costs for your business).<n><n>Your task is to maintain ample stocks of the goods that the workers would normally produce, to ensure that the workers' strike fails and that they resume work.<n><n>Note: The town produces wheat, bricks, cotton, sugar and tobacco. <n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>The stocks of goods produced in the town must be @a$Amount$ for each good by @D$EndDate$.
text: 托尔图加发生了工人罢工。所有工人都放下工具，停止工作，但你的产业仍需支付费用。<n><n>你的任务是保持这些工人平日所生产商品的充足库存，让罢工失去作用，迫使他们复工。<n><n>注意：该城镇生产小麦、砖、棉花、糖和烟草。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>关卡目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>在@D$EndDate$之前，使该城镇生产的每种商品库存都达到@a$Amount$。

source: Go to the market in @T$Town$ within the next 30 days to collect your reward.
text: 请在未来30天内前往@T$Town$的市场领取报酬。

source: %1 has appointed a new governor named %2.

My daughter already mentioned you were coming. She can be very impetuous sometimes, you know. But I cannot stand in the way of my daughter's wishes, and I do believe you are the right man for her. And so I must ask you: will you take %1 as your wife?
text: 我女儿已经说过你会来。你知道，她有时会有些冲动。不过，我不能违背女儿的心愿，而且我也相信你是她的良配。那么，我必须问你：你愿意娶%1为妻吗？

source: Your next battle is going be a little more difficult because this time the enemy will resist. Your mission is to track down and kill a pirate for the governor.<n><n>But first you have to arm your convoy for the battle. Buy a ship, add it to your convoy and take new weapons and sailors on board.<n><n>You can press the F1 button at any time during the sea battle to display the keyboard and mouse configuration. <n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Arm your convoy and accomplish the new mission assigned to you by the Governor of Cartagena.
text: 下一场战斗会稍难一些，因为这次敌人会抵抗。你的任务是替总督追踪并消灭一名海盗。<n><n>但首先要武装船队。购买一艘船，编入船队，再补充武器和水手。<n><n>海战中随时按F1，都能查看键盘与鼠标操作说明。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>关卡目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>武装船队，完成卡塔赫纳总督交给你的新任务。

source: Visit the Governor of @T$TOWN$ and accept his mission.
text: 拜访@T$TOWN$总督，接受他的任务。

source: The level of difficulty determines the prices of goods and the damage inflicted in sea battles.<n><n>In addition, with a low level of difficulty, you do not need such a successful trading record in a town before you can purchase a building permit.
text: 难度会影响商品价格和海战伤害。<n><n>此外，在较低难度下，只需较少的城镇贸易贡献，就能获准购买建筑许可证。

source: Very good! Now pay a visit to the Spanish viceroy in Port Royale and accept a mission to capture a French town.<n><n>Usually, you have to capture two towns before a viceroy grants you a plot of land. However, in this scenario, you have a small bonus and only have to capture one town for Spain.<n><n>You can decide which town to capture. It is a good idea to choose a town with a minimum number of harbor cannons. One French town that would be an ideal target at present is @T$SampleTown$.<n><n>In return for capturing a town, the viceroy will grant you a plot of land. Note: You cannot speak with a viceroy unless you hold at least the rank of Boatswain.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Pay a visit to the Spanish viceroy in Port Royale and accept a mission to capture a town. After you have accomplished this mission, you can accept his gift of a plot of land.
text: 很好！现在去拜访皇家港的西班牙殖民地总督，接受占领一座法国城镇的任务。<n><n>通常，你必须占领两座城镇，殖民地总督才会赐予你一块土地。不过，在本剧本中你有一点优待，只需为西班牙占领一座城镇即可。<n><n>你可以自行决定攻击哪座城镇。最好选择港口火炮数量较少的目标。目前，@T$SampleTown$就是一座理想的法国目标城镇。<n><n>作为占领城镇的回报，殖民地总督会赐给你一块土地。注意：你的等级至少达到水手长，才能与殖民地总督交谈。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>拜访皇家港的西班牙殖民地总督，接受占领城镇的任务。完成任务后，领取他赏赐的土地。

source: <g:INTEXT_SCHATZKISTE_800x600.screen><n>You have found the hideout containing the Governor's treasure. You find @g$Gold$.
text: <g:INTEXT_SCHATZKISTE_800x600.screen><n>您找到了藏着总督财宝的隐秘地点，获得@g$Gold$。

source: You must deliver @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$ to the market in @T$TOWN$ by @D$Date$. You shall then receive @g$GoldPerBarrel$ for each <gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>.
text: 请在@D$Date$前，将@a$Amount$的@G$Goods$送到@T$TOWN$的市场。每<gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>货物，你将得到@g$GoldPerBarrel$。

source: You have sabotaged the town of @T$TargetTown$ and I thank you on behalf of my nation. I have a very special reward for you. I have persuaded a very experienced captain to join you. His name is @N$CaptainName$ and he awaits you at the inn.
text: 你成功破坏了@T$TargetTown$，我代表我国向你致谢。我为你准备了一份特别的报酬：我说服了一位经验丰富的船长加入你。他叫@N$CaptainName$，正在酒馆等你。

source: Do you want to buy a Letter of Marque for %1 and hunt down the ships of our enemies in the name of France?
text: 要花%1购买私掠许可证，以法国之名追击敌船吗？

source: Good! The convoy set sail from @T$HostileTown$ in the direction of Europe and will leave the Caribbean in the east. Search the entire route for the documents and bring them to me by @D$EndDate$.
text: 好！船队从@T$HostileTown$驶向欧洲，将从东面离开加勒比海。沿整条航路寻找文件，并在@D$EndDate$之前带回来。

source: You are a great help to me! If all goes according to plan, the helmsman will secretly throw the books overboard, one after the other. The ship has set sail from @T$HostileTown$, bound for Europe. Follow the ship and collect the books. Bring them to me by @D$EndDate$.
text: 你可真是帮了我的大忙！如果一切按计划进行，舵手会偷偷把那些书一本接一本扔下船。那艘船已经从@T$HostileTown$出发，正驶往欧洲。跟着它，把书捡起来，并在@D$EndDate$之前带给我。

source: Excellent. The ship has already left the harbor of @T$HostileTown$ bound for Europe. However, she is carrying a passenger who still owes me a favor. He will search the ship for documents and will secretly throw them overboard, one after the other. Your mission is to collect the documents and bring them to me by @D$EndDate$.
text: 太好了。那艘船已经离开@T$HostileTown$港口，正驶往欧洲。不过，船上有一位乘客还欠我一个人情。他会在船上寻找文件，然后一份接一份地偷偷扔到海里。你的任务是收集这些文件，并在@D$EndDate$之前带给我。

source: The harbor defenses are destroyed and your crew dock in the harbor. The town guard is nowhere to be seen.<n><n>What do you want to do now?
text: 港口防御已被摧毁，你的船员驶入港口靠岸。城镇守军不见踪影。<n><n>接下来你想怎么做？

source: You cannot visit the teacher. Your convoy must have @a$Amount$ of wine on board.
text: 目前无法拜访导师。你的船队必须携带@a$Amount$葡萄酒。

source: You cannot visit the teacher. Your convoy must have @a$Amount$ of rum on board.
text: 你无法拜访导师，船队必须携带@a$Amount$朗姆酒。

source: You cannot visit the teacher. Your convoy must have @a$Amount$ of food on board.
text: 无法拜访导师。船队必须带有@a$Amount$食物。

source: Your reputation in %1 is too low for you to be granted a meeting with the general.
text: 你在%1的声望太低，无法获准面见将军。

source: Excellent! You increased the population of @T$TOWN$ to 1,500 within @I$Days$ days.
text: 太好了！你在@I$Days$天内把@T$TOWN$的人口增加到了1,500。

source: An English military convoy has destroyed a convoy belonging to the pirate %1.
text: 一支英格兰军事船队摧毁了海盗%1的一支船队。

source: A French military convoy has destroyed a convoy belonging to the pirate %1.
text: 一支法国军事船队摧毁了海盗%1的一支船队。

source: A Dutch military convoy has destroyed a convoy belonging to the pirate %1.
text: 一支荷兰军事船队摧毁了海盗%1的一支船队。

source: A Spanish military convoy has destroyed a convoy belonging to the pirate %1.
text: 一支西班牙军事船队消灭了海盗%1的一支船队。

source: I thank you. Please bring me @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$. You have until @D$Date$ to deliver the goods to the market. There, you will receive @g$GoldPerBarrel$ for each <gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>.
text: 谢谢。请给我送来@a$Amount$@G$Goods$。你必须在@D$Date$之前把货物交到市场，届时每<gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>可获得@g$GoldPerBarrel$。

source: Please deliver @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$ to my emissaries in the market. You have until @D$Date$. On delivery, you shall receive @g$GoldPerBarrel$ for each <gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>.
text: 请在@D$Date$之前，把@a$Amount$的@G$Goods$交给市场上的使者。每交付一<gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>，即可获得@g$GoldPerBarrel$。

source: Sail to towns belonging to @n$FoeNation$ and collect @G$Goods$. Deliver @a$Amount$ to the market in my town by @D$Date$. You will receive @g$GoldPerBarrel$ for each <gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>.
text: 驶往@n$FoeNation$所属城镇收集@G$Goods$。在@D$Date$前向本城市场交付@a$Amount$。每<gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>货物，你将得到@g$GoldPerBarrel$。

source: <n><n>The scenario is over when you close this window.
text: <n><n>关闭这个窗口后，剧本即告结束。

source: I am most grateful to you for bringing me the imported goods, for we in the New World have not been supplied by my nation's transport convoys for many weeks now. As a reward, I am presenting you with two Dutch trading flute-ships. They are waiting for you in the harbor.
text: 非常感谢您带来这些进口商品。我国的运输船队已经好几个星期没有给新世界补给了。作为报答，我送您两艘荷兰商用福禄特帆船。它们就在港内等您。

source: I cannot tell you how many more towns the treasure fleet will visit. All we can say for sure is that the fleet takes more gold on board with every town it visits. I don't care when you attack, because you can keep the gold. All I want you to do is ensure that the treasure fleet disappears. It was last in @T$StartTown$, and its next port of call is @T$DestTown$, where it will lie at anchor for about five days.
text: 我不清楚宝船队还会停靠多少座城镇。只能确定，它每到一座城镇，都会装上更多黄金。你什么时候进攻都无所谓，黄金可以归你；我只要宝船队消失。它最近停在@T$StartTown$，下一站是@T$DestTown$，会在那里停泊约五天。

source: So you must act quickly. It was last in @T$StartTown$, from there it set off for @T$DestTown$, where it will anchor for longer than usual. The longer you hold off your attack, the more gold it will have on board. You can keep the lot, but the treasure fleet must never reach Europe.
text: 所以你必须尽快行动。它最后停靠在@T$StartTown$，随后驶向@T$DestTown$，在那里会比平时停留得更久。你越晚发动袭击，船上积攒的黄金就越多。黄金全归你，但宝船队绝不能抵达欧洲。

source: That's agreed then, thank you. If my information is correct, the treasure fleet recently left @T$StartTown$ and is en route to @T$DestTown$. There it will anchor for longer than usual. Now make haste and intercept it!
text: 那就说定了，谢谢。若情报无误，宝船队刚离开@T$StartTown$，正在前往@T$DestTown$，并会在那里比平时停留更久。赶快出发拦截它吧！

source: If you want as many traders as possible to visit your town, you should simply not supply your town with certain goods. You should ideally choose goods that are produced in nearby towns, because traders will take the length of the journey involved into consideration.<n><n>Traders who visit your town automatically buy goods that are in abundance and therefore have low prices in your town. You can also sell the goods you have produced to your town directly. As long as the goods are not more expensive than in other towns, they will be purchased regularly by traders.<n><n>The advantage of this is that there are always enough goods available for your citizens and you also don't have to worry about transporting the goods to other towns.
text: 如果想吸引尽可能多的商人到访，可以故意不向城镇供应某些货物。最好选择附近城镇生产的货物，因为商人会考虑运输距离。<n><n>到访的商人会自动购买本城供应充足、价格低廉的货物。你也可以把自产货物直接卖给城镇。只要价格不高于其他城镇，商人就会定期收购。<n><n>这样做的好处是，居民始终有足够货物可用，而你也不用操心将货物运往其他城镇。

The place lies somewhere in the bay of %1.

source: Destroy the convoy belonging to the trader @N$Name$. His hometown is @T$Town$. You have until @D$EndDate$.
text: 消灭商人@N$Name$的船队。他的家乡是@T$Town$。期限为@D$EndDate$。

source: Congratulations! You have successfully completed this scenario and now have some experience of sea battles and port attacks.<n><n>Always make sure your escort ships are well armed before you attack another convoy. Of course, you should also think very carefully before deciding which convoys to attack. Transport convoys from Europe and military convoys are always very powerful and pirates can sometimes become powerful opponents too.<n><n>If you attack traders without first obtaining a Letter of Marque from the Governor of a nation, this has a major influence on your reputation with all nations.  At worst, powerful military convoys will pursue your convoy.<n><n>A word of advice: If you capture a trading convoy without sinking its ships and only loot it, the negative impact on your reputation is much smaller.
text: 恭喜！你已成功完成本剧本，并积累了一些海战和港口进攻的经验。<n><n>攻击其他船队之前，务必让你的护航舰配备充足的武装。当然，选择攻击目标时也应慎重考虑。来自欧洲的运输船队和军事船队总是十分强大，海盗有时也会成为难缠的对手。<n><n>若未先从某国总督手中取得私掠许可证就攻击商人，你在所有国家的声望都会受到严重影响。最糟糕时，强大的军事船队会追捕你的船队。<n><n>一个建议：如果你击败商船队时没有击沉其船只，而且只劫掠货物、不夺取船只，对声望的负面影响就会小得多。

source: Last night, the %1 buccaneer %2 sneaked into the town and destroyed all the crop farms along with their harvest. You cannot harvest again for approximately 2 weeks.
text: 昨夜，%1私掠者%2潜入城镇，摧毁了所有农田及其收成。大约两周内，农田都无法再次收获。
摧毁黑胡子的海盗巢穴。

source: The Spanish treasure fleet has anchored in the town of %1
text: 西班牙运宝船队已在%1下锚

source: Visit the Spanish viceroy in Port Royale and accept a mission to capture towns on his behalf. After you have accomplished this mission, you can accept his gift of a plot of land.
text: 拜访皇家港的西班牙殖民地总督，接受替他夺取城镇的任务。完成任务后，就可以接受他赠送的土地。

source: Produce cocoa in Santa Marta and build up a supply of @a$AmountGoal$ in your warehouse.
text: 在圣玛尔塔生产可可，并在仓库中储备@a$AmountGoal$。

source: Unfortunately, I cannot search for survivors as none of my ships are currently available. Couldn't you take on this task?
text: 遗憾的是，我目前没有可用的船，无法搜寻幸存者。你能接下这项任务吗？
应用程序框架与工作流程

source: You have done absolutely nothing about the abduction. I am left with no choice but to agree to the terms of @n$HostileNation$.
text: 对于这起绑架，你根本什么都没做。我已经别无选择，只能答应@n$HostileNation$的条件。

source: <ts:20>You should know the following about goods:<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>-<t>There are five different types of goods: essential goods, raw materials, finished goods, colonial goods and import goods<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>Each town can produce five goods<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>There are two types of town: colonial towns and towns with a governor or viceroy<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>Governor towns produce essential goods and finished goods. They also receive regular deliveries of import goods from Europe. These towns are therefore the best places to find finished goods and import goods.<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>-<t>Governor towns need raw materials to produce finished goods. They also take in colonial goods. These are collected from the transport convoys from Europe.<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>-<t>Colonial towns produce essential goods, raw materials and colonial goods. Each colonial good can only be produced in certain areas of the Caribbean. Coffee, for instance, is only available in the south and west of the Caribbean.<n><n>You should know the following about prices:<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>The greater the demand for a good and the smaller the supply of it in a town, the higher the price will be.<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>The better your reputation in a nation, the lower the price at which you will be able to buy goods in towns belonging to that nation.<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>You should only buy goods in the towns where they are produced.<n><n>The fastest way to get money:<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>buy colonial goods and raw materials in colonial towns<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>sell these goods in governor towns and buy finished products and import goods there.
text: <ts:20>关于货物，你需要了解以下几点：<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>-<t>货物分为五类：生活必需品、原材料、制成品、殖民地特产和进口商品。<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>每座城镇可以生产五种货物。<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>城镇分为两类：殖民地城镇，以及总督或殖民地总督驻地。<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>总督驻地生产生活必需品和制成品，也定期接收来自欧洲的进口商品。因此，这些城镇是购买制成品和进口商品的最佳去处。<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>-<t>总督驻地需要原材料来生产制成品，也收购殖民地特产。来自欧洲的运输船队会将这些特产运走。<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>-<t>殖民地城镇生产生活必需品、原材料和殖民地特产。每种特产只能在加勒比海的某些地区生产。例如，咖啡只产于加勒比海的南部和西部。<n><n>关于价格，你需要了解以下几点：<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>一座城镇对某种货物的需求越大、供应越少，价格就越高。<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>你在某个国家的声望越高，在该国城镇购买货物的价格就越低。<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>尽量只在货物的产地购买该货物。<n><n>最快的赚钱办法：<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>在殖民地城镇购买特产和原材料。<n><n><gs:TEXTFLUSS_BASELINE><g:INTEXT_AUSRUF_800x600.screen>将其运往总督驻地出售，再在那里购买制成品和进口商品。

source: Donated by %1<n>on %2.<n><n>The hospital reduces the risk of plagues and improves the quality of life in the town.
text: 由%1捐建<n>日期：%2。<n><n>医院可以降低瘟疫风险，并改善城镇的生活质量。

source: This challenging scenario is all about trade, production and goods supplies in a town.<n:25>Strange things are happening in Tortuga: Hardly any traders want to visit the town and several events are making life difficult for its citizens. Your task is to save the town from ruin. At the end of the scenario, your score will be displayed. It depends on your speed and on your wealth at the end of the scenario.<n:25>In this scenario, you can use all the options offered in free-play mode but you will also have specific objectives to achieve.
text: 这个颇具挑战的剧本围绕一座城镇的贸易、生产和货物供应展开。<n:25>托尔图加怪事频发：几乎没有商人愿意到访，一连串事件又让居民的生活雪上加霜。你的任务是拯救这座濒临毁灭的城镇。剧本结束时会显示你的得分，分数取决于完成速度和最终财富。<n:25>本剧本提供自由游戏中的全部玩法，但你还需要完成一系列明确目标。

source: One of your convoys has docked unnoticed in the harbor of  %1.
text: 你的一支船队悄悄停靠在%1的港口，没有被人发现。
完成总督的下一项任务。

source: Famine has broken out in %1. While the famine rages, the price of wheat, fruit, corn and meat will rise.
text: %1发生饥荒。饥荒持续期间，小麦、水果、玉米和肉类的价格都会上涨。

source: <ts:80><ts:160>I have learned the following from talking to traders:<n><n>The four most expensive goods in %1 are:<n><n>%2<t>%3%<t>%4<n>%5<t>%6%<t>%7<n>%8<t>%9%<t>%10<n>%11<t>%12%<t>%13<n><n>(100% = normal production price)
I thank you. Search the waters outside the town. You may find clues as to the drunkards' whereabouts. I can only wait here until @D$EndDate$, please don't delay!
text: 谢谢你。搜查城外的海域，或许能找到那些醉汉下落的线索。我只能在这里等到@D$EndDate$，请别耽搁！

source: You are truly generous. Search the waters outside the town, you may find clues as to where the drunkards congregate. I can only wait here until @D$EndDate$, please don't delay!
text: 你真是慷慨。去城外海面搜寻一下，也许能找到那些酒鬼聚集之处的线索。我只能在这里等到@D$EndDate$，请别耽搁！

source: Maximum reached for this town size
text: 已达当前城镇规模的上限

source: See to it that the status of the town of @T$TargetTown$, which belongs to @n$HostileNation$, drops to "Recession“ by @D$EndDate$.
The traveler has boarded the convoy. Bring him to @T$TargetTown$ by @D$EndDate$ .
text: 旅客已登上船队。请在@D$EndDate$前将他送到@T$TargetTown$。

source: Your Letter of Marque against %1 is no longer valid.
text: 你针对%1的私掠许可证已失效。

source: One of our transport convoys was recently attacked and captured by pirates. I am concerned about the fate of the settler families on board the captured ships. We are currently searching the area around the location where the attack took place. Could you also take on the task of searching another area?
text: 我们的一支运输船队最近遭到海盗袭击并被俘获。我很担心船上那些移民家庭的命运。目前，我们正在袭击地点周围搜寻。你能帮忙搜索另一片海域吗？

source: Some of the settlers were unhappy with the working conditions in @T$SampleTown$ and left in a rickety rowing boat. They have not been seen since. Could you help me search for them?
text: 一些移民不满@T$SampleTown$的工作条件，乘着一艘破旧的小划艇离开了，之后再也没有消息。您能帮我找找他们吗？

source: Are you sure you want to quit the game and return to Windows?
text: 确定要退出游戏，返回Windows吗？

source: You have defeated your adversary and boarded a ship.<n><n>You now have to decide which goods you want to take and whether you want to capture the ship or just loot it.
text: 您击败了对手，并登上了一艘敌船。<n><n>现在需要决定拿走哪些货物，以及俘获这艘船还是只掠夺货物。

source: You have defeated your adversary and boarded several ships.<n><n>You now have to decide which goods you want to take and whether you want to capture the ships or just loot them.
text: 你击败了对手，并登上了数艘敌船。<n><n>现在需要决定带走哪些货物，以及要俘获这些船，还是只劫走货物。

source: You are still too inexperienced for your first mission. Come back to me as soon as you have reached the rank of Sailor, perhaps I will have a job for you then.<n><n>Your rank will rise if you accumulate further assets.
text: 你目前还缺乏经验，暂时无法接受第一项任务。等达到水手等级后再来找我，也许到时我会有工作交给你。<n><n>积累更多资产，就能提升你的等级。

source: Prevents trade routes from depleting minimum stock level
text: 防止贸易航线动用最低保留库存

source: Prevents trade routes from breaching the maximum stock level
text: 防止贸易航线补货超过库存上限
船长贸易时排除此货物

source: Add untraded goods to captain trading
text: 将未交易货物纳入船长贸易

source: Add untraded goods to manual trading
text: 将未交易商品加入手动贸易
手动贸易时排除此货物

source: Congratulations! You have successfully completed the second scenario. You have learned how to trade profitably, reached a higher rank and assembled a new convoy by hiring a new captain.<n><n>Note that the more experience captains have, the more expensive they are. They usually have very little experience at first but, over time, all captains gain experience in navigation, trade and combat, depending on how you employ them. You can check the current experience levels of your captains in the Overview for a convoy. To do so, click on a convoy and then on the "Overview and Costs" button.<n><n>In the next scenario, you'll establish your own businesses and produce goods.
text: 恭喜！你成功完成了第二关。你学会了如何通过贸易获利，提升了等级，还通过雇用新船长组建了一支新船队。<n><n>请注意，船长经验越丰富，雇用费用越高。船长最初通常经验不足，但随着时间推移，会根据你安排的工作积累航海、贸易和战斗经验。你可以在船队概览中查看船长当前的经验水平：先点击船队，再点击“概览与费用”按钮。<n><n>下一关中，你将建立自己的产业并生产商品。

source: <ts:0><ts:160>with convoy selected on:<n>sea chart/Mini Map<t>send convoy<n>- with CTRL<t>set route point<n>created convoy<t>transfer<n>harbor<t>ship transfer
text: <ts:0><ts:160>选中船队后点击：<n>海图／小地图<t>派遣船队<n>- 按住CTRL<t>设置航路点<n>已有船队<t>转移<n>港口<t>转移船只

source: Due to your troops' superiority, the soldiers of the town guard capitulate and your men begin to look for the treasure chamber without meeting any resistance. They loot %1.
text: 由于你的部队实力占优，城镇守军投降。你的手下毫无阻碍地开始寻找藏宝室，劫获了%1。

source: Your convoy succeeds in breaching the harbor defenses. Your sailors disembark and search for the pirate treasure without meeting any resistance. They loot %1.
text: 你的船队成功突破了港口防线。水手登岸搜寻海盗宝藏，没有遇到抵抗。他们掠得了%1。

source: I knew I could trust you. It concerns the town of @T$TargetTown$, which belongs to @n$HostileNation$. Attack the town and loot it for all I care, then seek out my wife. Don’t delay, as I have only been given until @D$EndDate$ to think it over.<n><n>If you do not yet possess a Letter of Marque against @n$HostileNation$, I will give you one.
text: 我就知道你值得信赖。她被关在@n$HostileNation$所属的@T$TargetTown$。去攻打那座城镇吧，劫掠也无所谓，然后找到我的妻子。务必抓紧，对方只让我考虑到@D$EndDate$。<n><n>如果你还没有针对@n$HostileNation$的私掠许可证，我会给你一份。

source: My wife will be overjoyed. The poodle Michelle is hidden in @T$TargetTown$. Loot the town so that it looks like a military mission and then search for the dog. You have until @D$EndDate$.<n>Believe me, it will give me no pleasure to see the dog again, but my wife's sniveling shows no sign of abating.<n><n>If you do not yet possess a Letter of Marque against @n$HostileNation$, I will give you one.
text: 我妻子一定会高兴坏的。贵宾犬米歇尔被藏在@T$TargetTown$。请劫掠这座城镇，让行动看起来像一项军事任务，然后搜寻那条狗。期限是@D$EndDate$。<n>相信我，再见到这条狗并不会让我开心，可我妻子的哭闹一直没有停下来的意思。<n><n>如果你还没有针对@n$HostileNation$的私掠许可证，我会给你一张。

source: That's agreed then. Please loot @T$TargetTown$ and return my daughter to me. Her birthday is on @D$EndDate$ and she must be back here again for this special occasion.<n><n>If you do not yet possess a Letter of Marque against @n$HostileNation$, I will give you one.
text: 那就说定了。请劫掠@T$TargetTown$，把我女儿带回来。她的生日是@D$EndDate$，在这个特殊的日子到来之前，她必须回到这里。<n><n>如果你还没有针对@n$HostileNation$的私掠许可证，我会给你一张。

source: Then so it shall be. But before I entrust her to you, you must procure the goods for the banquet. Meet my wedding banquet organizer at the market.<n><n>The banquet will be held as soon as you have delivered all of the goods.
text: 那就这么定了。不过，在把她托付给你之前，你必须筹齐宴会所需的货物。请到市场与婚宴筹办人见面。<n><n>全部货物交齐后，宴会便会举行。

source: You have not delivered the goods in time.
Today, @N$OwnerName$ came aboard the convoy. Bring him to @T$TargetTown$ before @D$EndDate$.
text: 今天，@N$OwnerName$登上了船队。请在@D$EndDate$之前把他送到@T$TargetTown$。

source: You may now control 2 captains and own 1 permit.
text: 现在你可以雇用2名船长，并拥有1张许可证。

source: You may now control %1 captains and own %2 permits.
text: 现在你可以雇用%1名船长，并拥有%2张许可证。

source: You may now control any number of captains and own 10 permits.
text: 现在你可以雇用任意数量的船长，并拥有10张许可证。

source: The number of captains and permits you are allowed is now unlimited.
text: 您可雇用的船长和持有的许可证数量不再受限。

source: You may now control %1 captains and own %2 concession.<n>You have just received a message containing hints on the subject of “reputation”.
text: 你现在可以指挥%1位船长，持有%2张建筑许可证。<n>你刚刚收到一条关于“声望”的提示消息。

source: You did not manage to deliver the goods in time for the feast.<n><n>%1 is angry with you and never wants to see you again.
text: 你没能及时交付宴会所需的货物。<n><n>%1很生气，再也不想见到你。

source: You did not manage to deliver the goods in time for the feast.<n><n>%1 wants nothing more to do with you.
text: 你没能及时交付宴会所需的货物。<n><n>%1不想再与你有任何瓜葛。

source: This is the clue that can lead you to a hoard of treasure:<n><n>
text: 以下线索能指引您找到一处宝藏：<n><n>

source: Now accomplish the mission assigned to you by the Governor of @T$TOWN$.
text: 现在完成@T$TOWN$总督交给你的任务。

source: You have failed to breach the town's defenses.
You are in the colonial town of Santa Marta. Click on the town name to display the town information.
text: 你正位于殖民地城镇圣玛尔塔。点击城镇名称，查看城镇信息。

source: Colonial towns like Santa Marta can produce two essential goods, two raw materials and one colonial good.<n>In the last scenario, you learned that there is a particularly high demand for raw materials and colonial goods in governor towns.<n>You want to produce the colonial good cocoa first.<n>Now close the town information.
text: 像圣玛尔塔这样的殖民地城镇，可以生产两种生活必需品、两种原材料和一种殖民地特产。<n>上一个剧本中，你已经了解到，总督驻地对原材料和殖民地特产的需求尤其旺盛。<n>你打算先生产特产可可。<n>现在关闭城镇信息。

source: Since colonial goods are shipped to Europe from governor towns, the demand for cocoa in these towns is high. These conditions are good for your first business. Now locate and click on the master builder's building in the center of the town.
text: 殖民地特产经由总督驻地运往欧洲，因此这些城镇对可可的需求很高。这为你的第一家企业提供了良好条件。现在到城镇中心找到建筑师的建筑，并点击它。

source: At the master builder's, you can apply for permission to construct a new building or return your building permit. This is not what you want to do now of course!<n>Look at the different buildings you can construct. You can also use the buttons on the right of the Master Builder window.<n>Click on the Cocoa Plantation button.
text: 在建筑师那里，你可以申请建造新建筑的许可，也可以交回建筑许可证。当然，现在可不是要把许可证交回去！<n>看看有哪些建筑可建造，也可以使用建筑师窗口右侧的按钮。<n>点击“可可种植园”按钮。

source: You can now see how many building materials are required and what the construction costs will be.<n>You can also see how many building materials you currently have in your warehouse and how many you'll have to buy from the town.<n>You have enough materials at present.<n>Position your cursor on an available construction site and left-click on it.
text: 现在你能看到所需建材数量，以及建造费用。<n>你还能查看仓库里已有多少建材，以及需要从城镇购买多少。<n>目前材料足够。<n>将鼠标移到一处可用工地上，点击左键。

source: The scaffolding of the cocoa production facility is now displayed and construction begins.<n>It will take a couple of days for construction to be completed. In the meantime, you should organize accommodation for your new workers.<n>Close the Construction menu and look for a residential area in Santa Marta.
text: 可可生产设施的脚手架已经出现，工程开始了。<n>建造还需要几天时间。趁此机会，你应该为新工人安排住处。<n>关闭建设菜单，在圣玛尔塔寻找一片住宅区。

source: This residential area belongs to a trader from the town. You can check how many residential areas are owned by local traders and how many tenants they have. You want to build your own residential area. To do so, open the Construction menu.
text: 这片住宅区属于一位当地商人。你可以查看当地商人拥有多少住宅区，以及其中住了多少租户。你想建造自己的住宅区，为此请打开建造菜单。

source: Select a residential area in the Construction menu and look at the construction costs display. <n>You may not have enough building materials in storage. However, you can buy any materials that you need in the town if they are in sufficient supply. <n>Otherwise, you'll have to source them in another town.<n>Then build a residential area.
text: 在建造菜单中选择住宅区，查看显示的建造费用。<n>你的仓库里可能没有足够的建材。不过，只要城镇供应充足，就可以就地购买所需材料。<n>否则，你得去其他城镇采购。<n>接下来建造一片住宅区。

source: A business can employ 30 workers. Since there are four family members in an average worker's family, living quarters for 120 people are required for each business you establish. <n>A residential area has space for 120 tenants and so one residential area is required for each business.<n>Now close the Construction menu and click on your new residential area.
text: 一处产业可以雇用30名工人。工人家庭平均有四口人，因此每开办一处产业，就需要可容纳120人的住处。<n>一片住宅区能住120人，所以每处产业需要配一片住宅区。<n>现在关闭建设菜单，点击新建的住宅区。

source: There is no construction period for a residential area because the tenants live in tents at first.<n>Over time, the tenants themselves develop the residential area into a very sizeable building.<n>The appearance of a residential area depends on how old it is and on the status of the town.<n>Close the residential area dialog.
text: 住宅区没有建造期，因为住户起初都住在帐篷里。<n>随着时间推移，住户会自行将住宅区发展成相当可观的建筑。<n>住宅区的外观取决于它的历史长短和城镇的经济状况。<n>关闭住宅区对话框。

source: As you know, your first building in a town must always be a warehouse. You cannot construct any other buildings until you have built this.<n>You already have a warehouse in the town where you started the game. Find it and click on it. It is shown in light blue on the screen.
text: 你知道，在一座城镇建造的第一座建筑必须是仓库。有了仓库，才能建其他建筑。<n>你在游戏起始城镇已经拥有仓库。找到并点击它，画面中它显示为浅蓝色。

source: In the warehouse, you can see which buildings you own in the town and what it costs to maintain them.<n>You can also see how much rent your tenants pay you and what goods your businesses are producing.<n>Later, you'll be able to give the storekeeper instructions.<n>Have a look around the warehouse and then close it.
text: 仓库中会显示你在城里拥有的建筑，以及维持它们所需的费用。<n>你还可以查看租户缴纳的租金，以及各家企业正在生产的货物。<n>稍后，你将可以给仓库管理员下达指令。<n>先浏览一下仓库，然后将其关闭。

source: the military presence in this town could be better
text: 本城的驻军还有待加强

source: Click on your cocoa plantation. The display always shows all of your cocoa plantations in the town.<n>Once your production facilities are constructed, you’ll need 30 workers, that is, 30 settlers. Now leave the plantation, go to the docks in the harbor and press the “Cargo” button (the bottom button on the right).
text: 点击你的可可种植园。面板会统一显示你在本城拥有的全部可可种植园。<n>生产设施建成后，需要30名工人，也就是30名移民。现在离开种植园，前往港口码头，按下“货物”按钮（右侧最下方的按钮）。

source: Here you can see if there are any settlers waiting to be hired in the town or if the town needs new workers. This will be the case as soon as construction of your business has been completed.<n>Go to the surrounding governor towns and bring settlers to Santa Marta until your business is employing a full complement of workers.
text: 这里会显示城镇中是否有等待雇用的移民，以及城镇是否缺少工人。您的企业竣工后，就会需要新工人。<n>前往周边设有总督的城镇，把移民运到圣玛尔塔，直到企业的工人全部招满。

source: Click on one of your cocoa plantations.
text: 点击你的一座可可种植园。

source: You can now see how much cocoa your business is producing each day and how many tools this requires.<n>Now build up a supply of @a$SubGoal$ of tools in your warehouse because your warehouse supplies goods to your businesses.
text: 现在，你可以看到企业每天生产多少可可，以及需要消耗多少工具。<n>请在仓库中储备@a$SubGoal$工具，因为你的企业会从仓库领取生产所需的货物。

source: Tools are imported goods. This means that you'll find the most plentiful supply and the lowest prices in governor towns.<n>You could try to source some in Cartagena to the southwest or far to the east in Margarita .
text: 工具属于进口商品。因此，总督驻地的供应最充足，价格也最低。<n>你可以去西南方的卡塔赫纳，或者远在东方的玛格丽塔采购。

source: Well done!<n>The lower the average price of the raw materials your require, the lower your production costs for the goods you produce.<n>Now continue to produce cocoa until you have a supply of @a$AmountGoal$ in your warehouse.
text: 干得好！<n>所需原材料的平均采购价越低，制成商品的生产成本就越低。<n>现在继续生产可可，直到仓库库存达到@a$AmountGoal$。

source: %1,<n>you’re new here, aren't you? But I have already heard tell of you, and your good name precedes you. You should pay me a visit now and then, as there is always some work to be done.
text: %1，<n>你是新来的吧？不过我已经听说过你，你的好名声先一步传来了。以后不妨常来看看，我这里总有事需要人做。

source: Sail with your convoy to the town of Cartagena and enter the town.<n>A small circle symbol is displayed below the town name on the right of the screen. This shows your trading record in Cartagena up to now.<n>Things are a little easier for you in this scenario because you have received a bonus.<n>Now open the town information.
text: 率领船队驶往卡塔赫纳并进入城镇。<n>屏幕右侧的城镇名称下方有一个小圆形图标，显示你目前在卡塔赫纳的贸易贡献。<n>本剧本给了你额外加成，因此事情会稍微容易一些。<n>现在打开城镇信息。

source: Under "Trading Record", you can now check what percentage of the required score you have already achieved. If 100% is displayed here, you can apply for a permit from the master builder.<n>Close the town information.
text: 在“贸易贡献”一栏，你可以查看自己已达到要求的百分之几。当这里显示100%时，就可以向建筑师申请许可证。<n>关闭城镇信息。

source: The prices of goods that are scarce in a town are shown in red in the trade window. If you sell these goods, you will improve both your trading record in the town and your reputation with the nation to which the town belongs.<n>Click once on the docks to display information on the stock of goods in the town.
text: 城镇中短缺货物的价格，会在贸易窗口里以红色显示。出售这些货物，既能改善你在城镇中的贸易表现，也能提高你在该城所属国家的声望。<n>单击码头，即可查看城镇的货物库存信息。

source: Note which goods are lacking in the town. For example, the town will always need sugar and cotton because it produces rum and garments.<n>But there are other scarce goods in the town also.<n>Go to other towns to buy the goods that Cartagena needs and improve your trading record.
text: 留意城镇缺少哪些商品。例如，这里生产朗姆酒和服装，所以始终需要糖和棉花。<n>不过，城里还有其他短缺商品。<n>前往其他城镇采购卡塔赫纳所需的货物，提高您对这里的贸易贡献。

source: Not bad! You have raised your profile in Cartagena considerably.<n>But be careful not to buy up any scarce goods in Cartagena! You can easily recognize scarce goods because the stocks of these goods are displayed in red.<n>Increase your trading record score to 85%.
text: 不错！你在卡塔赫纳的地位已经提高了不少。<n>但要小心，不要买走卡塔赫纳短缺的货物！这类货物的库存会以红色显示，很容易辨认。<n>将你的贸易表现评分提高到85%。

source: Well done! You now have a score of 85% in Cartagena. Keep up the good work!<n>Increase your score to 100%.<n>By the way, you have just received a message about "promotion and ranks".
text: 干得好！你在卡塔赫纳的评分已经达到85%。继续努力！<n>把评分提高到100%。<n>另外，你刚收到一条关于“晋升与等级”的消息。

source: Excellent! You have now done enough trade with Cartagena.<n>Unfortunately, your rank is still Ordinary Sailor and so you can only be granted one permit.<n>To be promoted to the next rank, you must increase your wealth by trading some more.
text: 太好了！你与卡塔赫纳的贸易往来已经足够。<n>可惜你目前仍是普通水手等级，只能持有一张许可证。<n>继续贸易，增加财富，才能晋升下一级。

source: Very good! As a Sailor, you can be granted two building permits.<n>Go to the master builder in Cartagena and apply for a permit.<n>If you don't have enough gold, you must trade some more. Don't forget to trade the goods that you are producing in Santa Marta.
text: 很好！达到水手等级后，你可以取得两张建筑许可证。<n>去卡塔赫纳找到建筑师，申请许可证。<n>如果金币不够，就再做些贸易。别忘了出售你在圣玛尔塔生产的货物。

source: You must first build a warehouse in Cartagena before you can construct any other buildings.
text: 你必须先在卡塔赫纳建造仓库，才能兴建其他建筑。

source: Now establish two weaving mills and build two residential areas.<n>If there are not enough building materials in the town, you must buy these in another town and deliver them to your warehouse at the docks. <n>Don't forget to negotiate a price before you part with your precious gold!
text: 现在建造两座织布厂和两片住宅区。<n>如果城镇的建材不足，就到别的城镇采购，再通过码头运入您的仓库。<n>掏出宝贵的金币之前，可别忘了先谈好价钱！

source: You should ensure that you have a supply of @a$SubGoal$ of cotton in the warehouse by the time your weaving mills have been built, so that the new businesses can start weaving cloth from cotton straight away.
text: 你应在纺织厂完工前，确保仓库里有@a$SubGoal$棉花，这样新工厂就能立即开工，把棉花织成布匹。

source: Your next objective is to produce your own supply of @a$SubGoal$ of cloth for the warehouse in Cartagena and wait for your weaving mills to be constructed.<n>For @a$SubGoal$ of cloth, you need exactly @a$SubGoal$ of cotton.
text: 接下来，等待纺织厂建成，再自行生产@a$SubGoal$布匹，存入卡塔赫纳仓库。<n>生产@a$SubGoal$布匹，正好需要@a$SubGoal$棉花。

source: Click on the goods to activate or cancel purchase.
text: 点击货物，开启或取消收购。

source: Very good!<n>To ensure that you always have enough raw materials for your weaving mills, you should now establish a cotton business in Santa Marta.<n>One production facility can supply enough raw materials for two manufacturing facilities.
text: 很好！<n>为了让纺织厂始终拥有充足的原材料，现在你应该在圣玛尔塔兴建一处棉花生产设施。<n>一处原材料生产设施，足以供应两座加工厂。

source: Now ensure that your businesses in Santa Marta and Cartagena are operating at full steam.<n>Don't forget that your weaving mills in Cartagena require a constant supply of cotton.<n>Continue to trade and sell the goods you produce.<n>This scenario will end as soon as you have increased your cash to @g$GoldGoal$.
text: 现在，请确保你在圣玛尔塔和卡塔赫纳的产业全力运转。<n>别忘了，卡塔赫纳的纺织厂需要持续供应棉花。<n>继续贸易，出售自己生产的货物。<n>当你的现金增加到@g$GoldGoal$时，本剧本就会结束。

source: You already attacked the town of %1 in the last 30 days. The captain refuses to attack it again on moral grounds.
text: 你在过去30天内已经袭击过%1。出于道义，船长拒绝再次进攻。

source: The %1 buccaneer %2 has poached %3 workers and their families. Many businesses in the town are now no longer operating at full capacity.
text: %1私掠者%2挖走了%3名工人及其家属，城镇中许多产业现在无法满负荷运转。

source: %1,<n>you know quite well I'd tell you to go to hell under normal circumstances, but in dire times like these, I'd sell my soul to the devil himself.<n><n>So come on in, I have something to tell you.
text: %1，<n>你很清楚，平时我会叫你滚远点。可眼下这么艰难，哪怕要把灵魂卖给魔鬼，我也愿意。<n><n>进来吧，我有话对你说。

source: Your task is to ensure that the town of @T$TargetTown$ declines in status to “Recession” by @D$EndDate$. You have two options here:<n><n>Either attack the town and loot all the goods to bring about the status “Recovery”. The town’s status will then continue to decline due to the scarcity of goods.<n><n>Alternatively, you can cut off the supply of goods to the town by intercepting trading convoys. Note:  If you only loot a convoy and do not capture it, your reputation with the nation in question will suffer to a much lesser extent.
text: 你的任务是在@D$EndDate$前，让@T$TargetTown$的经济状况降至“衰退”。你有两种办法：<n><n>其一是袭击城镇，掠走全部货物，使其进入“恢复”状态。随后，货物短缺会使城镇的经济状况继续恶化。<n><n>另一种办法是拦截贸易船队，切断城镇的货物供应。注意：如果只是劫掠船队而不俘获它，对你在该国声望的损害会小得多。

source: Good! I am assigning you the mission of causing the town of @T$TargetTown$ to fall into a state of “Recession”. You have until @D$EndDate$.<n><n>To achieve your objective, you must intercept all traders visiting the town so that it receives no more goods and its status slowly starts to decline.<n><n>However, there is a way of making this happen faster. This involves attacking and looting the town. Your attack will cause the status to drop rapidly to “Recovery” and the resulting scarcity of goods in the town will then cause it to drop even further until the town is in “Recession”.
text: 很好！我要交给你一项任务：让@T$TargetTown$陷入“衰退”状态。期限是@D$EndDate$。<n><n>要实现这个目标，你必须拦截所有前往该城镇的商人，让城镇得不到新的货物，经济状况便会逐渐恶化。<n><n>不过，也有更快的办法，那就是攻击并劫掠这座城镇。进攻会让它的经济状况迅速跌至“复苏”，而此后城里的货物短缺会令状况继续恶化，直到陷入“衰退”。

source: There is nothing you can do for me.
text: 我没有什么需要你帮忙的。

source: Unfortunately, I have no news for you at the moment. Try again later.
text: 可惜目前没有新消息，稍后再来吧。

source: I'm afraid I have no missions for you. Come back and see me again in a few days.
text: 抱歉，我目前没有任务交给您。过几天再来看看吧。

source: Arm your convoy so that it has at least three fully armed and fully manned escort ships that are all of the type frigate or higher.
text: 武装船队，使其至少拥有三艘武器和水手满编的护航船，船型必须是护卫舰或更大。

source: Thank you for your kind donation.
Thank you for your kind and generous donation.
text: 感谢你仁慈而慷慨的捐赠。

source: No workers are needed in the town.
name: IDPR_HDC_SIEDLER_NO_NEED

source: All that remains is a lone hat where the pirate captain once sat. He must have been captured and the convoy sunk.
text: 海盗船长原来坐的地方，只剩下一顶孤零零的帽子。他一定被俘了，船队也沉没了。

source: Well, get going then. Head for the waters around the town of @T$TargetTown$.
text: 那就出发吧，前往@T$TargetTown$周围的海域。

source: In this scenario, you'll learn how to establish businesses and find out what you need to take into account when you do so. You'll also construct residential areas for your new workers.<n><n>In Port Royale 2, you can build in any town where you have a purchased a building permit. The more permits you have, the more expensive your next one will be. You already have one permit in the town where you started the game, so you can start to construct new buildings there immediately.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Construct one cocoa production facility and one residential area in Santa Marta.
text: 本关将教你开办产业，以及需要注意的事项。你还要为新工人建造住宅区。<n><n>在《海商王2》中，购买了建筑许可证，就能在对应城镇建设。持有的许可证越多，下一张就越贵。你在游戏起始城镇已经拥有一张，因此可以立即在那里动工。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>关卡目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>在圣玛尔塔建造一处可可生产设施和一片住宅区。

source: Now you know how sea battles work. It is also possible to attack an entire town to loot it or to capture it on behalf of another nation. However, to do so, you need large convoys with powerful ships. As you can imagine, attacking a city will seriously damage your reputation with the nation in question and its military convoys will pursue you from then on.<n><n>Alternatively, you can attack a pirate hideout. Pirate hideouts are usually in secret locations but each of these locations will become known at some point in the game. You can then attack a pirate hideout in the same way you attack a town, to destroy the entire pirate gang.<n><n>The strength of the defenses surrounding one of these hideouts depends on how long a pirate gang has been at large and how successfully their convoys have looted trading ships.<n><n>Your final task in this scenario will be to raid a small pirate's den. Find out where the hideout is located from the Governor of @T$TOWN$.<n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Destroy the pirate hideout of @P$PirateName$.
text: 现在你已了解海战的进行方式。你也可以攻击整座城镇，对其进行劫掠，或代表另一个国家将其占领。不过，这需要一支拥有强大战舰的大型船队。不难想象，攻击城镇会严重损害你在该国的声望，此后该国的军事船队便会追捕你。<n><n>你也可以攻击海盗藏身处。它们通常位于隐秘地点，但游戏过程中，这些地点终究会被发现。届时，你就能像攻击城镇一样攻击海盗藏身处，彻底消灭整个海盗团伙。<n><n>藏身处的防御强度，取决于海盗团伙横行了多久，以及他们的船队劫掠商船的成果。<n><n>本剧本的最后一项任务是突袭一个小型海盗巢穴。请向@T$TOWN$的总督打听其位置。<n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>摧毁@P$PirateName$的海盗藏身处。

source: Now you should create jobs in the town and construct residential areas.<n><n>Since settlers will only want to stay in your town if they can find work there, you should first construct four production facilities. Decide what kind of production facilities you want to build. But ensure that you only produce goods that you'll be able to sell at a profit in other towns, because production costs are high and you rely on the profits you make from selling the goods.<n><n>Four production facilities provide jobs for 120 workers. Since each of these workers is one of a family of four, you must provide living quarters for 480 citizens, in other words, four residential areas.<n><n>As soon as your production facilities and residential areas are ready, you can try to bring settlers from other towns to your own town. Settlers usually wait for work in governor towns. <n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Increase your town's population to 480.
text: 现在，你应该在城镇中创造就业岗位，并建造住宅区。<n><n>移民只有找到工作才愿意留在你的城里，因此你应先建造四处生产设施。产业类型由你决定，但务必选择那些能运往其他城镇获利出售的货物，因为生产成本很高，你需要依靠销售利润维持经营。<n><n>四处生产设施可为120名工人提供工作。每位工人都代表一个四口之家，因此你需要为480名市民提供住房，也就是四片住宅区。<n><n>生产设施和住宅区建好后，就可以尝试将其他城镇的移民运到自己的城镇。移民通常在总督驻地等候工作。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>将你的城镇人口增加到480。

source: Congratulations! You can now produce cloth from cotton in Cartagena.<n><n>As you can imagine, the costs of producing cloth depend to a large degree on the price you pay for the cotton. For this reason, you can only produce finished goods if you can be sure of being able to purchase the raw materials at a reasonable price. Alternatively, you can produce the raw materials yourself.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Build a cotton production facility in Santa Marta and trade to increase your cash to @g$GoldGoal$.
text: 恭喜！现在你能在卡塔赫纳把棉花加工成布匹了。<n><n>不难想象，布匹的生产成本很大程度上取决于棉花的采购价格。因此，只有确保能以合理价格购入原材料，才适合生产制成品。另一种办法是自己生产原材料。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>在圣玛尔塔建造棉花生产设施，并通过贸易将现金增加到@g$GoldGoal$。

source: Far to the east of Charleston lie the Bermuda Islands. Steer well clear of them! Two months ago, my brother-in-law sailed there to explore them, but he never returned. No one knows what goes on there, but one thing is certain: A terrible fate awaits all those that dare to sail too close to the islands!
text: 查尔斯顿以东很远的地方，就是百慕大群岛。千万离那里远些！两个月前，我的姻亲出海探察那些岛屿，再也没有回来。没人知道那里究竟发生了什么，但有一点可以肯定：凡是胆敢靠得太近的人，都会遭遇可怕的命运！

source: Have you heard the latest story about the Bermuda Islands? A trader wanted to use the route leading past the islands to sail to Europe, but he never arrived there. His brother set out to search for him, but he found nothing but a few pieces of wreckage to the south of the islands.
text: 你听说百慕大群岛最近的传闻了吗？有个商人打算沿途经过群岛驶往欧洲，却始终没有抵达。他兄弟出海寻找，结果只在群岛南面发现了几片残骸。

source: Just the other day, a seaman from Port Royale told me that they recently sailed very close to the Bermuda Islands. They almost sailed too close, for with his own eyes, he saw a huge monster moving in the water. It was spitting fire and smoke belched from its long ears. Woe betide those that dare to approach this sea monster!
text: 前几天，一位来自皇家港的水手告诉我，他们最近航行时离百慕大群岛很近，差一点就近过头了。他亲眼看见一头巨兽在水中游动，口中喷火，长长的耳朵里冒着浓烟。谁敢靠近那只海怪，谁就要倒大霉！

source: The %1 buccaneer %2 sneaked into the town and destroyed large stocks of goods belonging to the town market.
text: %1私掠者%2潜入城镇，摧毁了市场的大量货物库存。

source: Today, %1 %2 captured the town of %4 for %3. %5 now has %6 towns in the New World, while %7 has only %8 towns.
text: 今天，%1%2为%3占领了%4。如今，%5在新世界拥有%6座城镇，而%7只剩%8座。

source: Today, %1 %2 captured the town of %4 for %3. %5 now has %6 towns in the New World, while %7 is only represented by a single town in the New World.
text: 今天，%1%2为%3攻占了%4。%5如今在新大陆拥有%6座城镇，而%7只剩下一座。

source: %1,<n>Our church needs constant maintenance and must be decorated as befits a place of worship, but Rome is far away. Make a donation to our church and we will include you in our prayers. Your reputation in my nation and my town will also benefit.<n><n>Choose the sum you would like to donate.
text: %1，<n>教堂需要经常修缮，也得装点得像个礼拜之所，可罗马实在太远。请为教堂捐款，我们会在祷告中为你祝福，你在我国和本城的声望也会提高。<n><n>请选择捐赠金额。

source: You must not sink or capture the ships.<n><n>You have until @D$EndDate$.<n><n>Remember that transport convoys do not count as trading convoys and that you must have a Letter of Marque if you want to attack traders.
text: 不得击沉或俘获船只。<n><n>期限是@D$EndDate$。<n><n>记住，运输船队不算商船队；而且要攻击商人，您必须持有私掠许可证。
城镇的货物库存已被买空

source: %1,<n><n>I have sent you the sum of %2 gold coins today. My debt with you is therefore settled.<n><n>The Treasurer of %3
name: ID_LETTER_TOWN_LOAN_PAYOFF_TEXT
text: %1，<n><n>今日已向你汇出%2枚金币。至此，我欠你的债务已全部清偿。<n><n>%3财务官

source: The treasure fleet is anchored in the harbor.
text: 运宝船队正停泊在港口。

source: Do you want to overwrite the saved game?

But don’t forget: It’s only goods you’re after! You must not sink or capture any ships because you don’t want to provoke the enemy any more than is necessary.<n><n>You have until @D$EndDate$.<.<n><n>Remember that transport convoys do not count as trading convoys and that you must have a Letter of Marque if you want to attack traders.
text: 但别忘了：你要的只是货物！不得击沉或俘获任何船只，免得过度激怒敌人。<n><n>期限为@D$EndDate$。<.<n><n>记住，运输船队不算贸易船队；若要攻击商人，必须持有私掠许可证。

source: You have accepted the mission to destroy the hideout of pirate %1. %2
text: 您已接受摧毁海盗%1巢穴的任务。%2

source: Introductory scenario<n><n>In this scenario, you will command your first sea battles. Initially, you will wage a battle against a practice convoy, but, later in the scenario, you will take on pirate ships and even attack a pirate’s den.
text: 入门剧本<n><n>在本剧本中，你将首次指挥海战。开始时，你会与一支演练船队交战；之后则要对付海盗船，甚至进攻一处海盗巢穴。
<ts:0><ts:160>城镇视图／海战<t>缩放<n>列表中<t>滚动

source: A convoy belonging to the pirate %1 has attacked your convoy.
text: 海盗%1的一支船队袭击了你的船队。

source: This ship has recently set sail with a convoy bound for Europe. I want you to see whether my spy on board has thrown important documents overboard for us.
text: 这艘船最近随船队启航，驶往欧洲。我想让你去看看，船上的间谍是否把重要文件抛入海中，留给我们。

source: You have offered exemplary support to @T$TargetTown$ and made a very good name for yourself in the town. Thankfully, you have been given a building permit and a warehouse.
text: 你对@T$TargetTown$的援助堪称典范，在城镇中赢得了极佳的名声。作为感谢，你获得了一张建筑许可证和一座仓库。

source: The town is recovering from a plague.
text: 城镇正在从瘟疫中恢复。

source: <g:INTEXT_FLASCHENPOST_800x600.screen><n>You have found a fragment of a treasure map. It seems to belong to the map you already have in your log.
text: <g:INTEXT_FLASCHENPOST_800x600.screen><n>你找到了一块藏宝图碎片，似乎正属于日志中已有的那张地图。

source: <g:INTEXT_FLASCHENPOST_800x600.screen><n>You have found a fragment of a treasure map in a bottle. You place the piece of map in your log.
text: <g:INTEXT_FLASCHENPOST_800x600.screen><n>你在瓶子里发现了一片藏宝图，并把碎片收进日志。

source: Introductory Scenario<n><n>In Port Royale 2, your objective is to rise from being a humble trader to become an influential businessman. To help you achieve the status you seek, you can transport goods as well as trade, build, and engage in politics and piracy.<n:25>The introductory scenario will teach you the basics of how to play the game. This scenario, like all the others, involves several different objectives.
text: 入门剧本<n><n>在《海商王2》中，你的目标是从一名不起眼的商人，成长为举足轻重的商业巨头。运输货物、贸易、建设、参与政治或从事海盗活动，都能帮助你实现抱负。<n:25>入门剧本将教你游戏的基本玩法。与其他剧本一样，它包含若干不同目标。

source: %1: Loss of goods due to rat infestation
Excellent! You restored the population of Tortuga within @I$Days$ days.
text: 太棒了！你在@I$Days$天内让托尔图加的人口恢复了。

source: Greetings, @s$USER$. I have a clue for you. If you collect more of these clues, you could find treasure.
text: 你好，@s$USER$。我有一条线索给你。多收集些这样的线索，或许就能找到宝藏。

source: Greetings, @s$USER$. Do you wish to set off in search of treasure? Then listen to the first clue.
text: 你好，@s$USER$。想出海寻宝吗？那就听好第一条线索。

source: Do you wish to set off on a treasure hunt, @A$USER$? Then I can give you your first clue.
text: 你想出发寻宝吗，@A$USER$？那我可以给你第一条线索。

source: %1,<n>choose which convoy should be blessed. The blessing will give all your sailors the highest possible morale.
text: %1，<n>请选择要接受祝福的船队。祝福会让全体水手的士气达到最高。

source: Hello, @s$USER$, I have here a clue to lead you to hidden treasure. Do you want to hear it?
text: 你好，@s$USER$。我这里有一条通往秘藏宝藏的线索。想听听吗？

source: Hello, @F$FName$ @L$LName$, sit down here beside me and let's have a wee tipple. Then I'll tell you of hidden treasure.
text: 您好，@F$FName$ @L$LName$，来我旁边坐，陪我小酌一杯，我就告诉您一处宝藏的消息。

source: You are @s$USER$, aren't you? Then you're the person looking for more clues to a hidden treasure. I could help you, if you wish.
text: 你就是@s$USER$吧？这么说，寻找宝藏线索的人就是你了。如果你愿意，我可以帮忙。

source: Greetings, @A$USER$. I can tell you how to find what you are looking for. Hear my clue to the hidden treasure.
text: 你好，@A$USER$。我可以告诉你如何找到你要找的东西。听听这条关于秘藏宝藏的线索吧。

source: There are no convoys in automatic trading
text: 没有正在自动贸易的船队

source: I have nothing further to discuss with you.<n>Improve your reputation with my nation if you want to do more business with me.
text: 我没有其他事要与你商谈。<n>如果想继续与我做生意，请先提高你在我国的声望。

source: You are doing me a great favor. All is in order, you have paid me the @g$PriceBuy$. Meet me in the market and I will hand over @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$. After that, take the goods to @T$Town$ by @D$EndDate$ and hand them over to @N$DestName$.
text: 你可帮了我大忙。一切妥当，你已经付给我@g$PriceBuy$。到市场与我碰面，我会交给你@a$Amount$的@G$Goods$。然后，请在@D$EndDate$前把货物运到@T$Town$，交给@N$DestName$。

source: Once again, we are faced with a shortage of those imported goods delivered by transport convoys from @n$Nation$. Could you help my friends and I with regard to this matter?
text: 我们又缺少由@n$Nation$运输船队送来的进口商品了。您能帮我和我的朋友们解决这个问题吗？

source: The war with @n$HostileNation$ has resulted in a shortage of imported goods for the colonies in @n$Nation$. Since there appear to be no shortages in @n$HostileNation$, we could attack their transport convoys and procure the scarce goods in this way. You could undertake this task.
text: 与@n$HostileNation$的战争导致@n$Nation$的殖民地缺乏进口商品。既然@n$HostileNation$似乎并不短缺，我们就可以袭击他们的运输船队，获取急需的货物。这个任务可以交给你。
英格兰殖民地总督的馈赠
法国殖民地总督的赏赐
荷兰殖民地总督的赠礼
西班牙殖民地总督的赠礼

source: Your men set off to find the treasure chamber without meeting any resistance. They loot %1.<n><n>You must now choose what goods you want to loot from the town's warehouse.
text: 你的部下毫无阻碍地找到了宝库，掠走了%1。<n><n>现在，你必须选择从城镇仓库中掠走哪些货物。

source: %1 has set loose %2 the buccaneer to sabotage our towns. Only recently he attacked %3, and now he is en route to his home town. You would do me and my nation a huge favor if you were to stop this buccaneer in his tracks.
text: %1派出私掠者%2破坏我们的城镇。不久前他刚袭击了%3，现在正返回家乡。如果你能拦住他，就是帮了我和我国一个大忙。

source: I have just learned that the buccaneer %1 has recently left %2 to attack one of our towns. I hope we can stop him before he strikes.
text: 我刚得知，私掠者%1最近已离开%2，准备袭击我们的一座城镇。希望能在他动手之前拦住他。

source: Under orders from %2, the buccaneer %1 is on his way to attack our towns. I have learned that he is currently in %3 to prepare his next action.
text: 私掠者%1奉%2之命，正准备进攻我们的城镇。我得知他目前在%3筹备下一次行动。

source: I'm delighted! From this day onwards, the hostilities between us are a thing of the past.
text: 太好了！从今天起，我们之间的敌对关系就成为过去了。

source: Nice work! With your Letter of Marque, you are now officially in the service of Holland and involved in the war with England. This means that you can attack English trading ships without your reputation suffering in Holland, France or Spain.<n><n>Naturally, your reputation with England will be damaged and, from now on, whenever you are in English waters, you should be on the lookout for the military convoys that will be pursuing you!<n><n>The English towns are all located to the southeast of the Turk Islands. Sail in this direction with your convoy and search for suitable trading convoys to capture. Sell the loot and the smaller ships to increase your wealth.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Capture three English trading convoys: Board their ships and add them to your convoy.
text: 干得好！有了私掠许可证，你现在正式为荷兰效力，参与对英格兰的战争。这意味着，你可以袭击英格兰商船，而不损害在荷兰、法国或西班牙的声望。<n><n>当然，你在英格兰的声望会受损。此后驶入英格兰海域时，务必提防前来追击的军事船队！<n><n>英格兰城镇都位于特克斯群岛东南方。率领船队朝那个方向航行，寻找适合俘获的贸易船队。出售战利品和较小的船只，积累财富。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>俘获三支英格兰贸易船队：接舷夺取它们的船只，并编入你的船队。

source: and the harbor is sufficiently secure.
text: 而且港口有足够的防卫。
Beta 测试管理与母盘制作

source: The convoy is being repaired and cannot be dispatched.<n>Do you want to stop repairs to the convoy?<n>You will not get back any gold!
text: 船队正在维修，无法派遣。<n>要中止维修吗？<n>已付金币不会退还！

source: Thank you for bringing me the documents. As a reward, I am presenting you with a barque. You will find her in the harbor.
text: 谢谢你把文件带给我。作为报酬，我送你一艘巴克帆船。它就停在港口里。

source: Many thanks for your support and for returning my diaries. As a reward, I am presenting you with a barque. You will find her in the harbor.
text: 非常感谢你的帮助，也谢谢你归还我的日记。作为报酬，我送你一艘巴克帆船，它就停在港口里。

source: Thank you for bringing me the documents. As a reward, I am presenting you with a barque. You will find her in the harbor.
text: 谢谢你把文件带给我。作为报酬，我送你一艘巴克帆船。它就停在港口里。

source: Pause game during editing of trade routes.
text: 编辑贸易航线时暂停游戏。

source: Whenever you capture enemy towns for a viceroy, he will grant you a plot of land in return. On this land, you can build a town that will belong to you and in which you can construct different buildings. In other words, any viceroy can help you become the owner of your own town. <n><n>Your next objective is to improve your reputation with Spain, because a viceroy will only receive you if you have a good reputation with his nation.<n><n>You can check your reputation with a nation under the town name in the town view, for example. In Margarita, where you start the game, three flags are displayed, indicating that your reputation with Spain is "neutral".<n><n>You can improve your reputation with a nation by accomplishing missions for its governors, hunting pirates or trading with its towns and delivering the goods they need.<n><n>Since Spain and France are at war, you can obtain a Letter of Marque against France from the Governor of Margarita. You can improve your reputation quickly with letters of Marque.<n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Improve your reputation with Spain to "friendly".
text: 每当你替殖民地总督夺取敌方城镇，他都会赐给你一块土地作为回报。你可以在这块土地上建立属于自己的城镇，兴建各种建筑。也就是说，任何一位殖民地总督都能帮助你成为城镇的主人。<n><n>下一个目标是提高你在西班牙的声望，因为只有与其国家关系良好，殖民地总督才会接见你。<n><n>例如，你可以在城镇视图的名称下方查看国家声望。在游戏起始地玛格丽塔，那里显示三面旗帜，表示你与西班牙的关系为“中立”。<n><n>完成该国总督的任务、追猎海盗，或向该国城镇运送所需货物进行贸易，都能提高声望。<n><n>西班牙与法国正在交战，因此你可以向玛格丽塔总督取得针对法国的私掠许可证。执行私掠行动能够迅速提高声望。<n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>将你与西班牙的关系提高到“友好”。

source: You performed an action that prevents you from completing the scenario successfully.<n><n>Follow the instructions in the Event window.
text: 你的某项操作导致本剧本已无法成功完成。<n><n>请遵循事件窗口中的指示。

source: @s$USER$, I have some information that I'm sure is worth @g$Price$ to you. My brother-in-law knows @N$TeacherName$, a retired captain.
text: @s$USER$，我有个消息，想必值得你花@g$Price$。我姐夫认识一位退休船长，名叫@N$TeacherName$。

source: Sit down here beside me and pour me some rum, I have some news for you. On my last journey, I met @N$ContactName$. He was a friend and student of the legendary @N$TeacherName$.
text: 来，坐我旁边，给我倒点朗姆酒。我有消息告诉你。上次出海时，我遇见了@N$ContactName$，他是传奇人物@N$TeacherName$的朋友兼学生。

source: @s$USER$, sit down beside me, I know where you can get training for one of your captains. Do you remember @N$TeacherName$?
text: @s$USER$，来，坐我旁边。我知道哪里能训练你的船长。还记得@N$TeacherName$吗？

source: Find the survivors of the shipwreck between @T$TOWN$ and @T$Town$ by @D$EndDate$.
text: 在@D$EndDate$之前，于@T$TOWN$和@T$Town$之间找到沉船幸存者。

source: Search the area between @T$TOWN$ and @T$Town$ for survivors until @D$EndDate$.
text: 在@D$EndDate$之前，于@T$TOWN$和@T$Town$之间的海域搜寻幸存者。

source: Search the area between @T$TOWN$ and @T$Town$ until @D$EndDate$ to see what became of the settlers.
text: 请在@D$EndDate$之前搜索@T$TOWN$与@T$Town$之间的地区，查明那些移民的下落。

source: This veteran captain knew every trick in the book for getting the better of even the most experienced traders.
text: 这位老练的船长精通各种手段，就连最有经验的商人也难逃他的算计。

source: This experienced seaman was a master at battle.
text: 这位老练水手是个战斗高手。

source: They say he was an outstanding navigator.
text: 据说他是一位出色的领航员。

source: I am quite sure he could teach one of your captains a thing or two! So, will you give me the gold?
text: 我十分肯定，他能教你的某位船长一些本领！那么，你愿意把金币给我吗？

source: For @g$Price$, I will tell you where you can find @N$ContactName$.
text: 付@g$Price$，我就告诉你去哪里找@N$ContactName$。

source: Many thought he was long since dead, but only recently I met a trader who happened to come across his hideout. It seems he's just been lying low. For @g$Price$, I'll tell you where you can find the trader.
text: 许多人以为他早已死了，可不久前我遇到一位商人，他偶然发现了那家伙的巢穴。看来他只是一直躲着不露面。给我@g$Price$，我就告诉您去哪里找那位商人。

source: You have not taken control of all of your opponent’s ships. However, in the case of pirate convoys or military convoys, you have the option of sinking the abandoned ships.<n>Do you want to choose this option?
text: 你尚未接管对手的全部船只。不过，如果对方是海盗船队或军事船队，你可以选择击沉被遗弃的船只。<n>要这样做吗？

source: Congratulations! You have successfully completed each of the tasks in this scenario in @I$Days$ days and you have amassed total assets of @g$Wealth$.<n><n>Your score is now: @I$Val1$
text: 恭喜！你用@I$Days$天完成了本关所有任务，并积累了@g$Wealth$总资产。<n><n>你目前的得分为：@I$Val1$

source: <n>Do you want to give me some gold to procure more harbor cannons? One cannon costs %1.
text: <n>你愿意捐些金币，让我增购港口火炮吗？每门火炮需要%1。

source: I see you are a wealthy man, %1. I'm finding it hard to make ends meet and would like to ask you on behalf of my nation whether you could find it in your heart to give me a loan of %2? You will get back %4 in %3 months.
text: 看得出来，你很富有，%1。我现在入不敷出，想代表我国请你帮个忙，借给我%2。%3个月后，你将收回%4。

source: The captain and crew have disembarked at the harbor. This is going to be some adventure! Which waters shall I prowl?
text: 船长和船员已在港口登岸。这回可真是一场冒险！我该去哪个海域游猎呢？

source: Click on the button "Sea chart" to define a route
text: 点击“海图”按钮设置航线

source: Greetings, %1. Do you have all the goods for the feast?
text: 你好，%1。宴会所需的货物都带齐了吗？

source: I see you have a piece of a treasure map in your log. Would you be interested in a new piece? You never know, perhaps it will already be enough for you to find the treasure.<n>I'll give it to you for @g$Price$.
text: 我看见你的日志里有一块藏宝图碎片。想再要一块吗？说不定有了它，你就能找到宝藏了。<n>付@g$Price$，我就把它给你。

source: @s$USER$, I've heard you are interested in treasure maps. I have a piece here that belongs to your map. I'll give it to you for @g$Price$.
text: @s$USER$，听说你对藏宝图有兴趣。我手里有块碎片，正好属于你的那张地图。付@g$Price$，它就是你的。

source: Good day, @s$USER$. I hear you have an incomplete treasure map in your possession, do you not? I would like to offer you another piece belonging to your map. I'm only asking @g$Price$ for it.
text: 你好，@s$USER$。听说你手里有张不完整的藏宝图，对吧？我有另一块属于那张地图的碎片，只要@g$Price$就卖给你。

source: Good! The town in question is @T$TargetTown$. In order to bring them to heel, the Viceroy of @n$TargetNation$ has forbidden all traders to sail to the town. If we can succeed in restoring wealth by supplying the town, then we can certainly count on its citizens' allegiance. You have until @D$EndDate$ to complete this mission.
text: 很好！目标城镇是@T$TargetTown$。为了迫使他们屈服，@n$TargetNation$的殖民地总督禁止所有商人驶往那里。如果我们能通过供货让城镇重新富裕起来，市民就一定会归附我们。你必须在@D$EndDate$之前完成任务。

source: I refer to the town of @T$TargetTown$. All traders have been forbidden to sail to the town. Your mission is to supply the town in order to restore its wealth. In this way, we can make clear our interest in @T$TargetTown$. You have until @D$EndDate$ to accomplish your mission.
text: 我说的是@T$TargetTown$。所有商人都被禁止驶往那里。你的任务是向城镇供货，使它重新富裕起来。这样，我们就能明确表达对@T$TargetTown$的支持。你必须在@D$EndDate$之前完成任务。

source: The matter is this: The viceroy has forbidden all traders to sail to the town of @T$TargetTown$. By doing this, he wants to exert pressure on the town council. If you succeed in supplying @T$TargetTown$ enough goods to allow wealth to be restored by @D$EndDate$, I have no doubt that I can arrange a peaceful change of national allegiance.
text: 事情是这样的：殖民地总督禁止所有商人驶往@T$TargetTown$，想借此向市议会施压。如果你能在@D$EndDate$前，为@T$TargetTown$提供足够的货物，使其恢复富庶，我相信自己一定能安排它和平改换效忠的国家。

source: You have won the sea battle. Do you want to call off the attack?
text: 你赢得了海战。要停止进攻吗？

source: You have purchased a building permit and you may now build in this town. Your first building must be a warehouse.<n><n>Note: The more building permits you have, the more expensive the next one will be and the longer it will take for your trading record in other towns to improve.
text: 你已购买建筑许可证，现在可以在这座城镇建造了。第一座建筑必须是仓库。<n><n>注意：你拥有的建筑许可证越多，下一张就越昂贵，而改善其他城镇贸易表现所需的时间也会越长。

source: %1,<n>there you are again. Come, I may have some news for you.
text: %1：<n>你又来了。过来吧，我也许有些消息告诉你。

source: %1,<n>you weren’t gone for long this time. Have you nothing else to do?
text: %1：<n>这次你没离开多久就回来了。难道没有别的事情可做吗？

source: %1,<n>I was not expecting to see you again so soon. I don’t believe I have any news for you as yet.
text: %1，<n>没想到这么快又见到你了。恐怕我暂时还没有新消息。

source: %1,<n>nice of you to drop by. Shall I tell you of the latest events I've heard?
text: %1，<n>很高兴你能来。要听听我最近获悉的消息吗？

source: %1,<n>it's good to see you again. In the last couple of days, I’ve asked around and I may now have some news for you.
text: %1，<n>很高兴再次见到你。过去几天我四处打听，或许已经有些消息可以告诉你。

source: %1,<n>there you are again, I’m glad to see. I believe I may have some information for you.
text: %1，<n>又见到你真高兴。我想我有些消息可以告诉你。

source: %1,<n>it’s been quite a while, but I’m happy to see you again. I have some news for you.
text: %1，<n>好久不见，很高兴你又来了。我有些消息要告诉你。

source: %1,<n>I was just about to go out to visit someone, as things are rather boring for me around here. But now you’re here. Come, I have something to tell you.
text: %1，<n>这里实在有些无聊，我刚准备出去找人聊聊，您就来了。来吧，我有事告诉您。

source: %1,<n>There you are, I was just wondering where you’ve been all this time. I have some news for you.
text: %1，<n>你来了，我刚还在想你这些日子去了哪里。我有些消息要告诉你。

source: You now have enough gold to increase your convoy's firepower. Look in the shipyards in the Governor towns for the most powerful ship you can afford.<n><n>Then add this ship to your convoy and take more cannons and sailors on board. If you don't have enough gold, trade some more.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Increase your convoy's firepower to at least 90 cannons.
text: 你现在有足够的金币增强船队火力。到总督驻地的造船厂，找一艘你买得起的最强战船。<n><n>把它编入船队，再补充更多火炮和水手。若金币不够，就继续贸易。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>关卡目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>把船队火力提高到至少90门炮。

source: Visit your new town and build a shipyard.
text: 前往你的新城镇，建造一座造船厂。

source: I am happy to see you, %1.
%1,<n>it’s you, is it? I hardly recognize you. I understand that your adventures take up a lot of your time. However, you really could visit me more often.
text: %1，<n>真的是你吗？我都快认不出来了。我知道你忙着四处冒险，可你也该多来看看我呀。

source: %1,<n>do you want me to have to spend all of my time at the inn just for some company? You really should visit me more often!
text: %1：<n>难道你想让我为了找个人说话，就整天待在酒馆里吗？你真该多来看看我！

source: %1,<n>l allow all the visiting traders to be in and out here all day long, just so I can have some company. Could you not manage to drop by more often?
text: %1，<n>我让来访的商人整天进进出出，只为了找个人陪伴。你就不能多来看看我吗？

source: Deliver @G$Goods$ by @D$EndDate$ to a person in @T$TargetTown$. You will then be paid @g$Price$ for each barrel delivered.
text: 在@D$EndDate$之前，把@G$Goods$交给@T$TargetTown$的一位收货人。每桶可获得@g$Price$。

source: You have found the missing package. Bring it to @N$OwnerName$ in @T$TOWN$ by @D$EndDate$.
text: 您找到了遗失的包裹。请在@D$EndDate$之前，将它交给@T$TOWN$的@N$OwnerName$。

source: %1 %2 has broken through the town's harbor defenses and looted the town.
text: %1%2突破了城镇的港口防御，并洗劫了城镇。

source: You have served my nation long and faithfully, now I must reward you for your loyalty. I shall give you a parcel of land on which you can establish your own town.
text: 你长期以来忠诚地为我国效力，如今我必须奖赏你的忠心。我将赐给你一块土地，让你建立自己的城镇。

source: In this scenario, the Spanish viceroy grants you a plot of land on which you can build your own town. The objective of this scenario is ensure that your town's economy begins to flourish.<n:25>However, before you receive a plot of land, you must improve your reputation with Spain and make yourself popular with the Spanish viceroy by capturing towns on his behalf.
text: 在这个剧本中，西班牙殖民地总督将赐给你一块土地，让你建立自己的城镇。剧本目标是让你的城镇经济发展起来。<n:25>不过，获得土地之前，你必须先提高在西班牙的声望，并替西班牙殖民地总督夺取城镇，以赢得他的青睐。

source: You have come across castaways on a raft and have picked up @I$Settlers$ settlers. They are hoping to be put ashore in a town where there is a shortage of workers.
text: 你发现了一群乘木筏漂流的落难者，救起了@I$Settlers$名移民。他们希望在一座缺少工人的城镇上岸。

source: and the harbor is very poorly defended.
text: 而且港口防卫极其薄弱。

source: The last convoy from Europe informed me that my town is going to run short of imported goods in the next few weeks.<n><n>Can you help me? I cannot rely on the possibility of other traders bringing these goods to the town.
text: 上次来自欧洲的船队告诉我，未来几周本城将缺少进口商品。<n><n>你能帮忙吗？我不能指望其他商人碰巧把这些货物送来。

source: As you know, @n$Nation1$ and @n$Nation2$ are at war.<n>For this reason, I will still not be getting any imported goods from Europe for the coming weeks.  I therefore have no choice but to buy up the goods in @n$Nation2$.<n><n>I have already employed some other traders to do so but I would like to be able to rely on your help also.
text: 你也知道，@n$Nation1$和@n$Nation2$正在交战。<n>因此，未来几周我仍收不到欧洲的进口商品，只能去@n$Nation2$采购。<n><n>我已经雇了其他商人帮忙，但也希望能得到你的支持。

source: What does @n$Nation2$ think it's doing? I have just learned from an informant that transport convoys from Europe en route to my town are being attacked and looted. Will you help me to buy the imported goods we need?
text: @n$Nation2$到底想干什么？线人刚告诉我，从欧洲驶往本城的运输船队遭到袭击和劫掠。你能帮我采购急需的进口商品吗？

source: You cannot disband the convoy because there are still goods or cargo on board.
text: 船上仍有货物或其他载荷，无法解散船队。

source: Having defeated your adversary's escort ships, you seize a trading ship.<n><n>You now have to decide which goods you want to take and whether you want to capture the ships or just loot them.
text: 击败对手的护航舰后，你控制了一艘商船。<n><n>现在，你必须决定要拿走哪些货物，以及是夺取这些船只，还是只劫掠货物。

source: Having defeated your adversary's escort ships, you seize %1 trading ships.<n><n>You now have to decide which goods you want to take and whether you want to capture the ships or just loot them.
text: 击败敌方护航船后，你控制了%1艘商船。<n><n>现在需要决定带走哪些货物，以及要俘获这些船，还是只劫走货物。

source: Your adversary's convoy has no escort ships to defend him. You therefore seize the trading ship without a fight.<n><n>You now have to decide which goods you want to take and whether you want to capture the ship or just loot it.
text: 对方船队没有护航舰保护，因此您不费一兵一卒便控制了商船。<n><n>现在需要决定拿走哪些货物，以及俘获这艘船还是只掠夺货物。

source: Your adversary's convoy has no escort ships to defend him. You therefore seize the trading ships without a fight.<n><n>You now have to decide which goods you want to take and whether you want to capture the ships or just loot them.
text: 对手的船队没有护航舰保护。因此，你不费一枪一弹就控制了那些商船。<n><n>现在，你必须决定要拿走哪些货物，以及是夺取这些船只，还是只劫掠货物。

source: In this scenario, you'll learn how to wage a battle at sea. The scenario begins with a short practice battle. Later, you'll have to track down and destroy the convoy of a notorious pirate.<n><n>You'll also get to know the Governor of Cartagena, where you start the scenario. He will help you to become accomplished in waging sea battles and later he will assign you the mission of hunting down a certain pirate.<n><n>Your rank at the start of the scenario is Sailor. You must have reached this rank in order to be assigned a mission by the governor. <n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Pay a visit to the Governor of Cartagena and accomplish the mission he assigns to you.
text: 本关将教你如何进行海战。首先是一场简短的练习战，之后你需要追踪并消灭一名臭名昭著的海盗的船队。<n><n>你还会结识本关起点卡塔赫纳的总督。他将帮助你掌握海战技巧，随后委托你追捕一名海盗。<n><n>本关开始时，你的等级是水手。至少达到这个等级，才能接受总督的任务。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>关卡目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>拜访卡塔赫纳总督，完成他交给你的任务。

source: <n><n>You can go to a governor of his nation to demand a ransom for him.
text: <n><n>你可以向他所属国家的总督索取赎金。

source: %1 has been weakened as a result.
%1 %2 receives the town of %3 from the English viceroy.
text: %1 %2获得了英格兰殖民地总督赐予的城镇%3。

source: %1 %2 receives the town of %3 from the French viceroy.
text: %1%2获法国殖民地总督赐予城镇%3。

source: %1 %2 receives the town of %3 from the Dutch viceroy.
text: %1 %2获得了荷兰殖民地总督赐予的城镇%3。

source: %1 %2 receives the town of %3 from the Spanish viceroy.
text: %1%2获西班牙殖民地总督赐予城镇%3。

source: You do not have any map pieces at the moment.
text: 你目前没有任何地图碎片。

source: Do you want to demolish all of this large business?
text: 要拆除这家大型企业的全部建筑吗？

source: Do you want to buy a Letter of Marque for %1 and hunt down the ships of our enemies in the name of England?
text: 您愿意花%1购买私掠许可证，以英格兰的名义追捕我国敌人的船只吗？

source: You did not deliver the goods on time.
Your wife has disappeared. Speak to the governor!
text: 你的妻子失踪了。去找总督谈谈！

<ts:0><ts:110><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>%1<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>关闭对话框/<n><t>选项菜单<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>%2<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>快进<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>Shift<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>船队居中<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>Caps Lock<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>切换居中跟随<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>方向键<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>移动<n><t>画面视野<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>CTRL + 1..0<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>保存船队快捷键<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res> 1..0<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>选择对应船队<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res> TAB<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>下一支船队<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>+ / -<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>游戏速度<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_black14x14aaFHk.res>F5 <f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><t>快速存档<n><t>（战斗中不可用）

source: You'll have a lot more to do in this scenario than in the first. You'll learn how to trade successfully and make your first trading profits.<n><n>You'll also form a second convoy to allow you to transport more goods.<n><n><n><c><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Read and follow the hints in the Event window.
text: 本剧本需要你做的事情，比第一个剧本多得多。你将学会如何成功贸易，并赚取第一笔贸易利润。<n><n>你还将组建第二支船队，以便运输更多货物。<n><n><n><c><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>阅读并遵循事件窗口中的提示。

source: Convoy has not had any sea battles yet.
