Unfortunately you have no suitable convoys left anchored in the harbor. The convoy must consist of exactly 5 ships and have 150 cannons on board. Come back when you have assembled such a convoy.
text: 遗憾的是，你在港口停泊的船队中已经没有合适的了。船队必须恰好由5艘船组成，并配备150门火炮。组建好这样的船队后再来找我。

source: The trader is called @N$Name$ and his hometown @T$Town$. If you succeed in destroying his convoy by @D$EndDate$, I will reward you handsomely with goods.
text: 这名商人叫@N$Name$，家乡是@T$Town$。如果你能在@D$EndDate$前摧毁他的船队，我会用货物重重酬谢你。

source: I cannot task you with capturing a town belonging to another nation on my behalf because we are not at war at the present time. However, things may change very quickly. Come back to me if they do.
text: 目前我们没有与别国交战，因此我不能委托你替我攻占外国城镇。不过局势瞬息万变，若有变化，你再来找我。

source: We are at war with %1 and you have ensured that %1 only has one town left. We cannot take this, and so I am unable to task you with capturing any town at present. <n><n>But do come back again when the situation changes.
text: 我们正与%1交战，而你已让%1只剩下一座城镇。这最后一座不能攻占，所以眼下我无法再给你攻城任务。<n><n>局势改变后，请再来。

source: I would gladly task you with capturing a town belonging to %1.  I have enough military convoys to protect any newly captured area.<n><n>However, %1 is still too strong for such an undertaking.<n><n>You could help to weaken %1 by destroying its military convoys.<n><n>Then return to me and I may have a mission for you.
text: 我很愿意让你夺取一座属于%1的城镇。我有足够的军事船队保卫新夺取的地区。<n><n>但%1目前仍然过于强大，还不适合开展这样的行动。<n><n>你可以消灭%1的军事船队，帮助削弱其实力。<n><n>然后再来找我，也许我就会有任务交给你了。

source: I would gladly task you with capturing a town belonging to %1.  I have enough military convoys to protect any newly captured area.<n><n>However, %1 is still too strong for such an undertaking.<n><n>You could help to weaken %1 by destroying its military convoys.<n><n>Then return to me and I may have a mission for you.<n><n><n>You can check a nation’s strength under “Nations” in the Chronicle.
text: 我很愿意派你夺取%1的一座城镇。我有足够的军事船队保护新占领的地区。<n><n>不过，%1的实力仍然太强，还不适合采取这种行动。<n><n>你可以摧毁%1的军事船队，帮助削弱其军力。<n><n>然后再来见我，也许我就有任务交给你了。<n><n><n>你可以在编年史的“国家”页面查看各国实力。

source: Accomplish another mission for the Governor of @T$TOWN$.
text: 再替@T$TOWN$的总督完成一项任务。

source: Attack on an English military convoy
Attack on a French military convoy
Attack on a Dutch military convoy
Attack on a Spanish military convoy
Hot on the Trail of Blackbeard!
Which convoy can you offer me?

You have reached the rank of “Sailor”. As of today, you must do something to maintain your high reputation with a nation.<n><n> You can improve your reputation with the nations by trading, donating to the church, organizing celebrations, destroying pirates as well as by accomplishing missions and Letters of Marque.<n><n>If your reputation with a nation does not improve, it diminishes by a very small amount every day. Note that the number of buildings you have built in the towns of a nation determines how low your reputation can become in this way.<n><n>Your reputation influences both the trading prices and the assignment of missions in the towns. If your reputation is low, you should also beware of military convoys!
text: 你已晋升为“水手”。从今天起，你必须采取行动，才能维持在各国的良好声望。<n><n>贸易、向教会捐款、举办庆典、消灭海盗，以及完成任务和执行私掠许可证上的行动，都能提高你在各国的声望。<n><n>如果你在某国的声望没有提高，它就会每天小幅下降。请注意，你在该国城镇中建造的建筑数量，决定了声望以这种方式下降时的最低限度。<n><n>声望会影响城镇中的交易价格和任务委托。声望低下时，你还应该提防该国的军事船队！
船上可能仍载着未处理的商品！

source: The number of citizens (the population minus the number of soldiers) in Tortuga must be restored to @I$Pop$ by @D$EndDate$ at the latest to ensure that all businesses have a full complement of workers.
text: 最迟在@D$EndDate$之前，托尔图加的居民数量，也就是总人口减去士兵人数，必须恢复到@I$Pop$，以确保所有企业都能招满工人。

source: A military convoy belonging to %1 was destroyed by ships belonging to %2.
text: %1的一支军事船队被%2的船只消灭了。

source: Military ships belonging to %1 have attacked a trading convoy belonging to %2.
text: %1的军舰袭击了%2的一支商船队。

source: Today, the %1 buccaneer %2 entered the town under a false name and caused a great deal of unrest among the workers. They now refuse to work for two weeks.
text: 今天，%1私掠者%2使用假名进入城镇，在工人中煽动了大规模骚乱。工人们决定停工两周。

source: You must find a package. @l$Pos$ Return it to @N$OwnerName$ in @T$TOWN$ by @D$EndDate$.
text: 找到一个包裹。@l$Pos$ 请在@D$EndDate$之前，把它交还给@T$TOWN$的@N$OwnerName$。

source: Unfortunately, you are an enemy of the nation to which the town belongs and have therefore sneaked into the harbor.
text: 遗憾的是，你与这座城镇所属的国家敌对，因此只能悄悄潜入港口。

source: The Governor urgently wants to speak to you.

Thank you!<n> Naturally, you will first need a permit in the town, but you are sure to receive one.<n>I will of course pay for all of your expenses as soon as the school is built. My wife's birthday is on @D$EndDate$, see to it that the foundation stone for the school is laid by then.
text: 谢谢！<n>当然，你得先拿到该城的建筑许可证，不过你一定办得到。<n>学校建成后，我会支付你的全部开支。我妻子的生日是@D$EndDate$，请务必在那之前为学校奠基。

source: That's good. Start building the school by @D$EndDate$. I will then pay for your expenses.<n>Don’t forget that you will need a permit in @T$Town$ if you want to build a school.<n>Don't breathe a word about this mission to my sister.
text: 很好。请在@D$EndDate$前动工建造学校，届时我会支付你的开支。<n>别忘了，想在@T$Town$建造学校，必须先取得建筑许可证。<n>这件委托千万别向我姐姐透露半个字。

source: Thank you! @T$Town$ will not find out about our accord. Begin construction by @D$EndDate$. I will then pay for your expenses.<n>Don’t forget that you will need a permit in @T$Town$ if you want to build a school.
text: 谢谢！@T$Town$不会知道我们的约定。请在@D$EndDate$之前动工，之后我会支付费用。<n>别忘了，在@T$Town$建学校需要建筑许可证。

source: Nice work! You now have an impressive convoy.<n><n>Your next task won't be an easy one, as it involves attacking and defeating an English military convoy. The Governor of the Turk Islands has provided you with another ship as backup. Locate it in the harbor of the Turk Islands and add it to your convoy.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Destroy an English military convoy.
text: 干得好！你现在拥有一支颇具实力的船队。<n><n>下一项任务并不容易：袭击并击败一支英格兰军事船队。特克斯群岛总督又给了你一艘船作为增援。在特克斯群岛港口找到它，将其编入船队。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>消灭一支英格兰军事船队。

source: Residential area of a local trader

Well done, you reached your first objective within @I$Days$ days. Your next objective is to increase the number of citizens living in the town. To do this, establish five businesses, one of each kind that is permitted in the town.<n><n>Remember that only a small number of traders visit Tortuga, and you must ensure that the town has sufficient supplies, so that its status is high enough to allow you to take in new settlers. Also, don’t forget to ensure that there is enough living space for the citizens.<n><n>You have 60 days to reach this objective. The sooner you achieve it, the better.<n><n>Hint: Soldiers are part of a town’s population but they don’t count as citizens! You can only increase the number of citizens in a town by creating jobs.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Set up five different businesses in Tortuga and increase the number of inhabitants to 1,500 by @D$EndDate$. Don’t forget to provide sufficient living space! One residential area is required for each business.
text: 干得好，你在@I$Days$天内达成了第一个目标。接下来的目标是增加城镇的市民人数。为此，请兴建五家企业，每种本城允许的产业各建一家。<n><n>记住，前往托尔图加的商人很少，你必须保障城镇供应，使经济状况足够良好，才能接纳新移民。别忘了为市民准备足够的住房。<n><n>你有60天完成这个目标，越快越好。<n><n>提示：士兵属于城镇人口，但不计入市民！只有创造就业岗位，才能增加城镇的市民人数。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>在托尔图加兴建五种不同企业，并在@D$EndDate$前将居民人数增加到1,500。别忘了提供足够住房！每家企业需要配套一片住宅区。

source: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>The ship that sank here must have been under the command of a very experienced captain. The chest does not contain any gold, but you find a carefully kept diary belonging to the captain @L$RandLName$. As a result, the experience of the captain of convoy @C$Convoy$ increases by two points.
text: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>沉在这里的船，想必曾由一位经验丰富的船长指挥。箱子里没有黄金，却有一本保存完好的日记，属于船长@L$RandLName$。读过之后，船队@C$Convoy$的船长经验增加了两点。

source: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>The treasure chest is empty, however, it served as a buoy for a rope. Not far below the surface, you discover a hideout containing cannons. Your crew haul as many of these cannons as possible on board.
text: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>宝箱里空空如也，不过它被用作一根绳索的浮标。在水面下不深的地方，你发现了一处藏有火炮的储藏点。船员们尽可能多地把火炮拖上了船。

source: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>A large number of barrels of rum are floating in the surrounding waters. Your men retrieve as many of them as your convoy can carry.
text: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>附近海面漂着许多桶朗姆酒。你的部下尽可能打捞，直到船队装不下为止。

source: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>Your convoy has come across a large wooden chest. It is immediately brought on board and opened. Some real treasure at last, thinks the captain as he catches a glimpse of the @g$Gold$.
text: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>您的船队发现了一只大木箱，立即将它捞上船并打开。看到其中的@g$Gold$，船长心想：总算碰上真正的财宝了。

source: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>An old and almost completely rotten wooden chest is floating in the water. Whatever it once contained, nothing remains now apart from a revolting smell. In spite of this, your crew's morale is lifted because the search for the treasure has finally come to an end.
text: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>海面漂着一只陈旧、几乎烂透的木箱。不论它曾装过什么，如今都只剩下一股恶臭。尽管如此，寻宝之旅终于结束，船员的士气还是提高了。

source: and the harbor is heavily defended.

Unfortunately, you didn't have enough time to make @g$GoldGoal$ in cash.<n><n>Sell the goods in your warehouse in Tortuga in the towns where they are in short supply and be on the lookout for goods that you can buy at a good price.<n><n>You can also get a loan from the treasurer in Tortuga.
text: 遗憾的是，你没能在规定时间内将现金增加到@g$GoldGoal$。<n><n>将托尔图加仓库中的货物运到缺货的城镇出售，同时留意能够以低价购入的货物。<n><n>你也可以向托尔图加的财务官申请贷款。

source: Thank you! Improvement of the harbor defenses will begin as soon as there is enough wood and bricks in the town.
text: 谢谢！城镇一旦备好足够的木材和砖，就会开始加固港口防御。

source: You receive a discount of <o:0xFFF2FAAD>5%<o> for all goods bought if you do the trading yourself.
text: 亲自进行交易时，你购买的所有货物都可享受<o:0xFFF2FAAD>5%<o>的折扣。

source: A transport convoy will be arriving here shortly. A spy has told me that our enemy is planning to attack this convoy on its return voyage to Europe. Can you protect the convoy on its way home?
text: 一支运输船队很快就会抵达这里。一名间谍告诉我，敌人计划在它返回欧洲的途中发动攻击。你能保护这支船队平安返航吗？

source: I have a problem. My wife wants to travel to Europe on the next convoy, in order to visit her family. Unfortunately, @n$HostileNation$ has learned of this and is planning to intercept the convoy. Can you guarantee my wife safe passage?
text: 我遇到了一个麻烦。我妻子想搭乘下一支船队去欧洲探亲。不幸的是，@n$HostileNation$得知了此事，正计划拦截船队。你能保证我妻子的航程安全吗？

source: I will soon be sending important documents to Europe. As we are currently at war with @n$HostileNation$, I am taking no risks and want to arrange an additional escort. Could you provide this escort?
text: 我即将向欧洲送出重要文件。由于我们正与@n$HostileNation$交战，我不愿冒险，想额外安排一支护航队。你愿意担任护航吗？

source: I'm sorry, it turns out I can't give you this mission after all. I have just received a message telling me that the problem no longer exists.
text: 抱歉，看来我不能把这项任务交给你了。我刚收到消息，问题已经解决。

source: The convoy that was supposed to carry out this mission has been destroyed.
text: 负责执行这项任务的船队已被消灭。

source: <n><n>To attack the hideout, you must send a convoy there in the same way you would send one to a town. Watch out! Any pirate convoy that is not in the hideout when you attack will be warned and will set up a new hideout.
text: <n><n>要攻击巢穴，像前往城镇一样派船队过去即可。小心！进攻时不在巢穴内的海盗船队会收到警告，并建立新的巢穴。

source: After breaking through the harbor defenses, your convoy docks and the sailors make their way through the town. On the way, they encounter the commander of the town guard. He refuses to give way unless he is defeated in a fair duel. Your captain accepts the challenge.
text: 突破港口防御后，你的船队靠岸，水手们穿过城镇。途中，他们遇到了城镇守军指挥官。他声称，除非有人在公平决斗中击败他，否则绝不让路。你的船长接受了挑战。

source: Terminate this game and load the saved game?
text: 结束当前游戏并读取存档？

source: A pirate hideout can only be attacked from the sea.
text: 海盗巢穴只能从海上攻击。

source: %1, you have captured the beloved town of my father for %2! I want nothing more to do with you. I hope I never see you again. You should know that you never meant anything to me and that I won't spare you a thought in the future.<n>I sincerely hope that, sooner or later, you receive the punishment that you so richly deserve.<n><n>%3
text: %1，你竟然为%2占领了我父亲心爱的城镇！我再也不想与你有任何瓜葛，但愿永远不再见到你。你要知道，你对我从来就无足轻重，今后我也不会再想起你。<n>我衷心希望，早晚有一天，你会受到应得的惩罚。<n><n>%3

source: %1, by carrying out the annexation for %2, you have forced the viceroy to move to the beloved town of my father, who must now return to Europe.<n><n>I want nothing more to do with you. I hope I never see you again. I also want you to know that I was always far more interested in the traders at the inn than I ever was in you. You never meant anything to me and you will be the last thing on my mind from now on.<n><n>I sincerely hope that, sooner or later, you receive the punishment you so richly deserve.<n><n>%3
text: %1，你为%2完成了吞并，迫使殖民地总督迁往我父亲心爱的城镇，而父亲如今只能返回欧洲。<n><n>我再也不想与你有任何瓜葛，但愿永远不再见到你。我还要告诉你，我对酒馆里那些商人的兴趣，向来远远超过对你的兴趣。你对我从来就无足轻重，从今往后，我最不愿想起的就是你。<n><n>我衷心希望，早晚有一天，你会受到应得的惩罚。<n><n>%3

source: Look here. I have just received a message from my ambassador informing me that %1 has made us a unexpected peace offering. This means that we will probably make peace as early as today. <n><n>Therefore, I can no longer assign you a mission to capture a town.
text: 瞧，我刚收到大使的消息，%1出人意料地提出议和。我们可能今天就会停战。<n><n>因此，我不能再交给你攻城任务了。

source: A trade route already exists with the name '%1'.<n><c>Do you want to overwrite it?
name: IDPR_AHS_UEBERSCHREIBEN
text: 已存在名为“%1”的贸易航线。<n><c>要覆盖它吗？

source: %1,<n>I am glad that you have come. Come in and I'll see if I have something for you.
text: %1，<n>很高兴您来了。请进，我看看有什么事能交给您。

source: The commander of the town guard calls to your captain from the town wall,  asking him to call off the battle and fight a duel with him instead. To avoid further losses, your captain agrees.
text: 城镇卫队指挥官在城墙上向你的船长喊话，要求停止战斗，改由双方决斗。为避免更多伤亡，你的船长同意了。

source: After your troops have destroyed the town gate, they are confronted by the commander of the town guard. He challenges your captain to a duel.
text: 你的部队摧毁城门后，遇到了城镇卫队指挥官。他向你的船长提出决斗。

source: Keep a lookout for English convoys in the area and destroy @I$NumConvoys$ of them.
text: 留意该地区的英格兰船队，消灭其中@I$NumConvoys$支。

source: Keep a lookout for French convoys in the area and destroy @I$NumConvoys$ of them.
text: 留意这一带的法国船队，消灭其中@I$NumConvoys$支。

source: Keep a lookout for Dutch convoys in the area and destroy @I$NumConvoys$ of them.
text: 留意附近的荷兰船队，并摧毁其中@I$NumConvoys$支。

source: Keep a lookout for Spanish convoys in the area and destroy @I$NumConvoys$ of them.
text: 留意该地区的西班牙船队，消灭其中@I$NumConvoys$支。

source: Well done! Tortuga has the status "boom" once again. You completed this task within @I$Days$ days.
text: 干得好！托尔图加再次恢复了“繁荣”。你用了@I$Days$天完成这项任务。

source: Average for 1 day. Average daily profit %1.
text: 每日平均值。日均利润为%1。

source: An experienced captain is waiting at the inn.
text: 一位经验丰富的船长正在酒馆等候。

source: <n><n>You can usually hand back a building permit you have acquired. However, you cannot do so in this case because %1 is the town where you started the game.
text: <n><n>通常，你可以交回已取得的建筑许可证。但这里不行，因为%1是你开始游戏的城镇。

source: <n><n>Do you want to hand back your permit?<n>Remember that I can pay you nothing for it!
text: <n><n>你想交还许可证吗？<n>记住，我不会为此付你任何钱！

source: Thank you. I will pay you high prices for wine, tools and spices until @D$Date$. Meet my emissary at the marketplace and deliver @a$Amount$ of each. He will only accept a complete delivery and will pay you there and then.
text: 谢谢。在@D$Date$之前，我会高价收购葡萄酒、工具和香料。请在市场与我的使者见面，每种交付@a$Amount$。他只接受一次交齐全部货物，并会当场付款。

source: That sounds good. So travel to our enemies' towns and buy up import goods there. Deliver @a$Amount$ of each by @D$Date$ to my emissary at the marketplace of @T$TOWN$, he will pay more than twice the usual price.
text: 那就好。请到敌国城镇买下那里的进口商品，在@D$Date$之前，将每种各@a$Amount$送到@T$TOWN$集市上的特使手中。他会支付超过平常两倍的价格。

source: Do you know what the best thing would be? To buy up the imported goods in @n$Nation2$ and cause a shortage there. Deliver @a$Amount$ of each to the marketplace. My emissary will wait there until @D$Date$ and will pay you a high price.
text: 你知道最妙的办法是什么吗？把@n$Nation2$的进口商品买光，让他们闹短缺。请把每种进口商品各@a$Amount$运到市场。我的使者会在那里等到@D$Date$，并出高价收购。

source: I recently overheard a conversation in which a trader mentioned that one of his ships had sunk. He wasn't too concerned about the ship, as it was only a rickety old tub. But it had a special chest on board.
text: 最近我无意中听见一个商人说，他的一艘船沉了。他倒不心疼那艘破旧老船，但船上有一只特别的箱子。

source: We have an agreement then. On the last trip I signed on to, the captain lost his temper over a chest for some reason, which he then just dumped overboard.
text: 那就说定了。我上次跟船出海时，船长不知为何对一口箱子大发雷霆，然后竟把它直接扔进了海里。

source: A man who was once a good friend has run off with an expensive chest of mine.
text: 一个曾经的好友带着我一只贵重的箱子逃走了。

source: I must have these things! We do not know the exact spot where the ship sank. @l$ChestPos$ Bring me the chest by @D$EndDate$.
text: 我一定要得到这些东西！我们不知道沉船的确切位置。@l$ChestPos$请在@D$EndDate$前把箱子带给我。

source: You must get me the things by @D$EndDate$. @l$ChestPos$
text: 你必须在@D$EndDate$前把东西带给我。@l$ChestPos$

source: Only recently he wrote to tell me he had thrown this chest overboard. @l$ChestPos$ You must bring me back my things! You can find me here until @D$EndDate$.
text: 不久前，他写信告诉我，已经把这个箱子扔下了船。@l$ChestPos$你一定要把我的东西找回来！我会在这里等到@D$EndDate$。

source: A local trader is prepared to pay you %1 for the business.
text: 一位当地商人愿意出价%1购买这家企业。

source: A military convoy has destroyed the town's harbor defenses and has looted goods. The status of the town has also fallen.
text: 一支军事船队摧毁了城镇的港口防线，并劫掠货物。城镇的发展状态也下降了。

source: Very good! Now you have to make your convoy more powerful so that you'll be able to take on several military convoys. You should have at least three ships in your convoy that are frigates or larger ships.<n><n>You can capture the ships or try to purchase them in the shipyards of the governor towns.<n><n>Make these ships escort ships and ensure that they are fully-armed and fully-manned with sailors.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Arm your convoy so that it has at least three fully-armed and fully-manned escort ships that are frigates or larger ships.
text: 很好！现在你得增强船队实力，才能应对多支军事船队。船队里应至少有三艘护卫舰或更大的船。<n><n>你可以俘获这些船，也可以试着在总督驻地的造船厂购买。<n><n>把它们设为护航船，并确保武器齐备、水手满编。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>关卡目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>武装你的船队，使其至少拥有三艘武器和水手满编的护航船，船型必须是护卫舰或更大。

source: I am certain that you have already heard of the pirate @P$PirateName$. He already has @I$NumConvoys$ convoys and we have not yet discovered his hideout. Fortunately, we know the whereabouts of one of his convoys. Perhaps he is still nearby. I want you to destroy this convoy.
text: 我相信你已经听说过海盗@P$PirateName$。他手下已有@I$NumConvoys$支船队，而我们仍未找到他的巢穴。所幸，我们掌握了其中一支船队的行踪，它或许还在附近。我希望你消灭这支船队。

source: We must act quickly, for I have just learned of the whereabouts of one of the convoys belonging to the pirate @P$PirateName$. Find and destroy this convoy.
text: 我们必须立即行动，我刚刚得知了海盗@P$PirateName$的一支船队的下落。找到并消灭它。

source: All pirates have their own hideout from which they dispatch convoys to capture booty. Meanwhile, the pirate @P$PirateName$ has amassed a fleet of @I$NumConvoys$ convoys. By chance, we have discovered the recent whereabouts of an important captain from this gang and his convoy. I want you to find and destroy this convoy.
text: 每个海盗都有自己的巢穴，从那里派出船队四处劫掠。如今，海盗@P$PirateName$已聚集了@I$NumConvoys$支船队。我们偶然获悉了这伙海盗一名重要船长及其船队最近的行踪。我希望你找到并消灭这支船队。

source: The status of the town is low.
<f:fonts/Tiepolo_black13x13aaFHk.res>Protect the town harbor<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold13x13aaFHk.res>(convoy is in the harbor and an escort ship is present)
text: <f:fonts/Tiepolo_black13x13aaFHk.res>守卫城镇港口<n><f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold13x13aaFHk.res>（船队停在港内且拥有护航船时）

source: Do you want to demolish the most recently constructed warehouse?
text: 要拆除最近建造的仓库吗？

source: My darling %1,<n>I can barely contain my impatience. Please hurry to the market and deliver the goods for the wedding, so we can have the banquet soon.
text: 亲爱的%1：<n>我已经迫不及待了。请尽快去市场交付婚礼所需的货物，让我们早日举办喜宴。

source: To display the next scenario objective, you must accomplish your mission to capture the towns.
text: 必须先完成夺取城镇的任务，才会显示下一个剧本目标。

source: Thank you for returning the package to me. Here is your reward of @g$Reward$.
text: 感谢你把包裹送回来。这是@g$Reward$报酬。

source: Today, the pirate %1 started wreaking havoc in the Caribbean.
text: 今天，海盗%1开始在加勒比海兴风作浪。

source: Unfortunately, I cannot tell you anything definite. My harbor master gave me a vague description of the ship that they may have taken. A trader spotted this ship at sea and showed me the spot. @l$Pos$ Search this area, you may find a clue.
text: 遗憾的是，我也说不出确切消息。我的港务长只粗略描述了他们可能乘坐的那艘船。一位商人曾在海上见过它，并给我指出了位置。@l$Pos$去那一带搜索，也许能找到线索。

source: The position is @l$Pos$. Search this area, you may find a clue. Please bring me back my daughter safe and sound.
text: 位置是@l$Pos$。搜查这一带，也许能找到线索。请把我的女儿平安带回来。

source: The position is @l$Pos$. Search this area, perhaps @F$WifeName$ was trying to tell us something when she mentioned it. Please bring my daughter back safe and sound. And if you come across that Casanova, give him my best regards.
text: 地点是@l$Pos$。搜索那片区域，也许@F$WifeName$提到那里，是想暗示我们什么。请把我女儿平安带回来。如果碰到那个花花公子，替我好好“问候”他。

source: Are you sure you want to quit the current game and return to the main menu?
text: 确定退出当前游戏并返回主菜单吗？

source: You cannot add more than 10 ships to the convoy.
text: 船队最多只能编入10艘船。

source: We are at war with @n$HostileNation$. One of my captains recently thought of a clever way to demoralize @n$HostileNation$. He suggested assembling a military convoy comprising our enemy’s ships, in order to give them a taste of their own medicine, so to speak.<n>You appear to be just the man to secure these ships for us.
text: 我们正与@n$HostileNation$交战。最近，我的一位船长想出了打击@n$HostileNation$士气的妙计：用敌人的船组建一支军事船队，让他们尝尝自己的厉害。<n>看来，你正是能帮我们弄到这些船的合适人选。

source: As we are once again at war with @n$HostileNation$, I want to assemble a new convoy to protect my town. I have no desire to wait until I am assigned a new military convoy from Europe.<n>Unfortunately, my resources are currently very limited and so I came up with the idea of using our enemy's ships. Do you wish to help me capture several @S$ShipType$ type ships?
text: 我们又与@n$HostileNation$开战了，我想组建一支新船队来保卫城镇。我可不愿等着欧洲派来新的军事船队。<n>可惜我目前资源十分有限，于是想到干脆使用敌人的船。你愿意帮我夺取几艘@S$ShipType$吗？

source: You have no suitable convoy in the town
text: 您在城里没有合适的船队

source: Natives have attacked the town and looted all the luxury goods. The attack claimed the lives of %1 citizens.
text: 原住民袭击了城镇，劫走所有奢侈品。袭击造成%1名居民死亡。

source: Thank you. I am a trader from @T$Town$. As my pursuers do not know where I am staying, they will surely try to catch me in my home town. Start your search there and kill the bounty hunters. I must depart from here no later than @D$EndDate$. If you accomplish the mission before then, I will pay you @g$Reward$.
text: 谢谢。我是来自@T$Town$的商人。追杀我的人不知道我藏在哪里，一定会去我的家乡等我。从那里开始搜寻，杀掉那些赏金猎人。我最迟必须在@D$EndDate$离开这里。如果你能在那之前完成任务，我会付你@g$Reward$。

source: I must return to @T$Town$ urgently, as I have some business to take care of there before I can make off for good. Unfortunately, the access routes to @T$Town$ are being watched by a bounty hunter, whom you must kill. I will reward you with @g$Reward$ if you accomplish the mission before @D$EndDate$.
text: 我急需返回@T$Town$，在那里处理完一些生意，才能彻底远走高飞。可惜有个赏金猎人监视着通往@T$Town$的航路，你必须除掉他。如果能在@D$EndDate$之前完成，我会给你@g$Reward$作为报酬。

source: Thank you! I suspect that a bounty hunter is watching the entrance to the harbor of @T$Town$.<n>This is what we will do: I will spread a rumor that I am going aboard one of your ships and then you set sail for @T$Town$ and see what happens.<n>Let me know by @D$EndDate$ at the latest that the coast is clear and I will then pay you a reward of @g$Reward$.
text: 谢谢！我怀疑有个赏金猎人守在@T$Town$的港口入口。<n>我们这样办：我散布消息，说自己登上了你的一艘船，然后你驶向@T$Town$，看看会发生什么。<n>最迟在@D$EndDate$前告诉我危险已解除，我就付你@g$Reward$赏金。

source: Congratulations! You have successfully completed this scenario and rid the Caribbean of the scourge of a notorious pirate.<n><n>Over the course of the game, pirate hideouts will emerge of their own accord. However, the number of pirate convoys depends on how successful they are. Note that pirates only want to loot trading convoys and are very wary of military convoys. For this reason, they avoid waters where too many military convoys are at large.<n><n>You can also hunt down pirates and smoke out their hideouts in free-play mode.
text: 恭喜！你成功完成了本关，为加勒比海除掉了一名臭名昭著的海盗。<n><n>游戏过程中，海盗巢穴会自行出现，而海盗船队的数量取决于他们的劫掠是否顺利。请注意，海盗只想抢劫贸易船队，对军事船队十分忌惮，所以会避开军事船队频繁活动的海域。<n><n>在自由游戏模式中，你同样可以追捕海盗，捣毁他们的巢穴。

source: %1 of %2 sailors want to join you in your adventures.
name: IDPR_HDC_MATROSEN_JOIN
text: %2名水手中有%1名愿意随你冒险。

source: Congratulations! You have been entrusted with a mission to capture towns!<n><n>Since towns may be very heavily defended, you should choose an English town with a minimum number of cannon towers in its harbor. The town of @T$SampleTown$ is a perfect target.<n><n>To attack a town, activate the Attack Towns option for your convoy. To do so, select your convoy and click on the Attack Mode button.<n><n>You can attack a town from the sea or from land. However, you should only risk an attack from land if your sailors outnumber the town's soldiers. You should also be able to arm half of your sailors with cutlasses and half with muskets in this case.<n><n>Note: If there is a military convoy in a town's harbor, you have to defeat this convoy before attacking the town itself.<n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Accomplish your mission to capture towns.
text: 恭喜！你已经受命攻占城镇！<n><n>城镇的防御可能非常坚固，因此你应选择港口炮塔较少的英格兰城镇。@T$SampleTown$就是一个理想目标。<n><n>要攻击城镇，先为船队开启“攻击城镇”选项：选中船队，点击“攻击模式”按钮即可。<n><n>你可以从海上或陆地进攻。但只有当水手人数超过守军时，才值得冒险从陆地进攻。此时还应准备足够的武器，让一半水手装备弯刀，另一半装备火枪。<n><n>注意：如果城镇港口内有军事船队，必须先击败它，才能攻击城镇。<n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>关卡目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>完成攻占城镇的任务。

source: Excellent! Now your convoy is armed and ready to track down one of Blackbeard's pirate convoys.<n><n>The Event window provides daily hints to help you discover the location of the pirate convoy, provided that the location is at sea. Finding pirates can be difficult because they always return to their hideout after a successful raid on a trading ship.<n><n>Remember that a pirate convoy can have up to five warships. Reinforce your convoy if you don't think it is powerful enough. You already know how to get your hands on some gold.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Accomplish the mission assigned to you by the Governor of @T$TOWN$.
text: 太好了！你的船队已全副武装，可以开始追踪黑胡子的一支海盗船队了。<n><n>只要海盗船队还在海上，事件窗口每天都会提供线索，帮助你发现它的位置。寻找海盗并不容易，因为每次成功劫掠商船后，他们总会返回藏身处。<n><n>请记住，海盗船队最多可能拥有五艘战舰。如果你认为自己的实力不足，就继续加强船队。你已经知道该如何赚到金币了。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>完成@T$TOWN$总督交给你的任务。

source: Deliver @a$Amount$ by @D$Date$. You can hand over the goods at the market and you shall receive an immediate payment of @g$GoldPerBarrel$ for each <gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen> of @G$Goods$.
text: 在@D$Date$之前交付@a$Amount$。你可以在市场交货，每<gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>的@G$Goods$可立即获得@g$GoldPerBarrel$。

source: I am delighted. Please deliver @a$Amount$ to the market. There, you shall receive your payment of  @g$GoldPerBarrel$ for each <gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen> until @D$Date$.
text: 太好了。请把@a$Amount$运到市场。在@D$Date$之前，每<gs:TEXTFLUSS_KEINEHOEHE><g:INTEXT_FASS_800x600.screen>可获得@g$GoldPerBarrel$。

source: Please meet my emissary at the market. Hand over @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$ by @D$Date$, he will offer you good price.
text: 请到市场与我的使者碰面，在@D$Date$前交给他@a$Amount$的@G$Goods$。他会给你一个好价钱。

source: So, @N$OwnerName$ sent you to see me? Yes, I do know this old captain, he could certainly teach your crew a thing or two. Why should I help you though? But I don't want to be difficult, I appreciate you must have spent some time tracking me down. If you do a small favor for me, I'll tell you where the captain has retired.
text: 是@N$OwnerName$让你来找我的？没错，我认识那位老船长，他确实能教你的船员一些本领。不过，我为什么要帮你呢？但我也不想为难你，毕竟你找我一定花了不少工夫。替我办件小事，我就告诉你那位船长隐居在哪里。

source: I don't know any @N$OwnerName$, but I certainly do know where @N$TeacherName$ is. I suppose I could tell you, if I was so inclined. How about you scratch my back and I'll scratch yours?
text: 我不认识什么@N$OwnerName$，不过确实知道@N$TeacherName$在哪里。只要我愿意，倒是可以告诉你。不如你帮我一个忙，我也帮你一个忙，如何？

source: I don't care if it was @N$OwnerName$ who sent you or the hunchbacked Grand Vizier of Taipei! I have a problem. And, until it is solved, I am not interested in hearing about anything else. I have a suggestion: How about you find me a chest, and I’ll tell you where this crazy old @N$TeacherName$ is hiding.
text: 我才不管派你来的是@N$OwnerName$，还是台北那个驼背大宰相！我有个麻烦，解决之前，别的事我一概不想听。不如这样：你替我找回一只箱子，我就告诉你那个疯老头@N$TeacherName$躲在哪里。

source: Your convoy is in the harbor with an unarmed brig and your cash assets amount to %1.
text: 您的船队停在港内，拥有一艘未武装的双桅横帆船。您的现金为%1。

source: Your convoy is in the harbor with an unarmed sloop and your cash assets amount to %1.
text: 你的船队停泊在港口，拥有一艘未武装的单桅帆船，现金为%1。

source: Your convoy is in the harbor with an unarmed pinnace and your cash assets amount to %1.
text: 你的船队停泊在港口，拥有一艘未武装的皮纳斯帆船，现金为%1。

source: Look out for English trading convoys and sink or capture at least @I$NumShips$ ships.
text: 寻找英格兰贸易船队，击沉或俘获至少@I$NumShips$艘船。

source: Look out for French trading convoys and sink or capture at least @I$NumShips$ ships.
text: 寻找法国贸易船队，击沉或俘获至少@I$NumShips$艘船。

source: Look out for Dutch trading convoys and sink or capture at least @I$NumShips$ ships.
text: 寻找荷兰贸易船队，击沉或俘获至少@I$NumShips$艘船。

source: Look out for Spanish trading convoys and sink or capture at least @I$NumShips$ ships.
text: 留意西班牙商船队，击沉或夺取至少@I$NumShips$艘船。

source: Attack trading convoys belonging to @n$TargetNation$ and sink or capture @I$NumShips$ ships by @D$EndDate$.
text: 袭击@n$TargetNation$的贸易船队，在@D$EndDate$前击沉或俘获@I$NumShips$艘船。

source: Attack trading convoys belonging to @n$TargetNation$ in the waters around @T$TargetTown$ and sink or capture @I$NumShips$ ships.  You have until @D$EndDate$.
text: 在@T$TargetTown$附近海域袭击@n$TargetNation$的贸易船队，击沉或俘获@I$NumShips$艘船。期限为@D$EndDate$。

source: I don't have anything for you. Accomplish my last mission, and we'll take it from there.
text: 目前没有别的事可交给您。先完成上次的任务，我们再谈。

source: In duels you will receive a bonus of <o:0xFFF2FAAD>5%<o> for the damage you inflict on your opponent.
text: 决斗时，你对敌人造成的伤害额外提高<o:0xFFF2FAAD>5%<o>。

source: Pirates have attacked the town but could not breach the harbor defenses.
text: 海盗袭击了城镇，但未能突破港口防线。

source: Oh, I can't believe it. Drunkards have stolen my beautiful ship. They filled it with bottles of rum and made off. Can you help me search for my ship?
text: 真不敢相信！一群醉汉偷走了我的漂亮船只，装满朗姆酒就跑了。你能帮我找船吗？

source: I might have known. My feckless son Boris has borrowed my finest ship. I have now discovered that he and his friends have decided to set off on a jaunt. No doubt, they have filled the hold with rum and I'm sure that I will never see my ship again. Could you retrieve my ship for me?
text: 我早该猜到了。我那不成器的儿子 Boris 借走了我最好的船，如今才发现他要和朋友出海游玩。毫无疑问，他们把货舱装满了朗姆酒，我怕是再也见不到那艘船了。你能替我找回来吗？

source: Many thanks for delivering on time, the Governor will be delighted. The wedding banquet is to start this very day!
text: 非常感谢你按时送达，总督一定会很高兴。婚宴就在今天开始！

source: All your sailors already have the highest possible morale.
text: 所有水手的士气都已达到最高。

source: You have no convoy and no stores in the town
text: 你在这座城镇没有船队，也没有仓库

source: Loot @a$Amount$ of spices, wine and tools from transport convoys belonging to @n$HostileNation$. You must not capture or sink any ships. Then deliver these goods to the market in @T$TOWN$ by @D$EndDate$. After that, you can collect your reward from the governor.
text: 从@n$HostileNation$的运输船队中，劫取香料、葡萄酒和工具各@a$Amount$。不得夺取或击沉任何船只。然后在@D$EndDate$之前，将货物送到@T$TOWN$的市场。完成后即可向总督领取报酬。

source: Build a church and increase the population of your town to 2,200. You have until @D$EndDate$.
text: 建造一座教堂，并把城镇人口增加到2,200。期限为@D$EndDate$。

source: The convoy cannot set sail because there are too many sailors on board. Fire some of your sailors so you do not exceed the maximum number of crew allowed.
text: 船上水手过多，船队无法起航。请解雇一些水手，使人数不超过船员上限。

source: Capture a colonial town belonging to %3 for %1 by %2 . The town must not be the seat of a Governor or of the viceroy.
text: 在%2前，替%1夺取一座属于%3的殖民地城镇。该城镇不能是总督或殖民地总督的驻地。

source: Capture any town belonging to %3 for %1 by %2 .
text: 在%2前，替%1夺取任意一座属于%3的城镇。

source: Good. Your mission is to loot @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$ from English traders.
text: 好。你的任务是从英格兰商人那里掠得@a$Amount$的@G$Goods$。

source: Good. Your mission is to loot @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$ from French traders.
text: 好。您的任务是从法国商人手中抢到@a$Amount$的@G$Goods$。

source: Good. Your mission is to loot @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$ from Dutch traders.
text: 好。您的任务是从荷兰商人手中抢到@a$Amount$的@G$Goods$。

source: Good. Your mission is to loot @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$ from Spanish traders.
text: 好。您的任务是从西班牙商人手中抢到@a$Amount$的@G$Goods$。

source: %1 %2 has destroyed a convoy belonging to the pirate %3.

I hear that you want to put yourself to the test as commander of a sea battle. Well, I have a task for you that could benefit both of us.<n>Two abandoned ships are floating aimlessly at sea as we speak. I want you to get rid of these ships before they start to pose a threat to my traders.<n>Do you accept this mission?
text: 听说你想试试自己指挥海战的本领。我倒有个对你我都有好处的任务。<n>此刻有两艘弃船正在海上漫无目的地漂流。我希望你在它们危及我的商人之前把它们清除掉。<n>你接受这项任务吗？

source: Now for something rather more difficult. A little bird told me where a pirate convoy commanded by @P$PirateName$ is currently roaming the seas. The convoy consists of only one ship, so it shouldn't prove too difficult for you to destroy it.<n>Do you accept this mission?
text: 接下来有件稍难一些的事。有人告诉我，@P$PirateName$指挥的一支海盗船队目前正在某片海域游荡。这支船队只有一艘船，消灭它对你来说应该不算太难。<n>你接受这项任务吗？

source: You have already destroyed a pirate convoy belonging to @P$PirateName$. However, there are usually several convoys in a pirate hideout, all commanded by @P$PirateName$. You can only eliminate the leader of a pirate gang by finding and destroying their hideout.<n>Another convoy commanded by @P$PirateName$ has now emerged. This convoy consists of two ships, and so you must be well prepared before you engage in combat.<n>Are you ready?
text: 你已经消灭了一支属于@P$PirateName$的海盗船队。不过，一处海盗巢穴通常有多支船队，都听命于@P$PirateName$。只有找到并摧毁巢穴，才能彻底消灭海盗头目。<n>现在又出现了一支由@P$PirateName$指挥的船队。这支船队有两艘船，因此交战前必须做好充分准备。<n>你准备好了吗？

source: You can attack this pirate hideout from the sea with a convoy. First you must defeat all ships in the harbor.
text: 你可以派船队从海上进攻这个海盗巢穴。首先必须击败港内的全部船只。

source: %1 %2 You also have a permit to erect buildings and establish businesses in %3 and you already own a warehouse in the town.<n><n>As you are young and inexperienced, you have only reached the rank of Ship's Boy. Therefore you cannot yet command further convoys or buy additional building permits in another town.<n><n>Your rank is determined by your total assets, which comprise cash and property and currently amount to around %4. You will reach the next rank as soon as your assets reach %5.<n><n><n>Good luck!
text: %1 %2 你还拥有在%3建造房屋、开办产业的许可证，并且已经在该城镇拥有一座仓库。<n><n>你年轻且缺乏经验，目前只达到船童等级，因此还不能指挥更多船队，也不能在其他城镇购买额外的建筑许可证。<n><n>你的等级由总资产决定，包括现金与财产，目前约为%4。总资产达到%5时，你就会晋升下一级。<n><n><n>祝你好运！

source: The convoy cannot set sail because there are too many goods on board. Sell some of your goods or move them to your warehouse so you do not exceed the maximum loading capacity of the convoy.
text: 船上货物过多，船队无法起航。请卖掉部分货物，或转移到仓库，使载货量不超过船队的上限。

source: Excellent! Your town is now quite large. Soon, the first traders from other towns will land to trade goods with your town.<n><n>But your town is also in danger of being visited by other, less desirable characters. These include pirates and buccaneers from nations with which you have a poor relationship. Your next task is therefore to hire soldiers and erect harbor cannons.<n><n>Fortunately, the citizens in your town can organize themselves to a large degree. You only have to give them some instructions and purchase any necessary materials. After that, there are no extra costs.<n><n>You can construct harbor cannons using the Construction menu, and you can hire soldiers from your palace.<n><n>Remember:<n>Soldiers need living quarters too! However, in contrast to workers, soldiers only require one  space each.<n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario  objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Construct five harbor cannons and increase your soldiers to 300.
text: 太好了！你的城镇已经颇具规模。很快，第一批外地商人就会前来交易。<n><n>但城镇也可能迎来不受欢迎的客人，包括海盗，以及与你关系不佳的国家派来的私掠者。因此，你接下来的任务是招募士兵、建造港口炮台。<n><n>幸好，城镇居民大多能够自行组织。你只需下达指示，购买必要的材料，之后无需再支付额外费用。<n><n>你可以通过建设菜单建造港口炮台，并在宫邸里招募士兵。<n><n>记住：<n>士兵也需要住处！但与工人不同，每名士兵只占一个居住名额。<n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>关卡目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>建造五座港口炮台，把士兵数量增加到300。

source: Nobody here can bear the sight of you.
I am happy to see you.
A pirate has become more powerful
text: 一名海盗的势力壮大了

source: Your captain has defeated the commander in the duel. <n><n>What do you want to do now?
text: 你的船长在决斗中击败了守军指挥官。<n><n>接下来你想怎么做？

source: <n>The convoy had no other ship and was disbanded.
text: <n>船队已没有其他船只，因此解散了。

source: Tortuga must achieve the status "boom" by @D$EndDate$.
text: 托尔图加必须在@D$EndDate$之前达到“繁荣”状态。

source: You have defeated the %1 buccaneer %2 in a duel and taken him hostage. You can go to a Governor of his nation to demand a ransom for him.
text: 您在决斗中击败了%1私掠者%2，并将他扣为人质。您可以前往他的国家，向当地总督索取赎金。

source: So be it. I hereby task you with attacking trading convoys belonging to @n$TargetNation$ and capturing or sinking @I$NumShips$ ships. You therefore only have until @D$EndDate$.
text: 就这么办。我委托你攻击@n$TargetNation$的贸易船队，俘获或击沉@I$NumShips$艘船。期限是@D$EndDate$。

source: I am delighted. I regret that I cannot allow you much time. You must accomplish this mission by @D$EndDate$.   Attack trading convoys belonging to @n$TargetNation$ and sink or capture @I$NumShips$ ships.
text: 太好了。遗憾的是，我不能给你太多时间。你必须在@D$EndDate$之前完成任务。攻击@n$TargetNation$的商船队，击沉或夺取@I$NumShips$艘船。

source: Your troops break down the town gate and storm into the town. When the town's soldiers see this, they capitulate and your men begin looking for the treasure chamber without meeting any resistance. They loot %1.
text: 你的部队撞破城门，冲进城内。城里的士兵见状投降，你的部下随即毫无阻碍地搜寻宝库，掠走了%1。

source: You have no convoy in the town.

It gives me great satisfaction to hear that you have put Blackbeard in his place. As a reward, I am making you the gift of a Spanish galleon. It is awaiting you in the harbor. <n><n>And, while I’m at it, I might as well give you @g$Reward$.
text: 听说您给了黑胡子一个教训，我十分欣慰。作为奖励，我送您一艘西班牙大帆船，它已经在港内等您。<n><n>既然如此，我再送您@g$Reward$好了。

source: I am once again very satisfied to hear about your renewed defeat of the contemptible Blackbeard. I must also pass on my wife’s very special regards. She wishes to make you a gift of her Spanish galleon, and I don’t mean our cook!<n><n>In addition, I am rewarding you with @g$Reward$.
text: 听说你再次击败了卑鄙的黑胡子，我非常满意。我还要转达妻子对你的特别问候。她想把自己的西班牙大帆船送给你——我说的可不是我们那位西班牙厨娘！<n><n>此外，我再奖赏你@g$Reward$。

source: The ship carrying the spy set sail from @T$HostileTown$ in the direction of Europe and will leave the Caribbean in the east. Search the route for several documents and bring them to the Governor of @T$TOWN$ by @D$EndDate$.
text: 载有间谍的船已从@T$HostileTown$启程前往欧洲，将从东面离开加勒比海。请沿航线搜寻数份文件，并在@D$EndDate$前交给@T$TOWN$的总督。

source: <n>You don't have enough cash. Come back when you can afford it.
text: <n>你的现金不够。等付得起时再来吧。

source: Your rank is too low to assemble another convoy.
text: 你的等级太低，无法再组建一支船队。

source: You have reached the maximum number of convoys.
text: 你拥有的船队数量已达到上限。

source: A trader in %1 has demolished a business because the continuing low price of %2 in the town meant that production was no longer viable.
text: %1的一位商人拆除了一处产业，因为当地%2的价格持续低迷，已经无法维持生产。

source: Your task was to establish five different businesses in Tortuga and increase the number of citizens to 1,500. You didn't complete this task successfully.<n><n>Obtain the raw materials you need to construct the buildings. As soon as construction is under way, you should start to acquire the settler families you need. You need 30 settler families for each business and this will give you 120 new citizens.
text: 你的任务是在托尔图加兴建五种不同企业，并将市民人数增加到1,500。你未能完成这项任务。<n><n>先采购建造所需的原材料。施工一开始，就该着手招募所需的移民家庭。每家企业需要30个移民家庭，能带来120名新市民。
<ts:0><ts:160>选择<t>船队<n>进入<t>城镇图标/建筑<n>船只/港口<t>显示独立船只

source: The game could not be deleted!
The commander of the town guard has defeated your captain in a fair duel. The captain nobly accepts the outcome and duly orders a retreat.
text: 城防军指挥官在公平决斗中击败了你的船长。船长体面地接受了结果，随即下令撤退。

source: %1 %2 has broken through the town's land defenses and looted the town.
text: %1%2突破了城镇的陆地防御，并洗劫了城镇。

source: Construct five harbor cannons in your town and increase the number of soldiers to 300.
text: 在你的城镇建造五门港口火炮，并将士兵人数增加到300。

source: The person who charged you with your task has had goods delivered to the market in @T$Town$.
text: 委托你任务的人已把货物送到@T$Town$市场。

source: Greetings, %1. %2, a very experienced captain, has offered you his services.
text: 你好，%1。经验丰富的船长%2愿意为你效力。

source: Attack convoys belonging to @n$HostileNation$ and capture two @S$ShipType$ type ships. Anchor these ships in the harbor of @T$TOWN$ and visit the governor again by @D$EndDate$.
text: 袭击@n$HostileNation$的船队，俘获两艘@S$ShipType$。将它们停泊在@T$TOWN$港口，并在@D$EndDate$之前再次拜访总督。

source: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>You have discovered a huge goods cache and take the goods on board.
text: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>您发现了一大批藏匿的货物，并将它们搬上船。

source: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>You have discovered a huge goods cache, but you have no room to take the goods on board.
text: <g:INTEXT_TREIBGUT_800x600.screen><n>你发现了大批隐藏的货物，但船上没有空间装载。

source: I see you are a wealthy man, %1.<n><n>I would normally ask you for a loan, but unfortunately I can only do such business with local traders. Therefore, you must be able to produce a building permit for my town.
text: 看得出你很富有，%1。<n><n>我本来想向你借笔钱，可惜我只能与当地商人做这种生意。因此，你必须出示本城的建筑许可证。

source: We are in the governor town of Cartagena in the Southern Caribbean.<n>You can enter the various buildings in a town and perform various actions, more about this later on.<n>First, look at the top of the screen. You can see a range of buttons and displays.<n>Now click on the button with the clock, to the very left of the screen.
text: 我们现在位于加勒比海南部的总督驻地卡塔赫纳。<n>你可以进入城镇内的各种建筑，进行不同操作，稍后会详细介绍。<n>先看看屏幕顶部，那里有一排按钮和信息栏。<n>现在点击屏幕最左侧带时钟的按钮。

source: This is the Chronicle. It contains a record of all the events and occurrences in the Caribbean, rather like a daily newspaper.<n>There are some buttons to right of the Chronicle window. You can use these to display information about the Caribbean. However, this is not important for the moment.<n>Now close the Chronicle by clicking on the button marked "X".
text: 这是编年纪事。它像每日新闻一样，记录加勒比海发生的各种事件。<n>编年纪事窗口右侧有几个按钮，可以用来查看加勒比海的相关信息。不过目前还不必关注这些。<n>现在点击“X”按钮，关闭编年纪事。

source: At the top of the screen, beside the date, is the Log button and next to it, your cash.<n>The log keeps you up-to-date with any information concerning your successes and possessions. In addition, all the messages and missions that you receive are saved here.<n>Open the log.
text: 屏幕顶部、日期旁边是日志按钮，再旁边显示你的现金。<n>日志会随时记录你的成就与财产状况，收到的所有消息和任务也保存在这里。<n>打开日志。

source: As you can see, the log immediately displays all the messages that you have received so far. At the moment, the log only displays the instructions for this scenario.<n>There are more buttons to the right of the Log window. Click on the third button.
text: 可以看到，日志立即显示了你迄今收到的全部消息。目前，日志里只有本剧本的说明。<n>日志窗口右侧还有一些按钮。请点击第三个。

source: This displays the tasks and missions that you have received. At the moment, only the scenario objective is displayed.<n>Using the two buttons at the very top of the Mission window, you can switch between current and completed missions.<n>Now close the log. You can also do this simply by right-clicking.
text: 这里显示你收到的任务和委托。目前这里只列出了剧本目标。<n>任务窗口最上方的两个按钮，可以切换查看进行中的任务和已经完成的任务。<n>现在关闭日志。直接右击也可以关闭。

source: Later on in the game, you can accept numerous missions in order to achieve fame and fortune.<n>First, let's take a look at the town. As you can see from the display at the top center of your screen, we are in Cartagena. The town has roughly 2,000 inhabitants.<n>Click on the button showing the name of the town.
text: 随着游戏推进，你可以接受许多任务，赢取名望与财富。<n>先来看看城镇。屏幕上方中央显示，我们现在位于卡塔赫纳，这里大约有2,000名居民。<n>点击显示城镇名称的按钮。

source: This opens a window that displays information about the town.<n>Cartagena is a governor town and belongs to Spain. You can also see the status of the town and the goods that can be produced there.<n>Now enter a building. To do this, close the town information display.
text: 这会打开显示城镇信息的窗口。<n>卡塔赫纳是西班牙的总督驻地。你还能看到城镇的经济状况，以及当地可以生产的货物。<n>接下来进入一座建筑。先关闭城镇信息窗口。

source: You can use the arrow keys on your keyboard to move around the town view. Now take a look at the town center within the town walls. It contains buildings, such as the docks, the church and the governor's palace.<n>Click once on any of these buildings.
text: 你可以使用键盘方向键移动城镇视野。现在看看城墙以内的中心城区，这里有码头、教堂和总督府等建筑。<n>任选一座建筑，点击一次。

source: The display at the bottom center of your screen changes when you click on a building. Depending on the type of building, you now receive information or you can do certain things.<n>There are buttons to the right of the building display. To leave the building, click on the button marked "X".
text: 点击建筑时，屏幕下方中央的信息栏会随之变化。根据建筑类型，你可以查看信息，或执行不同操作。<n>建筑信息栏右侧有按钮。点击“X”即可离开建筑。

source: The buildings in which you can perform various actions are always located within the town walls. Your warehouse is an exception, and there will be more about this in the next scenario.<n>Now leave the building and use the arrow keys to display the harbor and the convoy named “Santa Maria”. Click on it.
text: 可以进行各种操作的建筑，通常都位于城墙以内。你的仓库是个例外，下一个剧本会详细介绍。<n>现在离开建筑，用方向键移动视角，找到港口和名为“Santa Maria”的船队，然后点击它。

source: As you can see, information on your convoy now appears in the bottom center of your screen.<n>The convoy has already loaded goods: 10 barrels of wheat and 15 barrels of corn.<n>There are several buttons to the right of the convoy display. Click on the second button (the one with the ship icon).
text: 你可以看到，屏幕下方中央已经显示出船队的信息。<n>船队装有一些货物：10桶小麦和15桶玉米。<n>船队信息右侧有几个按钮。请点击第二个，也就是带有船只图标的按钮。

source: This displays the number of ships in the convoy. A convoy can have up to 10 ships led by a captain.<n>Now let's send the convoy to another town.<n>Click on the button with the arrow in the top-right of your screen to leave the town and display the sea chart.
text: 这里显示船队的船只数量。一位船长率领的船队，最多可有10艘船。<n>现在让船队前往另一个城镇。<n>点击屏幕右上角带箭头的按钮，离开城镇，打开海图。

source: The sea chart now appears. In the center of the screen, you will see the town of Cartagena.<n>You can use the arrow buttons to shift the area of the map that is displayed and view the entire game world.<n>Now look for the town of Port Royale on an island to the north and right-click on the town with your convoy selected.
text: 现在显示的是海图。屏幕中央就是卡塔赫纳。<n>你可以用方向键移动视野，查看整个游戏世界。<n>现在找到北方岛屿上的皇家港，选中船队，再右键点击城镇。

source: A route is plotted and your convoy sets off.<n>By right-clicking on Port Royale, you have selected it as your convoy's destination.<n>If the convoy is taking too long to reach the town, you can simply fast-forward the game by pressing the space bar (default setting).
text: 航线已经规划好，您的船队出发了。<n>右键点击皇家港，就将它设成了船队的目的地。<n>如果觉得航程太慢，可以按空格键快进游戏，这是默认按键。

source: Welcome to %1,<n><n>I'd like to give you some words of advice to enable you to find your way in the region around %2 more quickly, so you can assist my nation in expanding this and other towns.<n>I'm sure you are already familiar with the basic information about governor towns: They need a constant supply of colonial goods for export to Europe. At the same time, these towns usually offer an assortment of luxury goods, which can be sold for a handsome profit to other towns.<n>Just one more thing: You might be interested to know that governors assign missions from time to time. However, you cannot accept missions until you have reached the rank of Ship's Boy.<n><n>%3 %4, Governor of %5
name: ID_LETTER_WELCOME_TEXT
text: 欢迎来到%1，<n><n>我想给你几条建议，帮助你尽快熟悉%2周边地区，以便协助我国发展本城及其他城镇。<n>相信你已经了解总督驻地的基本情况：这里需要持续供应殖民地特产，运往欧洲出口。同时，这类城镇通常有各种奢侈品出售，转运到其他城镇可赚取丰厚利润。<n>还有一件事：总督会不时委托任务。不过，你必须先达到船童等级，才能接受任务。<n><n>%5总督，%3 %4

source: Since your convoy has arrived in Port Royale, you may now enter in the town. Just click on the town symbol (with the small houses).
text: 船队已经抵达皇家港，现在可以入城了。点击带有小房子的城镇图标即可。

source: You now see the familiar town view again, but this time it's of Port Royale. You can move through any town in which you have convoys or buildings.<n>Look for the shipyard in the harbor and click on it, because we want to buy a new ship.
text: 您又看到了熟悉的城镇画面，不过这次是皇家港。只要城里有您的船队或建筑，您就能进入城镇。<n>在港区找到造船厂并点击它，我们要买一艘新船。

source: The shipyard is now displayed in the selection window where the convoy was just displayed.<n>Have a look around the shipyard by clicking on the buttons to the right of the shipyard display.<n>Then return to the display "Buy Ship" and have a look at the ships that are available.<n>Buy any ship you want.
text: 刚才显示船队的选择窗口，现在显示的是造船厂。<n>点击造船厂面板右侧的按钮，浏览一下各项功能。<n>然后返回“购买船只”页面，看看有哪些船可供购买。<n>挑选任意一艘船买下。

source: Congratulations! You have bought your first ship.<n>The ship will be delivered to the town's harbor.<n>Now leave the shipyard and click on the waters in the harbor. The selection window now displays the individual ships in the harbor.<n>Click on your new ship.
text: 恭喜！你买到了第一艘船。<n>船会交付到城镇港口。<n>现在离开造船厂，点击港口水面。选择窗口会显示停在港内的独立船只。<n>点击你的新船。

source: This displays the ship’s data, which you already saw in the shipyard.<n>Before you can do anything with an individual ship, you must add it to a convoy.<n>To do this, select your convoy again.
text: 这里显示船只资料，你在造船厂已经见过。<n>独立船只必须先编入船队，才能行动。<n>现在重新选中你的船队。

source: You now want to tell your convoy to interact with the harbor.<n>Right-click on the harbor.
text: 现在要让船队与港口进行交互。<n>请右键点击港口。

source: A Transfer window opens, in which you can add individual ships to the convoy.<n>To do this, click on the single ship on the left and drag it to the convoy, so that the convoy consists of two ships.<n>Then close the Transfer window again using the "X" button on the right.
text: 现在会打开调配窗口，你可以在其中将单独的船只编入船队。<n>点击左侧那艘独立船只，把它拖到船队中，让船队拥有两艘船。<n>然后点击右侧的“X”，关闭调配窗口。

source: You can also assemble another convoy with a new ship by hiring a new captain at the inn.<n>However, you cannot do this at the moment because your rank is not high enough.<n>Now select the convoy’s list of ships. This is the second button.
text: 你也可以在酒馆雇用新船长，用新船另组一支船队。<n>不过，你目前的等级还不够，暂时无法这样做。<n>现在选择船队的船只列表，也就是第二个按钮。

source: You now have a convoy with two ships in the harbor of Port Royale.<n>You can click on the ships in the convoy’s ships list to find out details about the ships.<n>Now send the convoy back to your home town of Cartagena. To do this, go to the sea chart by clicking on the button with the arrow in the extreme top-right of your screen.
text: 你现在有一支两艘船组成的船队，停泊在皇家港。<n>点击船队船只列表中的船，可以查看其详细信息。<n>现在派船队返回你的家乡卡塔赫纳。先点击屏幕最右上角的箭头按钮，切换到海图。

source: Now find the town of Cartagena in the south and send your convoy there by right-clicking on the town.<n>This scenario will end as soon as the convoy arrives at the town.
text: 现在找到南方的卡塔赫纳，右键点击城镇，让船队前往。<n>船队抵达时，本关便会结束。

source: You spend a very pleasant day with %1 and tell her of your adventures.
text: 你与%1愉快地共度一天，向她讲述自己的冒险。

source: You spend a very pleasant afternoon with %1 and forget about your business affairs for a time.
text: 你与%1共度了一个愉快的下午，暂时将生意抛在脑后。

source: You spend the evening with %1 and wish your time together would never end.
text: 你与%1共度良宵，只希望相伴的时光永不结束。

source: I have been waiting for you, %1. What do you have for me?
text: 我一直在等你，%1。你给我带来了什么？

source: There you are, %1. Do you have all the goods with you?
text: 你来了，%1。货物都带齐了吗？

source: Greetings, %1. Have you brought something for me?
text: 你好，%1。你给我带东西来了吗？

source: A convoy has docked unnoticed in the harbor.
text: 一支船队悄悄驶入港口，未被察觉。

source: You didn't put an end to the famine in Tortuga in time. To end a famine, you must ensure that at least three kinds of food must be available in the town for daily consumption. If all four kinds of foods are available, the famine will end sooner.
text: 你没能及时终结托尔图加的饥荒。要结束饥荒，城镇每天至少需要有三种食物可供消费。如果四种食物都齐备，饥荒就会更快结束。

source: Search for your wife. You have discovered a useful clue: @l$Pos$
text: 寻找你的妻子。你已发现一条有用的线索：@l$Pos$

source: Click on the goods to activate or cancel sale.
text: 点击商品以启用或取消出售。
由仓库管理员自动出售
贸易航线<n>不得动用<n>最低库存。

source: Do not allow<n>trade routes <n> to breach maximum stock level.
text: 不允许<n>贸易航线<n>超出库存上限。

source: A heavy storm is raging over the town
text: 猛烈风暴正在席卷城镇

source: Come in, my son. Will you not sit yourself down to pray?
text: 进来吧，我的孩子。何不坐下来祈祷？

source: My country is prepared to pay you %1 for the release of %2.
text: 我国愿意支付%1，换取您释放%2。

source: You have defeated your opponent and sunk a ship.
text: 你击败了对手，并击沉了一艘船。

source: You have sunk %1 ships in your opponent’s convoy.
text: 你击沉了敌方船队的%1艘船。

source: My nation recently lost the last governor town to its enemies.<n><n>If these enemy nations are weakened by having their military convoys sunk, we will then be able to win back some towns.<n><n>To avoid any problems with the other nations, I will  issue you with a Letter of Marque against our enemies.
text: 我国最近连最后一座设有总督的城镇都被敌人夺走了。<n><n>如果能击沉敌国的军事船队，削弱它们的实力，我们就能收复一些城镇。<n><n>为免您与其他国家发生不必要的纠纷，我会签发一份针对我国敌人的私掠许可证。

source: Are you not the famous @A$USER$? Could you please help me? I am being pursued by a bounty hunter, one of my adversaries put him on my tail.
text: 你不就是大名鼎鼎的@A$USER$吗？能帮帮我吗？有个赏金猎人正在追捕我，是一位仇家派他来的。

source: Please pull up a stool, @A$USER$. My name is @N$OwnerName$ and I have an important matter to discuss with you. Where do I begin? Well, I had an argument with my wife; she accused me of being unfaithful to her, which of course is completely untrue. Anyway, she threw me out of the house, and that's not the worst of it: She has hired a bounty hunter, so I can no longer even enter the town. Can you help me?
text: 请坐，@A$USER$。我叫@N$OwnerName$，有件要事想和你商量。该从哪儿说起呢？唉，我和妻子吵了一架；她指责我对她不忠，这当然完全是无稽之谈。总之，她把我赶出了家门。而且还不止如此：她雇了个赏金猎人，弄得我现在连城都进不去了。你能帮帮我吗？

source: You look like someone who can run a tight ship.<n>I have to travel to @T$Town$ urgently, to deliver documents that incriminate one of the local traders there. Unfortunately, the trader has got wind of this and is now trying to get his hands on the documents. Couldn’t you find a way of getting me to @T$Town$?
text: 看起来你是个能把船管好的人。<n>我急着去@T$Town$，送交能指证当地一位商人罪行的文件。不幸的是，那个商人已经得到了风声，正想方设法夺走文件。你能想办法把我送到@T$Town$吗？

source: Search outside the town of @T$TOWN$ for clues as to the drunkards' whereabouts. Return the ship to the trader @N$OwnerName$ by @D$EndDate$.
text: 在@T$TOWN$城外寻找醉汉下落的线索。请在@D$EndDate$之前，把船还给商人@N$OwnerName$。

source: Have you heard that a plague has broken out in @T$Town$? This could certainly have been prevented if there had been a hospital in the town. Unfortunately, my master builder is a coward and is afraid to enter the town in order to commission the hospital. I therefore propose sending you. Do you accept? I am prepared to pay you @g$Reward$ for your efforts!
text: 你听说@T$Town$爆发瘟疫了吗？如果当地有医院，本来一定可以避免。可惜我的建筑师是个胆小鬼，害怕入城主持医院建设。所以，我想派你去。你接受吗？我愿意支付@g$Reward$，酬谢你的辛劳！

source: You cannot perform a transfer with a convoy that is being repaired.
text: 不能与正在维修的船队调配船只或货物。

source: Today, an English military convoy attacked your convoy.
text: 今天，一支英格兰军事船队袭击了你的船队。

source: Today, a French military convoy attacked your convoy.
text: 今天，一支法国军事船队袭击了你的船队。

source: Today, a Dutch military convoy attacked your convoy.
text: 今天，一支荷兰军事船队袭击了你的船队。

source: Today, a Spanish military convoy attacked your convoy.
text: 今天，一支西班牙军事船队袭击了您的船队。

source: %1 %2 has attacked the town but could not breach the defenses.
text: %1 %2袭击了城镇，但未能突破防线。

source: Accomplish two more missions to capture towns for the Dutch viceroy before the end of the war between Holland and England. You have until @D$EndDate$.
text: 在荷兰与英格兰的战争结束之前，再替荷兰殖民地总督完成两次夺取城镇的任务。您的期限是@D$EndDate$。

source: A saboteur has contaminated the food supplies in Tortuga. This has immediately triggered a famine in the town.<n><n>Your task is to end this famine as quickly as possible.<n><n>For about 2-3 weeks, you must ensure that more goods are available than are consumed per day for as many foodstuffs as possible.<n><n>Hint: The foodstuffs include wheat, fruit, corn and meat.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>The famine must end by @D$EndDate$.
text: 一名破坏者污染了托尔图加的粮食储备，城镇立即爆发了饥荒。<n><n>你的任务是尽快结束这场饥荒。<n><n>在大约两到三周内，你必须让尽可能多种食物的可用库存持续高于每日消耗量。<n><n>提示：食物包括小麦、水果、玉米和肉类。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>必须在@D$EndDate$之前结束饥荒。

source: Thank you kindly. Here is the map piece. You can inspect it in your log.
text: 非常感谢。这是地图碎片，你可以在日志中查看。

source: %1,<n>my dear friend, I am so happy to see you. I hope you have been well since we last met.
text: %1，<n>亲爱的朋友，见到你真高兴。希望自从上次分别后，你一直安好。

source: %1,<n>you are most welcome to my home. Come in and let's talk awhile.
text: %1，<n>欢迎来我家。快进来，我们聊一会儿。

source: Introductory Scenario<n><n>This introductory scenario is all about goods transport and trade. You will be provided with tips about how to make large trading profits and you will learn how to assemble new convoys.
text: 入门剧本<n><n>本入门剧本介绍货物运输与贸易。你将学到获得丰厚贸易利润的技巧，以及组建新船队的方法。

source: Excellent! Now you should capture more English towns on Holland's behalf. But don't be slow because you can only capture towns while Holland and England are at war.<n><n>As usual, missions of this kind can only be assigned to you by the viceroy in Grand Bahama. Before you can be assigned any more missions to capture towns, you may have to do something to influence the military strengths and weaknesses of the two nations. You already know how to do this.<n><n>As backup, the Governor of the Turk Islands has provided you with three more carracks.<n><n>There are also many sailors and weapons available in the harbor.<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Accomplish two more missions to capture towns for the Dutch viceroy before the end of the war between Holland and England. You have until @D$EndDate$. The scenario will then be over.
text: 太好了！现在你应该代表荷兰攻占更多英格兰城镇。但动作要快，因为只有荷兰与英格兰交战期间才能攻占城镇。<n><n>和往常一样，这类任务只能由大巴哈马的殖民地总督交给你。要接到更多攻城任务，你可能需要先改变两国的军事强弱对比。你已经知道该怎么做。<n><n>作为增援，特克斯群岛总督又为你提供了三艘卡拉克帆船。<n><n>港口里也有大量水手和武器可供补充。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>关卡目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>在荷兰与英格兰的战争结束前，为荷兰殖民地总督再完成两次攻城任务。期限为@D$EndDate$，届时本关结束。

source: %1 %2 buys a permit to construct buildings in %3.
text: %1 %2购买了在%3建造建筑的许可证。

source: I have no other news for you. I bid you good day.
text: 没有其他消息了。祝你愉快。

source: We have nothing further to discuss. Come back and see me again in a few days.
text: 我们没什么可谈的了。过几天再来找我吧。

source: That will be all for today. I wish you the best of luck until we meet again.
text: 今天就到这里吧。祝你好运，我们后会有期。

source: Your reputation in %1 is too low for you to be granted a meeting with the treasurer.
text: 你在%1的声望太低，无法获准会见司库。

source: I want you to attack military convoys belonging to @n$HostileNation$ and capture two @S$ShipType$ type ships. Anchor the ships in the harbor and then come back to me.
text: 我希望你攻击@n$HostileNation$的军事船队，夺取两艘@S$ShipType$型船只。把船停在港口后，再来找我。

source: I want you to attack military convoys belonging to @n$HostileNation$ and capture two @S$ShipType$ type ships. Anchor the ships in the harbor and then come back to me.
text: 我希望你攻击@n$HostileNation$的军事船队，夺取两艘@S$ShipType$型船只。把船停在港口后，再来找我。

source: Add towns by clicking on them.
text: 点击城镇，将其加入航线。

source: Congratulations! You are now familiar with the basics of building a town.<n><n>As soon as your production facility is constructed, it automatically begins to employ workers. Each settler waiting at the harbor to be hired can be converted into one worker and four citizens. This means that one settler actually represents an entire settler family.<n><n>To ensure that your businesses have enough workers, you must ensure that sufficient numbers of settlers are available for work. Transport convoys carry settlers from Europe to the governor towns and are then brought by traders to the other towns<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Ensure that you have enough workers for your business in Santa Marta.
text: 恭喜！你已经掌握了建设城镇的基本方法。<n><n>生产设施建成后会自动开始雇用工人。港口每一名等待雇用的移民，都代表一个四口之家，其中一人可以成为工人。因此，雇用一名移民会为城镇增加四名居民。<n><n>要让企业有足够工人，就必须确保有足够移民等待就业。运输船队将移民从欧洲带到总督驻地，再由商人送往其他城镇。<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>剧本目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>确保你在圣玛尔塔的企业拥有足够工人。

source: Tortuga didn't achieve the status "wealth" in time. Each and every good influences the status of a town. If there is sufficient supply of a good to last 10 days, the good will have the best possible affect on the citizens' quality of life and therefore on the status of the town.
text: 托尔图加未能及时达到“富裕”状态。每一种货物都会影响城镇的经济状况。如果某种货物足够供应十天，它对居民生活质量和城镇经济的促进效果就能达到最佳。

source: A ship in the convoy has sunk
text: 船队中有一艘船沉没了

source: Destroy all of Blackbeard’s pirate convoys that are at sea. Do not attack his hideout!
text: 消灭黑胡子所有在海上的海盗船队。不要攻击他的巢穴！

source: Some aspects of the trade route had to be changed.<n><n>In this game, some of the towns in the route have not been discovered yet and have been removed, or you want to trade goods in a town, but there is no warehouse in this town. In this case, captain trading for the relevant town is activated for the corresponding goods.
text: 贸易航线的部分设置已调整。<n><n>这条航线中的某些城镇在当前游戏中尚未发现，因此已移出航线；或者您设置了通过仓库调配某种商品，但当地没有仓库，此时该城镇相应商品的交易方式会改为由船长买卖。

source: Thank you! My beautiful ship has been returned to me at last. Unfortunately, I can give you no gold, but I have had a couple of very nice goods delivered to you at the market in @T$Town$.
text: 谢谢！我漂亮的船终于回来了。遗憾的是，我无法用金币酬谢你，但我已安排在@T$Town$的市场给你送去一些很不错的货物。

source: We must make good this shortage quickly. Will you help me do this?
text: 我们必须尽快弥补短缺。你愿意帮忙吗？

source: Loot the town of @T$TargetTown$, which belongs to @n$HostileNation$, and free the governor's wife by @D$EndDate$.
text: 在@D$EndDate$之前洗劫属于@n$HostileNation$的@T$TargetTown$，救出总督的妻子。

source: That groomed poodle Michelle belonging to the Governor of @T$TOWN$ is being held captive in @T$TargetTown$. Loot the town and rescue the dog before @D$EndDate$.
text: @T$TOWN$总督那条精心打扮的贵宾犬米歇尔，被囚禁在@T$TargetTown$。请在@D$EndDate$之前劫掠该城，救出这条狗。

source: Attack the town of @T$TargetTown$, which belongs to @n$HostileNation$, by @D$EndDate$ in order to free the younger daughter of the governor.
text: 在@D$EndDate$之前进攻属于@n$HostileNation$的@T$TargetTown$，救出总督的小女儿。

source: Congratulations, you have successfully completed your first scenario. You now know how to select convoys and send them to other towns. You have also learned how to enter buildings in a town to perform various actions, such as buying a ship.<n><n>The next section is about making money by trading profitably.
text: 恭喜，你成功完成了第一个剧本。现在你知道如何选择船队并命令它驶往其他城镇，也学会了如何进入城镇中的建筑，进行购买船只等操作。<n><n>下一部分将介绍如何通过有利可图的贸易赚钱。
二维图形库与界面工具

source: …the many participants in the Port Royale forum, whose ideas and suggestions made the second part of Port Royale possible.<n>...the beta testers of Port Royale 2, who showed a tireless commitment to the project during open beta testing. Nicole Jeannette Pescher, Don Geraldo and BMP from the beta test for the logos they sent.
text: ……感谢《海商王》论坛的众多参与者，你们的创意与建议促成了续作的诞生。<n>……感谢《海商王2》的测试玩家，在公开测试期间始终不懈支持本项目。感谢测试中的 Nicole Jeannette Pescher、Don Geraldo 和 BMP 提供标志图案。

source: I have inspected the new artifacts and I think the engravings denote a particular location. %1 But I'm not sure yet. Hopefully you'll find even more artifacts, because I'm sure I can pinpoint the location more precisely.
text: 我查看了新找到的古物，觉得上面的雕刻指向某个地点。%1不过我还不能确定。希望你能再找到一些古物，那样我一定能更准确地确定位置。

source: I have found out something more about the artifacts and the special location. One thing I can now say for sure: %1 What that place holds, I do not know. To locate the position more accurately, I need more artifacts.
text: 关于那些古物和那个特殊地点，我又有了些发现。现在有一点可以确定：%1 那里到底藏着什么，我还不知道。要进一步确定位置，还需要更多古物。

source: I have some very good news: With the last artifact you found, I was able to make out an exact position. Here, I'll plot it for you on the sea chart. %1<n>Please be careful, as no one knows what lies in wait there.
text: 有个好消息：凭借你最后找到的那件遗物，我已经确定了准确位置。来，我给你标在海图上。%1<n>务必小心，谁也不知道那里等着你的是什么。

source: Hot on the Trail of Blackbeard!
A ship in the convoy has sunk
text: 船队中有一艘船沉没了

source: the military presence in this town is already very good
text: 本城的驻军已经十分充足

source: Arm your convoy and accomplish the new mission assigned to you by the Governor of Cartagena.
text: 武装船队，完成卡塔赫纳总督交给你的新任务。

source: A local trader is prepared to sell you the business for a price of %1.
text: 一名当地商人愿意以%1出售这处产业。

source: Living space is scarce in the town.
There is not enough %1 in the town.
You begin your career with <o:0xFFF2FAAD>%1<o> gold pieces and a <o:0xFFF2FAAD>sloop<o> (60 tons, max. 14 cannons)
text: 你将带着<o:0xFFF2FAAD>%1<o>金币和一艘<o:0xFFF2FAAD>单桅帆船<o>开始生涯（60吨，最多14门炮）

source: The town that you seek is a desolate place, far flung from all the world, as though forsaken, or in disgrace.
text: 你寻找的城镇荒凉冷落，远离尘世，仿佛遭人遗弃，又像蒙受了耻辱。

source: A river from the wilds at the headland divides There lies a town in which you’ll gladly reside.
text: 荒野流来的河水劈开岬角，那里有座令人乐意安居的城镇。

source: Four towns sit on the bay together. Sail to the east, in the third you must tether.
text: 四座城镇共临一湾，向东航行，在第三座系缆。

source: Not the most northerly town can it be, but further north only one other will you see.
text: 它不是最北方的城镇，但再往北走，你只会看见另一座。

source: Holy August is now northward bound, very soon in the town is where he’ll be found.
text: 圣奥古斯丁正向北行，不久便会在那座城镇现身。

source: Not the most northerly town can it be, but further north only one other will you see.
text: 它不是最北方的城镇，但再往北走，你只会看见另一座。

source: Holy August is now northward bound, very soon in the town is where he’ll be found.
text: 圣奥古斯丁正向北行，不久便会在那座城镇现身。

source: Holy August is now northward bound, very soon in the town is where he’ll be found.
text: 圣奥古斯丁正向北行，不久便会在那座城镇现身。

source: The town that you seek is a desolate place, far flung from all the world, as though forsaken, or in disgrace.
text: 你寻找的城镇荒凉冷落，远离尘世，仿佛遭人遗弃，又像蒙受了耻辱。

source: The town that you seek is a desolate place, far flung from all the world, as though forsaken, or in disgrace.
text: 你寻找的城镇荒凉冷落，远离尘世，仿佛遭人遗弃，又像蒙受了耻辱。

source: A lonely town lies in the west of the headland.
text: 岬角西侧，有一座孤零零的城镇。

source: A lonely town lies in the west of the headland.
text: 岬角西边，有一座孤零零的城镇。

source: You should travel here if you want to bake colored sweet corn bread with fruit in the clay oven.
text: 若想用黏土烤炉，烤出加了水果的彩色甜玉米面包，就到这里来吧。

source: You should travel here if you want to bake colored sweet corn bread with fruit in the clay oven.
text: 若想用黏土烤炉，烤出加了水果的彩色甜玉米面包，就到这里来吧。

source: You should travel here if you want to bake colored sweet corn bread with fruit in the clay oven.
text: 若想用黏土烤炉，烤出加了水果的彩色甜玉米面包，就到这里来吧。

source: You should travel here if you want to bake colored sweet corn bread with fruit in the clay oven.
text: 若想用黏土烤炉，烤出加了水果的彩色甜玉米面包，就到这里来吧。

source: This is the westernmost town of the region.
text: 这是该地区最西边的城镇。

source: Once long ago did other people here live, with their great temples praise to the gods did they give. Above it lies X, up in a corner. You’ll sail to the southeast in vain, I should warn you.
text: 很久以前，另一个民族居住于此，宏伟神庙承载着他们的颂祷。X 藏在其上方的一角；切记，向东南航行只会徒劳。

source: Once long ago did other people here live, with their great temples praise to gods did they give. Above it lies X, up in a corner. You’ll sail to the southwest in vain, I should warn you.
text: 很久以前，另一个民族曾居住此地，在宏伟神庙里敬奉诸神。X就在它上方的角落。劝你别往西南航行，那里只会徒劳。

source: The distance from X to Nombre is not far, you have plenty of rum and can enjoy a cigar.
text: X 离诺姆布雷-德迪奥斯并不远，朗姆酒正足，雪茄可慢慢品。

source: If off the cliffs to the north you should teeter, then in X you will certainly soon feel much better.
text: 若在北方悬崖前心惊胆战，到了 X，您定能很快心安。

source: Three little islands this area surround, but only on one are there ropes to be found.
text: 三座小岛围绕着这片地区，但只有一座岛能找到绳索。

source: X lies on the island, it’s really quite small. But look to the southeast, there’s none larger at all.
text: X位于一座小岛。向东南望去，便是最大的一座。

source: Here in the island chain, you’ll see a break. To the west there are islands and in the south. In the north there is nothing, only water and smoke.
text: 在这条岛链中，你会看见一道缺口。西边有岛，南边也有。北边则空无一物，只有海水与烟雾。

source: In a large bay lie some towns, there are three. X refers to the most westerly of these.
text: 一处大海湾里有三座城镇，X指的是最西边那座。

source: In a large bay lie some towns, there are three. X refers to the most southern of these.
text: 一处大海湾里有三座城镇，X指的是最南边那座。

source: A bay holds two islands, one large and one small. The town on the larger, under X must it fall.
text: 一处海湾藏着两座岛，一大一小。大岛上的城镇，正是X所指的目标。

source: An island far off, small and remote. There is nowhere else for X to denote.
text: 一座小岛，孤悬远海。X所指的，别无他处。

source: X is a town that has streets paved with gold. Its majestic harbor is a sight to behold.
text: X是一座街道仿佛铺满黄金的城镇，壮丽的港口令人叹为观止。

source: Four towns are situated around a volcano. The town in the southeast is the one that you are looking for.
text: 四座城镇环绕着一座火山。东南方的那座，就是你要找的城镇。

source: X lies on the island, it’s really quite small. But look to the southeast, there’s none larger at all.
text: X位于一座小岛。向东南望去，便是最大的一座。

source: On its sands, the sea is home to towns for which no one cares. But one of these in particular has always produced fine wares.
text: 海边的沙地上，几座城镇无人问津。其中有一座，却始终出产上等货品。

source: In a large bay lie some towns, there are three. X refers to the most westerly of these.
text: 一处大海湾里有三座城镇，X指的是最西边那座。

source: In a large bay lie some towns, there are three. X refers to the most westerly of these.
text: 一处大海湾里有三座城镇，X指的是最西边那座。

source: An island lies here, as though in a cradle. A peninsula from the north curls around at an angle.
text: 此处有座岛屿，宛如卧在摇篮；北方伸来的半岛，弯弯将它环抱。

source: An island lies here, as though in a cradle. A peninsula from the north curls around at an angle.
text: 此处有座岛屿，宛如卧在摇篮；北方伸来的半岛，弯弯将它环抱。

source: White strand beside the jungle, a little river known to none. Here you lie well hidden, in a bay seen only by the sun.
text: 丛林旁有一片白色沙滩，一条无人知晓的小河。在只有阳光能窥见的海湾里，你藏得安安稳稳。

source: Here lies the town, overlooking the sound. It guards the bay, for with ships it abounds.
text: 城镇俯瞰海峡，守卫海湾，港内船舶来往如织。

source: Not far from the town, at the bottom of a cliff, lie the battered remains of an old wrecked ship.
text: 离城镇不远的悬崖脚下，躺着一艘古老沉船的破败残骸。

source: Spain set up a harbor here once. You will find wood and bricks, but wheat there is none.
text: 西班牙曾在此建港。木材和砖都能找到，小麦却不见踪影。

source: In a large bay lie some towns, there are three. X refers to the most westerly of these.
text: 一处大海湾里有三座城镇，X指的是最西边那座。

source: In a large bay lie some towns, there are three. X refers to the most easterly of these.
text: 一处大海湾里坐落着三座城镇，X指的便是其中最东边的那座。

source: An island lies here, as though in a cradle. The land from the north curls around at an angle.
text: 这里有座岛，仿佛躺在摇篮中。北方的陆地转过弯来，将它环抱。

source: An island lies here, as though in a cradle. The land from the north curls around at an angle.
text: 这里有座岛，仿佛躺在摇篮中。北方的陆地转过弯来，将它环抱。

source: You come from the west, the bridge you cross over. The town with the X lies only a little further.
text: 从西方而来，跨过那座桥梁；标有X的城镇，就在不远前方。

source: Oh what a wondrous place. Nestled in a bay. Protected by towering cliffs, this is X, I say!
text: 多么奇妙的地方，依偎在海湾之中。高耸峭壁将它守护，我说这就是X！

source: Not far from the town, at the bottom of a cliff, lie the battered remains of an old wrecked ship.
text: 离城镇不远的悬崖脚下，躺着一艘古老沉船的破败残骸。

source: Powerful river flowing so deep, on towards the east and into the swamp. From there to the southeast, sometimes over land. To the town with the X, at the edge, at the end.
text: 深邃大河浩荡东流，注入沼泽。从那里转向东南，有时还须越过陆地，直到边缘尽头、标着X的城镇。

source: Thank you for returning my wife to me. Although I very much enjoyed the peace and quiet of the last few days, I could not simply abandon my wife to my enemies. As a reward, take this map showing a hideout containing @a$Amount$ of goods.
text: 谢谢你把妻子送回我身边。虽然我很享受这几天的清静，却不能把她丢给敌人不管。这张地图就当作报酬，上面标出了一个藏有@a$Amount$货物的秘密地点。

source: So, you have not returned my wife to me! Then I cannot reward you. However, between us both, I am actually very grateful to you.
text: 原来你没有把妻子送回来！那我就不能奖赏你了。不过，只说给你听，我其实非常感激你。

source: Your troops soon gain the upper hand. Suddenly a white flag is raised above the town wall: the town guard has capitulated!<n><n>What do you want to do now?
text: 你的部队很快占据上风。突然，城墙上升起了一面白旗：城防军投降了！<n><n>接下来你想怎么做？

source: My wife is overjoyed that you have found her dog. Take this map showing a hideout containing @a$Amount$ of goods.
text: 你找到了妻子的狗，她欣喜若狂。收下这张地图吧，上面标着一个藏有@a$Amount$货物的秘密地点。

source: What? You mean you threw the dog overboard? I am nevertheless very grateful to you. Naturally, I cannot officially reward you, but I once hid treasure in a secret location. Here is a map.
text: 什么？你是说，你把那个混蛋扔下海了？即便如此，我仍然非常感激你。当然，我不能公开给你奖赏，但我曾在一个隐秘地点埋下宝藏。这是地图。

source: Oh, thank you for bringing back my beloved daughter. Here is a map. On it, I have marked the spot where I once hid lots of treasure.
text: 啊，谢谢你带回我心爱的女儿。收下这张地图吧，我在上面标出了曾经埋藏大量财宝的地点。

source: What have you done! How could you leave my daughter behind in enemy hands? I will tell all of @n$Nation$ that you cannot be trusted! (Reputation in @n$Nation$ has diminished)
text: 您都做了些什么！怎么能把我的女儿留在敌人手里？我要让整个@n$Nation$都知道，您这个人根本不可信！（在@n$Nation$的声望下降）

source: Your convoy with two ships must reach the harbor of the town of Cartagena.
text: 让拥有两艘船的船队抵达卡塔赫纳港口。

source: and the harbor is very well defended.
text: 而且港口防御十分严密。

source: You begin your career in the English town of %1 in the year %2.<n><n>
text: %2年，你在英格兰城镇%1开始自己的生涯。<n><n>

source: You begin your career in the French town of %1 in the year %2.<n><n>
text: %2年，你在法国城镇%1开始自己的生涯。<n><n>

source: You begin your career in the Dutch town of %1 in the year %2.<n><n>
text: %2年，你在荷兰城镇%1开始自己的生涯。<n><n>

source: You begin your career in the Spanish town of %1 in the year %2.<n><n>
text: 你将在%2年，于西班牙城镇%1开始自己的生涯。<n><n>

source: Select the allocation of weapons to your sailors.
text: 设置船员的武器配备比例。

source: Collect reward from the governor of @T$TOWN$
The convoy is being repaired. While it is being repaired, the boarding crew has shore leave and therefore does not incur any maintenance costs.
text: 船队正在维修。维修期间，接舷战水手上岸休假，不产生维持费用。

source: The deadline for the goods handover has expired.
Attack on an English transport convoy
Attack on a French transport convoy
Attack on a Dutch transport convoy
Attack on a Spanish transport convoy
Two abandoned ships are located two days north of Cartagena. I want you to dispose of them.
text: 卡塔赫纳以北两天航程处有两艘被遗弃的船。我希望你去处理掉它们。

source: You should now have sufficient town defenses for the moment. Now increase the size of your town and improve its appearance. Build a church, as well as more production facilities and residential areas to attract more than 2,200 inhabitants to your town.<n><n>You have until @D$EndDate$ to do so. The scenario will then be over.<n><n>Don't forget to sell the goods you produce at a profit! <n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Build a church and increase the population of your town to 2,200. You have until @D$EndDate$.
text: 城镇目前的防御应该已经足够。接下来，扩大城镇规模并改善市容。建造一座教堂，增建生产设施和住宅，吸引超过2,200名居民。<n><n>期限为@D$EndDate$，届时本关结束。<n><n>别忘了出售自产商品，赚取利润！<n><n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>关卡目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>建造教堂，并把城镇人口提高到2,200。期限为@D$EndDate$。

source: The demand for @G$MsgGoods$ is high in: @T$MsgTown0$ and @T$MsgTown1$
The traveler @N$Name$ thanks you for rescuing him and pays you a reward of @g$Reward$.
text: 旅客@N$Name$感谢您救了他，并支付@g$Reward$作为酬谢。

source: The traveler @N$Name$ thanks you for rescuing him and disembarks.
text: 旅人@N$Name$向你道谢，感谢你的搭救，随后下船离开。
鼠标移至地图边缘时滚动。

source: Now take heed! I'm afraid my brother-in-law is a bit of a vagabond, no one knows exactly where he is.
text: 不过听好了！我那位姐夫有点像个流浪汉，没人确切知道他在哪里。

source: I knew you'd be interested. @N$ContactName$ is away for much of the time.
text: 我就知道你会感兴趣。@N$ContactName$大部分时间都不在家。

source: True enough, I must put money aside for my old age. The trader @N$ContactName$ is a difficult man to find.
text: 的确，我得留些钱养老。商人@N$ContactName$可不是那么容易找到的。

source: You have reached the highest rank!
Look for him in the inns there. Believe me, you can take your time, but if you do happen to see him, send him my best regards and tell him he might like to remind my sister what he looks like!
text: 去那里的酒馆找找他。不必着急，不过要是碰见他，请代我问好，再告诉他：他也该去让我姐姐重新认认他的模样了！

source: I'm afraid I can't say when would be the best time to see him there. The best thing to do is just to look for him as often as possible in the inns there.
text: 我也说不准什么时候最容易在那里遇见他。最好经常去那里的酒馆找找。

source: No doubt you'll find him at an inn. But I'm sure he'll help you to find @N$TeacherName$.
text: 你一定能在某家酒馆找到他。我相信，他会帮你找到@N$TeacherName$。

source: <n>To make matters appear more official, I will give you a Letter of Marque against @n$TargetNation$.
text: <n>为了让此事更显正式，我会给你一张针对@n$TargetNation$的私掠许可证。

source: %1 has been promoted to the rank of %2
You have found an empty bottle of rum.<n>Continue in the same direction and look for more bottles, and you may discover the drunkards’ whereabouts.
text: 您找到了一只空朗姆酒瓶。<n>继续朝这个方向寻找更多酒瓶，也许就能查到那些醉鬼的下落。
残暴的克里斯蒂安船长

source: Oh @s$USER$, what am I to do? A trader from @T$Town$ keeps interfering in my business and snatching my profits. This has been going on for months. Can you help me get rid of his convoy?
text: 唉，@s$USER$，我该怎么办？@T$Town$的一位商人总是干扰我的生意，抢走我的利润，这已经持续了好几个月。你能帮我除掉他的船队吗？

source: Can you help me arrange a little act of reprisal? I am quite certain that a trader from @T$Town$ was responsible for sabotaging some of my ships. Now I can only sit and wait for my ships to return from the shipyard. I want you to destroy a convoy belonging to my ruthless adversary. I will reward you handsomely!
text: 你能帮我实施一次小小的报复吗？我十分肯定，是@T$Town$的一位商人破坏了我的几艘船。现在我只能干坐着，等船从造船厂修好回来。我希望你消灭这个狠毒对手的一支船队。我会重重酬谢你！

source: Are you not @A$USER$? I may have a task for you.<n>A long time ago, I gave a sizeable loan to a trader from  @T$Town$ and it is nearly as long since he was supposed to have repaid it.  Well, he did not do so and it don’t think it will occur to him to do so in the future.<n>Therefore, I want to teach him a lesson! Would you attack one of his convoys for me? I will reward you richly!
text: 你是@A$USER$吧？我或许有件事要托你办。<n>很久以前，我借给@T$Town$的一名商人一大笔钱，约定的还款日期也早就过了。可他至今分文未还，我看他以后也不打算还。<n>所以，我想教训他！你能替我攻击他的一支船队吗？我会重重酬谢！

source: Do you want to demolish this residential building?
You have purchased @a$Amount$ of @G$Goods$. Collect the goods at the market in @T$TOWN$.
text: 你购买了@a$Amount$@G$Goods$。请到@T$TOWN$的市场领取货物。

source: Greetings, %1. Helmsman %2 has offered his services as an experienced captain.
text: 你好，%1。舵手%2愿意为你效劳，他是一位经验丰富的船长。

source: Thank you kindly. The town in question is called @T$TargetTown$. I hope I can come to an arrangement with the traders before @D$EndDate$. Until then, the town cannot fall below the status "Boom", so I can negotiate from a stronger position.
text: 非常感谢。那座城镇叫@T$TargetTown$。我希望在@D$EndDate$之前与商人们达成协议。在此之前，城镇状态不能低于“繁荣”，这样我谈判时才更有底气。

source: The town in question is @T$TargetTown$. Supply the town with all the goods it needs. I will do my utmost to quell the rumor by @D$EndDate$ for once and for all. Before then, the town cannot fall below the status "Boom".
text: 需要您支援的是@T$TargetTown$。请为城里提供所需的全部商品。我会尽力在@D$EndDate$之前彻底平息谣言。在那之前，城镇的发展状况不能低于“繁荣”。

source: The town in difficulty is @T$TargetTown$. Its status cannot fall below "Boom" before @D$EndDate$, otherwise too many citizens will leave the town. There is even the risk of a plague breaking out there. You must ensure that you supply the town with enough goods in time to prevent this!
text: 遇到困难的是@T$TargetTown$。在@D$EndDate$之前，它的状态不能低于“繁荣”，否则会有太多居民离开，甚至可能爆发瘟疫。你必须及时供应足够的商品，防止这种情况！

source: Good. @T$TargetTown$ is the town in question. Supply the town with everything it needs by @D$EndDate$. Its status cannot fall below "Boom". I must be honest and tell you that the town could quite possibly be hit by a plague. Be prepared for it.
text: 很好。目标城镇是@T$TargetTown$。在@D$EndDate$之前，向城镇供应它所需的一切，经济状况不能跌到“繁荣”以下。我必须坦白告诉你，那里很可能发生瘟疫，请提前做好准备。

source: You have discovered the location of Blackbeard's hideout. For information on the pirate gang, left-click on the hideout symbol on the sea chart.<n><n>Beware: When you destroy a hideout, the pirate gang is annihilated. However, any pirate convoys that were not in the hideout at the time are informed and they then set up a new hideout.<n><n>Your first objective is therefore to destroy all of the convoys belonging to the hideout. Ideally, you should lie in wait for any convoys that sail into or out of the hideout and attack them.<n><n>You have received some more cash to support you in your quest.<n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>Scenario objective<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>Destroy all of Blackbeard’s pirate convoys that are currently at sea. Do not attack his hideout!
text: 你发现了黑胡子的巢穴。左键点击海图上的巢穴图标，可以查看这个海盗团伙的信息。<n><n>注意：摧毁巢穴就能消灭这个海盗团伙。但当时不在巢穴内的海盗船队会收到消息，并建立新的巢穴。<n><n>所以，你的首要目标是消灭属于该巢穴的全部船队。最好埋伏在附近，攻击进出巢穴的船队。<n><n>你又获得了一笔资金，用于支援此次行动。<n><n><f:fonts/ELGRECO_26x26aaFHk.res>关卡目标<f:fonts/Tiepolo_bold14x14aaFH.res><n><n><c>消灭黑胡子目前在海上的所有海盗船队。不要攻击他的巢穴！

source: <n>Note that you also need a Letter of Marque to hunt for buccaneers.
text: <n>请注意，追猎私掠者同样需要私掠许可证。

source: %1 and %2 signed a peace treaty today The relevant Letters of Marque are no longer valid.
text: %1与%2今天签署了和平条约。相关的私掠许可证现已失效。

source: <n><n>Would you not like to set sail and rout this buccaneer?
text: <n><n>你愿意出海击溃这名私掠者吗？

source: Thank you. Here is the map piece. Good luck searching for the treasure!
text: 谢谢。这是地图碎片，祝你寻宝顺利！

source: Form a second convoy and increase your total assets to @g$GoldGoal$.
text: 组建第二支船队，并把总资产提高到@g$GoldGoal$。

source: The status of the town of @T$TOWN$ has dropped below "flourishing economy".
text: @T$TOWN$的状态已降到“经济兴盛”以下。

source: Business growth since the start of the game
text: 游戏开始以来的产业增长

source: My father tells me that pirates pose no threat at the moment.
text: 父亲告诉我，目前海盗构不成威胁。

source: My father tells me that the pirate %1 currently poses the greatest threat. He has %2 convoys and a total of %3 ships.
text: 父亲告诉我，海盗%1目前威胁最大。他有%2支船队，共%3艘船。

source: The pirate %1 poses the greatest threat. He has %3 ships and a total of %2 convoys. I managed to establish the last known position of one of his convoys. %4 I'll mark the spot on the sea chart for you.
text: 海盗%1的威胁最大。他总共有%2支船队、%3艘船。我查到了其中一支船队最近出现的位置。%4 我会替你标在海图上。
